attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered per replenishment order as stipulated by the supplier contract. Replenishment engine enforces this floor when generating inventory_replenishment_order records.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planner review of this reorder policy's parameters. Calculated from last_reviewed_date plus the review_cycle_days. Drives planner workqueue prioritization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for replenishment planners to document rationale for policy parameter choices, exceptions, seasonal considerations, or supplier-specific constraints associated with this reorder policy.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.business_glossary_term: Order Multiple (Case Pack / Minimum Order Quantity)
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which orders must be placed, reflecting the supplier's case pack size or Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ). All replenishment order quantities are rounded up to the nearest multiple of this value to comply with supplier constraints.

tag_set.value: Order Multiple (Case Pack / Minimum Order Quantity)

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The fixed quantity (in units) to order each time a replenishment trigger is activated. Used for fixed_quantity reorder method. For other methods, this field may be null and the order quantity is dynamically calculated.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Business-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners and referenced in automated replenishment engines (e.g., Blue Yonder). Externally visible identifier across systems.

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the reorder policy, used by replenishment planners to identify and manage policies (e.g., 'DC Grocery Min/Max Weekly', 'Store Electronics WOS-Based').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reorder policy. Controls whether the policy is actively used by the replenishment engine to generate inventory_replenishment_order records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|draft|pending_approval|expired|suspended — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this reorder policy record, incremented each time parameters are materially changed. Supports policy change history tracking and rollback capability for replenishment planners.

attributes.name: reorder_method
attributes.description: The replenishment calculation method applied by this policy: min_max (reorder when stock falls below minimum, order up to maximum), days_of_supply (maintain a target number of days of inventory), wos_based (Weeks of Supply (WOS) target), forecast_driven (demand forecast from Blue Yonder), fixed_quantity (constant order quantity), vendor_managed (VMI — Vendor Managed Inventory where supplier controls replenishment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|days_of_supply|wos_based|forecast_driven|fixed_quantity|vendor_managed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The on-hand stock level (in units) at which a replenishment order is automatically triggered. When the stock_position in inventory falls at or below this threshold, an inventory_replenishment_order record is generated. Core parameter for min/max and fixed-quantity reorder methods.

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: The frequency in calendar days at which the replenishment engine evaluates this policy and checks whether a reorder trigger has been breached. Defines the periodic review interval (e.g., daily=1, weekly=7, bi-weekly=14).

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity (in units) maintained above the reorder point to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Prevents stockouts during replenishment cycles. A key input to the reorder point calculation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this reorder policy was originated or last updated: ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), SAP_MM (SAP S/4HANA MM Module), BLUE_YONDER (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), MANUAL (planner-entered), MDM (Informatica MDM). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: target_days_of_supply
attributes.description: The desired number of days of inventory coverage to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in days_of_supply reorder method to calculate the replenishment order quantity based on forecasted daily demand.

attributes.name: target_wos
attributes.description: The desired number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply — WOS) to maintain at this location for this SKU. Used in wos_based reorder method. Replenishment orders are sized to achieve this WOS target based on forecasted weekly demand.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which all quantity fields (reorder_point_quantity, safety_stock_quantity, min/max, order_quantity, etc.) are expressed for this policy. Aligns with the SKU's base unit of measure in the product master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|ML|FT|M — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reorder policy record was most recently modified. Tracks parameter changes made by replenishment planners and supports change audit trails.

products.name: asn
products.description: Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) records received from suppliers or DCs prior to physical goods arrival. Captures ASN number, sender (supplier or DC), destination node, expected arrival date, carrier, tracking number, total cartons, total units, SKU-level line details, and ASN status (sent, in-transit, received, discrepant). Enables pre-receiving workflows, dock scheduling, and receiving discrepancy detection against corresponding inventory_goods_receipt records. Received via EDI 856 or API from trading partners.

attributes.name: asn_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Advance Shipment Notice record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier responsible for transporting the shipment. Used for carrier performance tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: destination_node_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving inventory node (store, DC, or MFC) where the shipment is expected to arrive. Drives dock scheduling and pre-receiving workflows in the WMS.

attributes.name: dock_appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dock scheduling appointment associated with this ASN arrival. Links to supplychain.inbound_appointment for dock door and labor resource planning.

attributes.name: food_safety_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_log. Business justification: Inbound shipments trigger temperature and quality monitoring logs at receiving. Retail food operations require linking ASNs to food safety logs for HACCP compliance, critical limit verification, and c

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory goods receipt record created upon physical receipt of this shipment. Links ASN to the goods receipt for discrepancy detection and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: primary_asn_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating inventory node (DC, MFC, store, or supplier facility) from which the shipment was dispatched. Used for inter-node transfer ASNs.

attributes.name: primary_asn_supplier_vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to supplier.vendor

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that this ASN fulfills. Links to the supplychain.purchase_order product for PO-to-ASN reconciliation and receiving discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: supplier_edi_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EDI 856 transaction set that originated this ASN record. Used for EDI audit trails, reprocessing, and trading partner dispute resolution.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment physically arrived at the destination node dock. Compared against expected_arrival_date to measure carrier on-time delivery performance and lead time actuals.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ASN as transmitted by the supplier or DC via EDI 856 or API. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dock scheduling.

attributes.name: asn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ASN. 'sent' = transmitted by sender; 'in_transit' = shipment en route; 'arrived' = at destination dock; 'receiving' = active receiving in WMS; 'received' = fully received; 'discrepant' = quantity or SKU variance detected; 'cancelled' = voided prior to receipt. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sent|in_transit|arrived|receiving|received|discrepant|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ASN by origin and fulfillment pattern. 'supplier' = inbound from vendor; 'dc_transfer' = inter-DC or DC-to-store transfer; 'cross_dock' = direct cross-dock flow; 'drop_ship' = vendor direct-to-customer; 'return_to_dc' = store or customer return to DC.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier for the shipment. Legal document of title used for freight claims, customs clearance, and receiving verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ASN record was first created in the system, either upon EDI 856 inbound processing or manual entry. Audit trail for record lineage.

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving node. Determines which receiving workflow and dock door assignment logic applies in the WMS.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a receiving discrepancy (quantity overage, shortage, or SKU mismatch) was detected when comparing the ASN to the actual goods receipt. Triggers discrepancy resolution workflow.

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receiving discrepancy detected against the ASN. 'overage' = more units received than declared; 'shortage' = fewer units; 'sku_mismatch' = wrong SKU received; 'damage' = goods received in damaged condition; 'none' = no discrepancy.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Assigned dock door at the destination node for unloading this shipment. Pre-assigned during dock scheduling to optimize receiving throughput and yard management.

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Drives dock door scheduling, labor planning, and replenishment availability projections.

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment responsibility terms for the shipment. 'prepaid' = supplier pays freight; 'collect' = receiver pays; 'third_party' = billed to a third party. Drives accounts payable freight accruals.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is designated for cross-docking (direct transfer without storage) at the destination DC. Triggers cross-dock workflow in the WMS and bypasses putaway.

attributes.name: is_rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags are present on cartons or pallets in this shipment, enabling automated receiving and inventory tracking via RFID readers at the dock.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: External purchase order number as referenced on the ASN document. Denormalized from the PO for cross-system matching with EDI 856 transmissions and supplier invoices.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number for LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) shipments. Used for freight bill matching and carrier invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: receiving_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all line items on the ASN were fully received and confirmed in the WMS. Marks the transition from 'receiving' to 'received' or 'discrepant' status.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment was physically dispatched from the source node or supplier facility. Used to calculate lead time and measure supplier on-time shipping performance.

attributes.name: shipment_mode
attributes.description: Transportation mode used for the shipment. Drives freight cost benchmarking, carrier selection analytics, and carbon footprint reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|parcel|rail|air|ocean|intermodal — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating node. Distinguishes supplier facilities from internal DC, MFC, store, or dark store nodes to support routing and receiving workflow logic.

attributes.name: source_system_code

products.name: node_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the assortment planning decision between inventory_node and item_hierarchy. It captures the strategic and operational decisions about which merchandise categories are carried at which locations, including space allocation, planogram assignments, and replenishment rules. Each record links one inventory_node to one item_hierarchy node with attributes that govern how that category is merchandised at that specific location.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, assortment planning is a core business process where each inventory node (store, DC, MFC) carries multiple merchandise categories, and each category is carried across multiple locations with location-specific merchandising rules. Store planners and category managers actively manage these node-category assortment decisions, allocating shelf space, assigning planograms, setting presentation quantities, and defining replenishment priorities that vary by location format, customer demographics, and regional preferences. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational planning entity that humans create, update, and monitor.

products.name: promo_stock_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between stock_position and promo_offer. It captures the allocation of specific SKU-location inventory to promotional campaigns, including promotional pricing, reserved quantities, display placement, and offer-specific timing. Each record links one stock position to one promotional offer with attributes that exist only in the context of this promotional inventory allocation.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, promotional inventory allocation is an active operational process where promotion managers assign specific SKU-location stock positions to promotional campaigns. A single stock position can participate in multiple concurrent promotional offers (e.g., a loyalty-exclusive discount stacked with a category-wide sale, or sequential promotions as inventory rolls from one campaign to another). Conversely, a single promotional offer applies to multiple stock positions across stores, DCs, and e-commerce fulfillment nodes. The business actively manages these allocations with relationship-specific data including promotional pricing, reserved quantities, display locations, and offer timing that varies by location.

products.name: assortment_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of a strategic assortment plan to a specific inventory node (store, DC, or fulfillment center). It captures the implementation status, compliance metrics, and timing of assortment execution at each location. Each record links one inventory_node to one assortment_plan with attributes that track how well the planned assortment is being executed at that specific location.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, assortment plans are deployed to multiple inventory nodes (stores, DCs, fulfillment centers), and each node carries multiple assortment plans across different categories and seasons. Merchandising teams actively manage these deployments by tracking compliance (planned vs actual SKU count), implementation status, and timing at each location-plan combination. This is a recognized operational relationship where the deployment itself has meaningful attributes that belong to neither the plan nor the node alone.

products.name: identity_link

Stores identifier type (loyalty card number, email hash, device ID, cookie ID, POS customer ID, Salesforce Contact ID, SAP customer number), identifier value, source system, link confidence score, link method (deterministic/probabilistic), and link creation timestamp. Enables omnichannel recognition across POS, e-commerce, and mobile. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

attributes.name: identity_link_id

attributes.name: match_rule_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: consent_status

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer provided or updated their consent for this identifier. Required for regulatory audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.0000 to 1.0000) representing the overall quality and reliability of this identifier based on completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness dimensions.

attributes.name: identifier_first_seen_date
attributes.description: The date when this specific identifier value was first observed in any source system. Used for recency analysis in RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: identifier_last_seen_date
attributes.description: The date when this identifier was most recently used in a transaction or interaction. Critical for identifying dormant identifiers. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: The category or type of identifier being linked. attributes.name: identifier_usage_count

attributes.name: identifier_value

attributes.name: is_primary_identifier
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary or preferred identifier for this customer. True if this is the main identifier used for customer recognition, False otherwise.

attributes.name: link_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating the certainty of the identity link. Deterministic matches typically score 1.0000, while probabilistic matches score lower based on matching algorithm confidence.

attributes.name: link_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identity link was first established in the MDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: link_effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this identity link is considered valid and active for customer recognition across channels. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: link_effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this identity link remains valid. Null indicates an open-ended link. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: link_method

attributes.name: link_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this identity link, typically used for manual review cases or to document special circumstances in the linking decision.

attributes.name: link_status

attributes.name: link_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: linked_by_user

attributes.name: match_attributes

attributes.name: merge_history_reference

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this identifier has been validated through external verification (e.g., email verification, phone verification). Validated identifiers have higher trust scores.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identifier was last validated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records every customer touchpoint, engagement event, and outbound communication across all Retail channels sourced from SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR) and the case management system. Stores interaction type (POS visit, website session, app open, call center contact, email send/open/click, SMS send/delivery, push notification, chat, clienteling visit, NPS survey response), direction (inbound/outbound), channel, store or digital property, timestamp, duration, outcome, NPS score (when applicable), associated campaign or promotion ID, delivery status and engagement metrics for outbound messages (delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/unsubscribed), and agent/associate ID. This is the single consolidated product for all customer communication and engagement history — foundation for omnichannel interaction timeline, communication audit trail, campaign response tracking, and CLTV modeling. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

attributes.name: channel

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: digital_property
attributes.description: The specific digital asset or platform where the interaction occurred (e.g., main website, mobile app, partner site, social media platform name). Applicable for digital interactions. Null for in-store interactions.

attributes.name: direction

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude

attributes.name: interaction_timestamp

attributes.name: interaction_type

products.description: Formal customer privacy rights requests submitted under GDPR (right to access, right to erasure, right to portability, right to rectification) and CCPA (right to know, right to delete, right to opt-out of sale). Stores request type, submission channel, submission timestamp, verification status, assigned processor, processing deadline (regulatory SLA), completion timestamp, outcome, and data categories affected. Managed in compliance with GDPR and CCPA as enforced by applicable regulatory bodies. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

attributes.name: privacy_request_id

attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who submitted the privacy request.

attributes.description: Outcome of the customer appeal: upheld (original decision maintained), overturned (request re-processed), pending (under review), withdrawn (customer cancelled appeal).

attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer submitted an appeal or complaint regarding the handling of this privacy request.

attributes.name: appeal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer submitted an appeal or complaint.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the privacy request was assigned to a processor.

attributes.description: Reference identifier to the detailed audit log entries tracking all system actions taken to fulfill this privacy request.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the privacy request was completed and the customer was notified.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this privacy request record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer was notified of the request outcome via email or other channel.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer was notified of the request outcome.

attributes.name: data_categories_affected
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of data categories affected by this request (e.g., profile, transaction_history, loyalty, marketing_preferences, location_data).

attributes.name: data_export_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the data export download link expires for security purposes.

attributes.name: data_export_format
attributes.description: File format used for data portability requests: JSON, CSV, PDF, XML. Applicable only for access and portability request types.

attributes.name: data_export_url
attributes.description: Secure download URL for the exported customer data package. Time-limited and encrypted. Applicable for access and portability requests.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Legal or business justification for denying the privacy request (e.g., legal obligation to retain data, manifestly unfounded request, excessive requests).

attributes.name: extension_granted_flag

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for granting a deadline extension (e.g., complex request, high volume, technical difficulties).

attributes.name: outcome

attributes.name: processing_deadline

attributes.name: processing_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments from the assigned processor documenting actions taken, challenges encountered, and decisions made during request processing.

attributes.name: records_anonymized_count
attributes.description: Number of database records anonymized (PII removed but record retained for analytics) to fulfill an erasure request.

attributes.name: records_deleted_count
attributes.description: Number of database records deleted across all systems to fulfill an erasure request.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary data protection regulation governing this request: GDPR (EU General Data Protection Regulation), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), LGPD (Brazil), PIPEDA (Canada), APPI (Japan), POPIA (South Africa).

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the privacy request, used for customer communication and tracking.

attributes.name: request_status

products.name: targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between customer segments and marketing campaigns. It captures the operational activation of specific customer segments within campaign execution, tracking targeting priority, budget allocation, reach metrics, and performance outcomes for each segment-campaign combination. Each record links one customer segment to one marketing campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this targeted activation.. Existence Justification: In retail marketing operations, campaigns routinely target multiple customer segments simultaneously (e.g., a seasonal promotion targeting VIP Gold, Geographic Region A, and High-Value Lapsed segments), and customer segments participate in multiple concurrent campaigns (e.g., VIP Gold segment is targeted by loyalty rewards campaign, seasonal sale, and category-specific promotion). The business actively manages segment targeting as an operational entity, allocating budget per segment, setting targeting priorities, and measuring segment-specific performance metrics (response rates, conversion rates, reach) for campaign optimization and ROI analysis. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

attributes.name: targeting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment-campaign targeting record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer segment being targeted in this campaign

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment was activated for targeting within the campaign. May differ from campaign start date if segments are activated in waves.

attributes.name: actual_reached_count
attributes.description: Actual number of customers from this segment who were successfully reached by campaign communications (emails delivered, ads served, SMS sent, etc.).

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the campaign budget allocated specifically to reaching this customer segment. Sum of all segment allocations should equal or be less than total campaign budget.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reached customers from this segment who completed the desired campaign conversion action (purchase, sign-up, etc.). Calculated as (converters / actual_reached_count) * 100.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this targeting record was created in the system. Audit field.

attributes.name: deactivation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment targeting was deactivated or completed. Null for currently active targeting.

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers from this segment expected to be reached by the campaign based on segment membership count and channel penetration rates.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this targeting record was last updated. Audit field.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this segment within the campaign's targeting strategy. Primary: main target audience; Secondary: secondary audience for expansion; Tertiary: opportunistic reach; Excluded: explicitly excluded from campaign.

attributes.name: response_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of reached customers from this segment who responded to the campaign (clicked, opened, visited store, etc.). Calculated as (responders / actual_reached_count) * 100.

attributes.name: targeting_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this segment targeting within the campaign. Planned: scheduled but not yet active; Active: currently being executed; Paused: temporarily suspended; Completed: execution finished; Cancelled: targeting cancelled before completion.

products.name: segment_banner_targeting
products.description: This association product represents the targeting relationship between customer segments and promotional banners in digital marketing campaigns. It captures campaign performance metrics specific to each segment-banner combination, enabling marketing attribution analysis, segment ROI measurement, and campaign optimization. Each record links one customer segment to one promotional banner with performance metrics and display scheduling that exist only in the context of this targeted marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail digital marketing operations, promotional banners are actively targeted to multiple customer segments simultaneously through campaign management systems (e.g., VIP Gold sees Banner A, Lapsed Customers see Banner B, but both segments may also see Banner C in different placements or time windows). Each segment-banner combination generates its own performance metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions, attributed revenue) that marketing teams use for attribution analysis, segment ROI measurement, and campaign optimization. This is an operational marketing execution relationship that humans actively configure, monitor, and optimize. Deployed to retail_mvm (MVM) and retail_mvm (ECM) as distinct schemas.

domains.name: order
domains.description: Manages omnichannel order lifecycle from cart creation through fulfillment including online orders, in-store POS transactions, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS, ship-from-store (SFS), and drop-ship orders. Tracks order headers, line items, payment methods, fulfillment status, delivery tracking, and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization). Integrates with OMS for end-to-end order orchestration.

products.name: header
products.description: Core master record for every omnichannel order. Captures order number, channel origin (web, app, call center, marketplace), order date/time, customer reference, fulfillment node reference (FK to store/distribution domain), order status, currency, locale, totals (subtotal, tax, discount, shipping, grand total), OMS reference ID, source system, and audit timestamps. SSOT for order identity and lifecycle. Carrier and fulfillment node masters are owned by peer domains and referenced via cross-domain FK.

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity returned by the customer after delivery. Supports partial returns and links to Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped to the customer. May differ from ordered_quantity due to partial fulfillment, substitutions, or inventory constraints.

attributes.name: sku

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a substitution for an out-of-stock product. True if a substitute product was provided instead of the originally ordered item.

attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction for this line item. Determines applicable tax rates based on ship-to location and product tax category.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. For example, 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: unit_retail_price

attributes.description: The unique transaction or message identifier from the source system that triggered this status change. Enables end-to-end traceability and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: primary_line_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who picked this line. Populated when status transitions to picked. Enables picker productivity and accuracy analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment container that this line is part of. Enables grouping of lines that shipped together and tracking of split shipments.

attributes.name: tertiary_line_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (customer service rep, warehouse manager, system admin) who manually triggered this status change, if applicable. Null for automated system transitions.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse picking wave that processed this line. Links status transitions to warehouse execution batches for operational analysis.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the line was delivered to the customer. Populated when status transitions to delivered. Used for on-time delivery SLA measurement.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: The shipping service level selected for this line (e.g., standard ground, 2-day air, overnight). Impacts delivery SLA and cost.

attributes.name: current_status
attributes.description: The new status that the order line transitioned TO at this event. Represents the current state of the line after this transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|returned|refunded — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: The carrier-provided or system-calculated estimated delivery date for this line. Updated as the line progresses through fulfillment stages.

attributes.name: exception_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the exception type when exception_flag is True. Enables aggregated exception reporting and trend analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inventory_shortage|customer_cancellation|quality_issue|carrier_delay|address_issue|payment_failure|system_error — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents an exception or deviation from normal fulfillment flow (e.g., cancellation, return, inventory shortage). True if exception, False if normal progression.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_type
attributes.description: The type of fulfillment location handling this line. Enables analysis of fulfillment performance by node type (e.g., ship-from-store vs DC).

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: The line item number within the parent order (e.g., line 1, line 2). Denormalized for quick identification without joining to order_line.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by users or systems to provide additional context about this status transition. Used for exception documentation and customer service reference.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status that the order line transitioned FROM. Enables reconstruction of the full status flow and identification of status reversals or exceptions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|returned|refunded — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity_affected
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU affected by this status transition. Supports partial fulfillment scenarios where a line is split across multiple shipments with different status progressions.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was inserted into the data platform. Distinct from status_transition_timestamp; used for data pipeline monitoring and late-arriving data detection.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture and data quality auditing.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The product SKU identifier for the line item. Denormalized to enable direct analysis of status transitions by product without joining to product master.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status transition occurred within the SLA target window. True if on-time or early, False if late. Critical for fulfillment performance KPIs.

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this status transition should have occurred per the order SLA. Used to calculate on-time performance at each fulfillment stage.

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining WHY the status transition occurred (e.g., CUST_CANCEL, INV_SHORTAGE, CARRIER_DELAY, QUALITY_ISSUE). Critical for root-cause analysis of fulfillment exceptions.

attributes.name: status_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the status transition reason. Provides additional context beyond the reason code for customer service and operations teams.

attributes.name: status_transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the order line transitioned to the current status. Business event timestamp for SLA measurement and fulfillment analytics.

attributes.name: system_source
attributes.description: The source system that generated this status transition event (e.g., OMS, WMS, TMS, carrier API). Enables data lineage tracking and system integration monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oms|wms|tms|pos|ecommerce|customer_service|carrier_api|manual — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number for this line shipment. Enables customer self-service tracking and last-mile visibility. Populated when status transitions to shipped.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity affected (e.g., each, case, pound). Denormalized from product master for direct interpretation of quantity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|pound|kilogram|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: pos_transaction
products.description: Point-of-Sale transaction record for in-store purchase events at registers. Captures POS terminal ID, register number, cashier/associate ID, store number, transaction date/time, transaction type (sale, return, exchange, void), total tender, tax, discount, loyalty card number, basket metrics (item count, UPT, ATV), and fiscal receipt number. SSOT for brick-and-mortar register transactions. Complements order_header for transactions originating at physical registers rather than digital order flow. Payment tenders linked via the payment product.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Transaction / NRF ARTS Transaction

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the POS transaction record. Primary key for in-store register transactions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: POS transactions must be allocated to cost centers for store-level P&L, department performance tracking, and internal management reporting. Required for daily sales accounting, variance analysis, and

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header for omnichannel transactions such as BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) pickups or ship-from-store fulfillments that originated as digital orders.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: POS transactions require direct membership link for real-time points posting, tier validation, member-only pricing, receipt balance printing, and daily loyalty reconciliation—critical in-store loyalty

attributes.name: original_transaction_pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original POS transaction being returned or exchanged when transaction_type is return or exchange.

attributes.name: pci_assessment_id

attributes.name: pos_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: pos_store_location_id
attributes.description: FK to store.store_location.store_location_id — POS transaction to store location is required for all store-level sales reporting, comparable sales calculations, and store P&L. Every retail operational report needs this join.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the POS terminal device used to process the transaction.

attributes.name: primary_pos_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store associate or cashier who processed the transaction.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who made the purchase. Populated when loyalty card is scanned or customer account is identified.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Every POS transaction requires profit center assignment for segment reporting, store profitability analysis, financial consolidation, and management reporting. Fundamental requirement for retail finan

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: Retail business day to which this transaction is attributed for financial reporting. May differ from transaction timestamp for transactions after store closing but before end-of-day processing.

attributes.name: change_amount
attributes.description: Cash change returned to the customer when tender_amount exceeds total_amount.

attributes.name: coupon_count
attributes.description: Number of coupons redeemed in the transaction including manufacturer coupons and store coupons.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction monetary amounts.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction including promotional discounts, coupons, markdowns, and employee discounts.

attributes.name: fiscal_receipt_number
attributes.description: Government-mandated fiscal receipt identifier for tax compliance and audit purposes. Required in jurisdictions with fiscal receipt regulations.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Fulfillment method for the transaction distinguishing between traditional in-store purchases and omnichannel fulfillment scenarios.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items in the transaction basket. Used for basket analysis and UPT (Units Per Transaction) calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POS transaction record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Loyalty program card number scanned during the transaction for points accrual and customer identification.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for this transaction based on purchase amount and promotional multipliers.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer during this transaction for discounts or rewards.

attributes.name: manager_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manager override was required during the transaction for actions such as large discounts, voids, or policy exceptions.

attributes.name: payment_method_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct payment methods used in the transaction. Supports split-tender analysis.

attributes.name: primary_payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for the transaction. For split-tender transactions, this is the method with the largest payment amount. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|mobile_payment|check|store_credit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotion_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct promotions applied to the transaction. Used for promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: receipt_email
attributes.description: Email address provided by the customer for digital receipt delivery.

attributes.name: receipt_phone
attributes.description: Phone number provided by the customer for SMS receipt delivery or order pickup notifications.

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: Physical register or checkout lane number within the store where the transaction was processed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for return when transaction_type is return. Used for return analytics and product quality monitoring.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, fees, and discounts are applied.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged on the transaction based on applicable tax jurisdiction and product tax categories.

attributes.name: tender_amount
attributes.description: Total amount tendered by the customer across all payment methods. May exceed total_amount when cash change is given.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount tendered by the customer including all items, taxes, fees, and after all discounts. Represents the net transaction value and ATV (Average Transaction Value).

attributes.name: total_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all items purchased in the transaction, summed across all line items. May differ from item_count when multiple units of the same SKU are purchased.

attributes.name: training_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed in training mode for new cashier onboarding. Training transactions are excluded from financial reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable transaction number printed on the customer receipt. Externally visible identifier for customer service and returns processing.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POS transaction indicating whether it was completed, voided, suspended for later completion, or refunded.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was completed at the register. Primary business event timestamp for sales analytics and footfall analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of POS transaction distinguishing between sales, returns, exchanges, voids, and no-sale register opens.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding the transaction when transaction_status is voided. Used for fraud detection and operational quality monitoring.

products.name: pos_transaction_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a POS transaction. Captures SKU, UPC, EAN, GTIN, item description, quantity sold, unit retail price, extended price, markdown amount, promotion code applied, tax code, tax amount, return reason (if applicable), serial number (for electronics), and weight (for variable-weight items). Supports basket analysis and sell-through rate calculations.
products.reference: SAP CAR POS Line Item / NRF ARTS LineItem

attributes.name: pos_transaction_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Transaction Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual line item within a POS transaction. Primary key for the transaction line detail record.

tag_set.value: Point of Sale (POS) Transaction Line ID

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who processed this transaction line. Used for cashier performance tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Line-level cost center tracking enables department-specific performance measurement within store transactions, supports mixed-department basket analysis, and provides granular data for departmental P&

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent POS transaction header. Links this line item to the overall transaction.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Line-level profit center allocation supports accurate segment reporting for mixed-department transactions, enables product category profitability analysis, and is required for financial consolidation

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the master product record. Links to product information management system for detailed product attributes.

attributes.name: sku_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.sku_price. Business justification: POS lines record actual selling prices at point of sale. Linking to sku_price enables real-time price verification, override detection, shrinkage analysis from pricing discrepancies, and margin tracki

attributes.name: stock_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_ledger. Business justification: Each POS line item generates a stock ledger transaction recording the inventory movement at SKU level. Required for item-level inventory accounting, variance analysis, and reconciling physical sales t

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier or vendor who provided this product. Used for vendor performance analysis and chargebacks.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Product category or subcategory code within the department. Supports assortment planning and basket analysis.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Unit cost of the product at the time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis. Business confidential.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Manufacturer or store coupon code applied to this line item. Used for coupon redemption tracking and vendor chargebacks.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trails.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Retail department or category code for this product. Used for departmental sales reporting and category management.

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number for international product identification. Used for global product tracking and cross-border commerce.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this line item calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price before discounts. Gross line amount before markdown.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Method by which this line item was fulfilled. Supports omnichannel order orchestration and fulfillment analytics.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies trade items worldwide. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on product type.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product as it appears on the receipt. Includes brand, product name, size, and variant details.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the transaction. Determines the order in which items were scanned or entered at the point of sale.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned for this line item purchase. Used for customer loyalty program management and engagement.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed to discount this line item. Reduces the net amount paid by the customer.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, coupons, and price reductions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_line_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this line item after markdown but before tax. Calculated as extended price minus markdown amount.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is a store brand or private label item. True for private label, false for national brands.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional campaign code applied to this line item. Links to promotion management system for campaign tracking and analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold for this line item. Supports fractional quantities for variable-weight items such as produce and deli products.

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents a product return. True for returned items, false for normal sales.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for product return. Used for return analytics and quality management.

attributes.name: scanned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this item was scanned or entered at the point of sale. Used for transaction timing analysis and basket sequence.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized products such as electronics and appliances. Used for warranty tracking and theft prevention.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit identifier for the product sold. Used for inventory tracking and assortment management.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged for this line item. Calculated by applying the tax rate to the net line amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and category code for this line item. Determines applicable sales tax rate based on product category and location.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Sales tax rate applied to this line item expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0825 represents 8.25 percent sales tax.

attributes.name: total_line_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including tax. Sum of net line amount and tax amount.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity sold. Indicates whether the item is sold by each, weight, or bulk packaging. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|kg|oz|g|case|pack|box — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Regular retail price per unit before any discounts or promotions. Represents the shelf price or list price of the item.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code scanned at point of sale. Standard barcode identifier for North American retail products.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for voiding this line item. Used for shrinkage analysis and operational improvement.

attributes.name: voided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided or cancelled during the transaction. True for voided items, false for completed sales.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight of variable-weight items measured at point of sale. Captured for produce, deli, meat, and bakery items sold by weight.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual weight. Indicates whether weight is measured in pounds, kilograms, ounces, or grams.

products.name: payment
products.description: Payment tender record capturing each payment instrument applied to an order or POS transaction. Stores payment method type (credit card, debit, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL, cash, digital wallet), masked PAN/token, payment processor reference, authorization code, settlement status (authorized, captured, settled, declined, voided), payment amount, currency, tender sequence for split-tender scenarios, PCI DSS tokenization reference, fraud score, and 3DS authentication result. Supports split-tender where multiple payment methods cover a single order total. Integrates with PCI SSC compliance requirements and payment gateway APIs.
products.reference: OMS Payment / PCI DSS Payment Record

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment tender record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Retail associates process payments at POS terminals and customer service desks. Tracking which associate processed each payment enables cash drawer reconciliation, fraud investigation, refund authoriz

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Payment settlement requires linking to specific bank accounts for cash management, daily reconciliation, treasury operations, and bank statement matching. Essential for payment processing, fraud detec

attributes.name: bnpl_installment_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) Installment Plan ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BNPL installment plan associated with this payment. Used for tracking payment schedules and reconciliation with BNPL provider.

tag_set.value: BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) Installment Plan ID

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized gift card number used for this payment tender. Applicable only when payment method type is gift card.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order or POS (Point of Sale) transaction to which this payment tender is applied. Links payment to the originating order header.

attributes.name: pci_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.pci_assessment. Business justification: Payment processing is core PCI scope. QSAs sample payment records during assessments to validate requirement compliance (encryption at rest/transit, tokenization, key management). Links payments to as

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount applied by this payment tender toward the order total. In split-tender scenarios, multiple payment records sum to the order total.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor or issuing bank confirming approval of the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was authorized by the payment processor or issuing bank. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this payment tender.

attributes.name: avs_result_code
attributes.description: Result code returned by Address Verification Service (AVS) indicating match status of billing address and postal code. Used for fraud prevention and risk assessment.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for AVS (Address Verification Service).

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and international payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Critical for AVS (Address Verification Service) validation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address. Used for AVS (Address Verification Service) and tax calculation.

attributes.name: bnpl_provider
attributes.description: Free text; common values include klarna, affirm, afterpay, sezzle, etc.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the authorized payment was captured (funds marked for settlement). Typically occurs at order fulfillment or shipment.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Free text; common values include visa, mastercard, amex, discover, jcb, unionpay, maestro, diners, rupay, regional/store cards

attributes.name: card_expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: card_expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit format, e.g., 2025). Used for validation and recurring payment processing. Stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for verification and fraud prevention. Stored securely per PCI DSS and GDPR requirements.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinguishes web, mobile app, in-store POS (Point of Sale), call center, kiosk, or third-party platform.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Supports multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: cvv_result_code
attributes.description: Result code indicating whether the Card Verification Value (CVV/CVV2/CVC) provided by the cardholder matched the issuer's records. Used for fraud prevention.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_type
attributes.description: Free text; common values include apple_pay, google_pay, paypal, samsung_pay, etc.

attributes.name: fraud_decision
attributes.description: Decision outcome from fraud detection system. Indicates whether the payment was approved, declined, flagged for manual review, or challenged with additional authentication.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically ranging from 0 (low risk) to 100 (high risk). Used for payment approval decisions and risk management.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed as payment for this tender. Applicable only when payment method type is loyalty points.

attributes.name: masked_pan
attributes.description: Masked or truncated version of the payment card Primary Account Number (PAN), typically showing only the last four digits (e.g., ****1234). Used for display and customer service without exposing full card number.

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument used for this tender. Includes credit card, debit card, gift card, loyalty points, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), cash, digital wallet (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay), or check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|gift_card|loyalty_points|bnpl|cash|digital_wallet|check — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment tender. Tracks progression from authorization through settlement, including declined, voided, or refunded states.

attributes.name: processor_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor. Used for tracing and reconciliation with external payment systems.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount refunded to the customer for this payment tender. May be partial or full refund of the original payment amount.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a refund was processed for this payment tender. Applicable for returns and RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) scenarios.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was settled and funds were transferred from the customer's account to the merchant's account. Final step in payment lifecycle.

attributes.name: tender_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number indicating the order in which this payment tender was applied in a split-tender scenario. First tender is 1, second is 2, etc.

attributes.name: three_ds_authentication_result

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: Version of the 3-D Secure protocol used for authentication (e.g., 1.0.2, 2.1.0, 2.2.0). Newer versions provide enhanced security and user experience.

attributes.name: token

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: void_timestamp

attributes.name: location_id
