attributes.name: hour_of_day
attributes.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when the measurement was taken. Enables intraday footfall pattern analysis and peak-hour identification for workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: inbound_count
attributes.description: Number of customers or individuals entering the counting zone during the measurement interval. Core footfall metric for traffic volume analysis.

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the measurement occurred on a recognized retail holiday or peak shopping day (e.g., Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve). Holidays significantly impact footfall patterns.

attributes.name: is_promotional_event
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a store-level promotional event or special sale was active during the measurement period. Used to isolate promotional lift in footfall analysis.

attributes.name: is_store_open
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the store was open for business during the measurement interval. Distinguishes operational footfall from after-hours activity (e.g., restocking, maintenance).

attributes.name: measurement_interval_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the measurement interval in minutes (e.g., 15, 60, 1440 for daily). Defines the time window over which traffic counts were aggregated.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the traffic count measurement was captured by the sensor system. Represents the business event time of the footfall observation.

attributes.name: net_occupancy_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers present in the zone at the end of the measurement interval, calculated as cumulative inbound minus outbound. Used for real-time capacity management and safety compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes or anomalies related to the measurement (e.g., sensor malfunction, store event, construction activity). Provides context for data quality issues or unusual patterns.

attributes.name: outbound_count
attributes.description: Number of customers or individuals exiting the counting zone during the measurement interval. Used to calculate net occupancy and dwell time.

attributes.name: peak_occupancy
attributes.description: Maximum number of customers simultaneously present in the zone during the measurement interval. Used for capacity planning, safety compliance, and staffing optimization.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the people-counting sensor or camera system that captured the measurement. Used for device performance tracking and data quality auditing.

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Technology type of the counting sensor (e.g., thermal imaging, video analytics with AI, infrared beam, RFID, WiFi tracking, Bluetooth beacon). Impacts measurement accuracy and privacy considerations.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Outdoor temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of measurement. Used for weather-adjusted footfall modeling and seasonal trend analysis.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of POS transactions completed during the measurement interval in the counting zone. Used to calculate conversion rate and sales per visitor metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this traffic count record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and data quality auditing.

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time of measurement. Footfall is highly correlated with weather; this attribute enables weather-adjusted traffic forecasting and comp sales analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|fog|storm|extreme_heat|extreme_cold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counting zone by functional area type. Used to segment footfall analysis by store area category.

products.name: comparable_sales
products.description: Periodic comparable store sales (SSS — Same-Store Sales) record tracking revenue performance of stores that have been open for a qualifying period (typically 13+ months). Captures store location, reporting period (week, month, quarter), total net sales, prior-period net sales, comp sales variance ($ and %), comp sales growth rate (%), transaction count, ATV (Average Transaction Value), UPT (Units Per Transaction), and comp store qualification status. This is the primary store-level financial performance signal used by finance, merchandising, and executive reporting.

attributes.name: comparable_sales_id
attributes.description: Primary key for comparable_sales

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Comp sales analysis by campaign measures promotional lift and marketing ROI. Retail finance and marketing teams require campaign attribution for sales variance analysis, budget justification, and prom

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Comp sales reporting requires alignment to fiscal periods for year-over-year variance analysis, investor reporting, and same-store sales metrics—standard retail financial reporting process tied to fis

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Comparable sales records currently denormalize store_format as a STRING. Adding FK to store_format product allows joining to get format_code, format_name, format_description, format_type, size_band_mi

attributes.name: kpi_value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_value. Business justification: Comp sales is a primary retail KPI; each comparable_sales record represents a kpi_value instance for comp_sales_growth_rate KPI. Direct semantic relationship for investor reporting and operational per

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location for which comparable sales are being reported. Links to the store master record.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Comparable sales analysis isolates promotional campaign impact—finance and merchandising teams attribute sales lifts and traffic increases to specific campaigns. Comp sales reporting by campaign enabl

attributes.name: closure_days
attributes.description: Number of days the store was closed during the reporting period. Used to adjust comp sales calculations for partial-period operations.

attributes.name: closure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the store was temporarily closed for any portion of the reporting period (e.g., due to weather, emergency, renovation). Impacts comp sales qualification and interpretation.

attributes.name: comp_sales_growth_rate
attributes.description: The year-over-year growth rate of comparable store sales expressed as a percentage. Synonymous with comp_sales_variance_percent but emphasizes growth perspective. Key performance indicator for executive reporting.

attributes.name: comp_sales_variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute dollar variance between current period net sales and prior period net sales. Calculated as current_period_net_sales minus prior_period_net_sales.

attributes.name: comp_sales_variance_percent
attributes.description: The percentage variance between current period net sales and prior period net sales. Calculated as ((current_period_net_sales - prior_period_net_sales) / prior_period_net_sales) * 100. Primary metric for store performance evaluation.

attributes.name: comp_store_qualification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store qualifies for inclusion in comparable sales (SSS - Same-Store Sales) reporting for this period. Typically requires the store to have been open for a minimum qualifying period (e.g., 13+ months) and not have undergone significant remodeling or format changes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent currency interpretation for multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: current_period_atv
attributes.description: Average Transaction Value (ATV) for the current reporting period. Calculated as current_period_net_sales divided by current_period_transaction_count. Measures the average dollar amount spent per transaction.

attributes.name: current_period_conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion Rate (CR) for the current reporting period. Calculated as (current_period_transaction_count / current_period_footfall) * 100. Measures the percentage of store visitors who complete a purchase.

attributes.name: current_period_footfall
attributes.description: Total number of customer visits (store traffic count) during the current reporting period. Measured via traffic counters at store entrances. Used to calculate conversion rate.

attributes.name: current_period_net_sales
attributes.description: Total net sales revenue for the store during the current reporting period, after returns, discounts, and allowances. Represents the actual sales performance for the period.

attributes.name: current_period_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of completed Point of Sale (POS) transactions at the store during the current reporting period. Used to calculate Average Transaction Value (ATV).

attributes.name: current_period_units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of product units (SKUs) sold at the store during the current reporting period. Used to calculate Units Per Transaction (UPT).

attributes.name: current_period_upt
attributes.description: Units Per Transaction (UPT) for the current reporting period. Calculated as current_period_units_sold divided by current_period_transaction_count. Measures the average number of items purchased per transaction.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this comparable sales record was extracted (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, Oracle Retail Merchandising System, SAP Customer Activity Repository). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (e.g., 1-12 for months, 1-4 for quarters) to which this comparable sales record belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this comparable sales record belongs, used for financial planning and reporting alignment.

attributes.name: months_in_operation
attributes.description: The number of complete months the store has been in operation as of the end of the current reporting period. Used to determine comp store qualification (typically 13+ months required).

attributes.name: prior_period_atv
attributes.description: Average Transaction Value (ATV) for the comparable prior period. Used as baseline for ATV performance comparison.

attributes.name: prior_period_conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion Rate (CR) for the comparable prior period. Used as baseline for conversion rate performance comparison.

attributes.name: prior_period_footfall
attributes.description: Total number of customer visits (store traffic count) during the comparable prior period. Used for year-over-year footfall comparison.

attributes.name: prior_period_net_sales
attributes.description: Total net sales revenue for the store during the comparable prior period (same period in the previous year), after returns, discounts, and allowances. Used as the baseline for comp sales calculation.

attributes.name: prior_period_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of completed Point of Sale (POS) transactions at the store during the comparable prior period. Used for year-over-year transaction count comparison.

attributes.name: prior_period_units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of product units (SKUs) sold at the store during the comparable prior period. Used for year-over-year unit sales comparison.

attributes.name: prior_period_upt
attributes.description: Units Per Transaction (UPT) for the comparable prior period. Used as baseline for UPT performance comparison.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this comparable sales record was first created in the system. Follows yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this comparable sales record was last modified in the system. Follows yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: remodel_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the store underwent significant remodeling or format change during or immediately prior to the reporting period. Stores with recent remodels may be excluded from comp sales calculations.

attributes.name: reporting_district
attributes.description: The district or sub-region to which this store belongs within the reporting region. Used for district-level comp sales aggregation and performance management.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period for which comparable sales are being measured. Follows yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the reporting period for which comparable sales are being measured. Follows yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: The granularity of the reporting period for this comparable sales record (week, month, quarter, or year).

attributes.name: reporting_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or market to which this store belongs for reporting purposes (e.g., Northeast, Southwest, EMEA, APAC). Used for regional comp sales aggregation and analysis.

attributes.name: sales_per_sqft
attributes.description: Current period net sales divided by store size in square feet. Key productivity metric measuring revenue efficiency per unit of retail space.

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: Business-facing store number or code used for operational identification and reporting. Human-readable identifier for the store.

attributes.name: store_open_date
attributes.description: The date the store first opened for business. Used to determine eligibility for comparable sales reporting based on minimum operating period requirements.

attributes.name: store_size_sqft
attributes.description: The total retail floor space of the store in square feet. Used for sales per square foot analysis and store productivity metrics.

products.name: pl
products.description: Store-level Profit & Loss (P&L) record capturing periodic financial performance for each retail location. Records store location, fiscal period (week/month/quarter/year), net sales, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), gross margin, gross margin %, shrinkage expense, occupancy cost (rent, CAM, utilities), labor cost, supply expense, total operating expense, EBITDA contribution, and P&L status (preliminary, final, restated). Owned by the store domain as the operational P&L; the finance domain owns the consolidated GL. Enables GMROI analysis and store-level profitability benchmarking.

attributes.name: pl_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store-level profit and loss record. Primary key for the store P&L data product.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fiscal period (week, month, quarter, or year) to which this P&L record applies.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail location (hypermarket, department store, discount outlet, dark store, or micro-fulfillment center) for which this P&L record is reported.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Store P&L attributes promotional costs and revenue to campaigns—finance teams allocate promotional discounts, vendor funding, and incremental labor to specific campaigns. Store-level P&L by campaign e

attributes.name: atv_amount
attributes.description: Average dollar value per transaction, calculated as net sales divided by transaction count. Key metric for store performance and basket analysis.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of merchandise sold at the store during the period, including product cost, inbound freight, and direct product costs. Used to calculate gross margin.

attributes.name: comp_sales_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store qualifies for comparable store sales (SSS - Same-Store Sales) analysis for the period. Typically true if the store has been open for at least 12 months.

attributes.name: comp_sales_growth_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) Growth Percent
attributes.description: Year-over-year percentage change in net sales for this store during the period, used for same-store sales (SSS) performance tracking.

tag_set.value: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) Growth Percent

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this store P&L record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this P&L record are denominated.

attributes.name: depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Depreciation expense for store fixtures, equipment, POS terminals, gondolas, and other fixed assets allocated to the store for the period.

attributes.name: discounts_amount
attributes.description: Total value of markdowns, promotional discounts, and price reductions applied to merchandise sales during the period.

attributes.name: ebitda_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount
attributes.description: Store contribution to enterprise EBITDA, calculated as gross margin minus operating expenses (excluding depreciation). Key metric for store-level profitability and GMROI analysis.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount

attributes.name: ebitda_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) Percent
attributes.description: EBITDA as a percentage of net sales. Used for store performance benchmarking and profitability comparison across locations.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) Percent

attributes.name: finalized_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this store P&L record was marked as final and locked for audit purposes. Null if still preliminary.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Net sales minus COGS. Represents the profit available to cover operating expenses and contribute to EBITDA.

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales. Key profitability metric used for store performance benchmarking and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: gross_sales_amount
attributes.description: Total merchandise sales at the store before deducting returns, allowances, and discounts. Used to calculate return rates and discount penetration.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total store labor expenses including wages, salaries, benefits, payroll taxes, and overtime for store associates and management during the period.

attributes.name: marketing_expense_amount
attributes.description: Store-level marketing and advertising expenses including local promotions, signage, endcap displays, and community engagement costs for the period.

attributes.name: net_sales_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue from merchandise sales at the store during the period, net of returns, allowances, and discounts. Represents the top line of the store P&L.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments explaining unusual variances, one-time adjustments, restatement reasons, or other contextual information for this P&L record.

attributes.name: occupancy_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total store occupancy expenses including rent, common area maintenance (CAM) charges, property taxes, utilities, and facility maintenance costs for the period.

attributes.name: other_operating_expense_amount
attributes.description: Miscellaneous operating expenses not classified in other categories, including bank fees, credit card processing fees, security services, and other store-level costs.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this P&L record.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this P&L record.

attributes.name: pl_status
attributes.description: Current status of the P&L record indicating whether the figures are preliminary estimates, final audited values, or restated corrections.

attributes.name: reporting_entity
attributes.description: Legal entity or business unit responsible for this store P&L record, used for consolidated financial reporting and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: returns_amount
attributes.description: Total value of merchandise returned by customers during the period. Subtracted from gross sales to arrive at net sales.

attributes.name: shrinkage_amount
attributes.description: Total inventory loss due to theft, damage, spoilage, or administrative errors during the period. Recorded as an operating expense.

attributes.name: supply_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of store supplies including bags, packaging materials, cleaning supplies, POS consumables, and other operational supplies consumed during the period.

attributes.name: total_operating_expense_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all operating expenses including shrinkage, occupancy, labor, supplies, marketing, depreciation, and other operating costs for the period.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of POS transactions completed at the store during the period. Used to calculate average transaction value (ATV) and units per transaction (UPT).

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of merchandise units (SKUs) sold at the store during the period. Used to calculate units per transaction (UPT) and sell-through rates.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this store P&L record was last modified, including status changes or restatements.

attributes.name: upt
attributes.description: Average number of units sold per transaction, calculated as units sold divided by transaction count. Indicates basket size and cross-selling effectiveness.

products.name: shrinkage_event
products.description: Operational record of an identified inventory shrinkage event at a store location. Captures event date, store location, department/zone, shrinkage type (shoplifting/external theft, internal theft, administrative error, vendor fraud, damage), SKU(s) involved, quantity lost, estimated retail value lost, detection method (POS exception, cycle count, RFID, LP investigation), case reference number, resolution status, and recovery amount. Shrinkage is a critical retail KPI directly impacting store P&L and inventory accuracy. Supports LP (Loss Prevention) operations and CPSC/FTC compliance reporting.

attributes.name: shrinkage_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shrinkage event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inventory adjustment transaction in the WMS or ERP system that recorded the shrinkage loss. Links to the inventory adjustment ledger.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_department. Business justification: Shrinkage events (theft, damage, spoilage) occur in specific departments within a store. The shrinkage_event record currently denormalizes department_code as a STRING. Adding FK to store_department al

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Shrinkage losses post to specific GL accounts (inventory shrink expense, theft loss) for financial statement impact and COGS accuracy—required for inventory valuation and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail location where the shrinkage event occurred. Links to the store master record.

attributes.name: primary_shrinkage_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee involved in or responsible for the shrinkage event (for internal theft or administrative error cases). Confidential and used only for internal investigations.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotional periods see elevated shrinkage due to high traffic, promotional displays, and temporary merchandising—loss prevention teams track shrinkage by campaign. AP and operations teams analyze cam

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to returns.rma. Business justification: Shrinkage events frequently originate from fraudulent returns (empty box returns, receipt fraud, wardrobing, return of stolen merchandise). LP teams link shrinkage events to specific RMAs for loss att

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier involved in the shrinkage event (for vendor fraud or DSD - Direct Store Delivery discrepancies).

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the associated Loss Prevention investigation case, if one was opened. May link to external case management systems.

attributes.name: cost_value_lost
attributes.description: The total cost value (COGS - Cost of Goods Sold) of inventory lost in this shrinkage event. Used for financial accounting and inventory valuation adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shrinkage event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: The method or process by which the shrinkage event was identified: POS (Point of Sale) exception report, cycle count, physical inventory, RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) scan, LP (Loss Prevention) investigation, or vendor audit.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shrinkage event was identified or occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the shrinkage event, used for tracking and case management (e.g., SHR-0000012345).

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the shrinkage event was detected or recorded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (quarter or month) in which the shrinkage event occurred, used for financial reporting and P&L impact analysis (e.g., 2024-Q2 or 2024-06).

attributes.name: incident_report_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal incident report was filed with Loss Prevention or law enforcement for this shrinkage event.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory adjustment for this shrinkage event has been posted to the inventory ledger and financial systems (WMS - Warehouse Management System and ERP).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shrinkage event record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, investigation findings, or details about the shrinkage event. May include Loss Prevention officer observations or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: police_report_number
attributes.description: Law enforcement report number if the shrinkage event involved external theft and was reported to police.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product(s) involved in the shrinkage event.

attributes.name: quantity_lost
attributes.description: The quantity of units lost in the shrinkage event. May include fractional units for weight-based or bulk items.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value recovered from the shrinkage event through restitution, insurance claims, vendor credits, or merchandise recovery. Null or zero if no recovery occurred.

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: The method by which value was recovered: merchandise physically recovered, restitution from perpetrator, insurance claim payout, vendor credit (RTV - Return to Vendor), chargeback to vendor, or none.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shrinkage event case was resolved or closed. Null if still open or under investigation.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the shrinkage event case: open (newly identified), under investigation, resolved (cause identified and addressed), closed unresolved, or recovered (merchandise or value recovered).

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party responsible for the shrinkage: external (customer/shoplifter), employee (internal theft), vendor (fraud/error), unknown, or not applicable (e.g., damage, administrative error).

attributes.name: shrinkage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of the shrinkage event: external theft (shoplifting), internal theft (employee), administrative error (paperwork/system), vendor fraud, damage (spoilage/breakage), or unknown.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit identifier of the primary product involved in the shrinkage event. For multi-SKU events, this represents the primary or highest-value item.

attributes.name: total_retail_value_lost
attributes.description: The total estimated retail value of inventory lost in this shrinkage event (quantity_lost × unit_retail_value). Directly impacts store P&L (Profit and Loss).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity lost (e.g., each, case, pound, kilogram, liter, gallon).

attributes.name: unit_retail_value
attributes.description: The retail price per unit of the product at the time of the shrinkage event. Used to calculate total estimated loss.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode of the product involved in the shrinkage event.

attributes.name: zone_location
attributes.description: Specific zone, aisle, or area within the store where the shrinkage event was detected (e.g., Aisle 12, Backroom, Checkout Lane 5).

products.name: department

Departments are the fundamental unit for planogram assignment, inventory allocation, staffing schedules, shrinkage attribution, and P&L sub-reporting within a store. attributes.description: Timestamp when the department record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment

attributes.name: urbanization_level
attributes.description: Population density classification for stores in this cluster. Urban stores serve high-density city centers; suburban stores serve residential areas; rural stores serve low-density regions; exurban stores serve outer suburban fringe areas.

The fulfillment domain owns execution (pick/pack/ship); this product owns the node capability and capacity definition.

products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between store clusters and store locations. It captures the assignment of individual stores to logical clusters used for localized assortment planning, zone pricing, promotional targeting, and operational benchmarking. Each record links one store cluster to one store location with effective dates, primary cluster designation, assignment reason, and status that exist only in the context of this relationship.
