[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this negotiation record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Negotiated lead time in days from purchase order placement to goods receipt at distribution center. Critical for inventory planning and weeks of supply calculations.

attributes.name: markdown_support_amount
attributes.description: Specific amount committed by the supplier to support markdown or clearance activities. Critical for margin protection and sell-through rate optimization.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier per purchase order. Critical constraint for OTB planning and replenishment strategy.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MOQ field (e.g., each, case, pallet). Ensures correct interpretation of MOQ constraints.

tag_set.value: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure

attributes.name: negotiation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the negotiation was concluded, either through agreement, rejection, or cancellation. Nullable for ongoing negotiations.

attributes.name: negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing key discussion points, special conditions, or context from the negotiation. Supports knowledge transfer and future negotiations.

attributes.name: negotiation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the vendor negotiation event, typically formatted as VN-YYYYMMDD or similar pattern used in Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS).

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the negotiation discussions formally commenced. Represents the beginning of the negotiation lifecycle.

attributes.name: negotiation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the negotiation event. Tracks progression from draft through approval to execution or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|pending_approval|approved|rejected|executed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: negotiation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the negotiation event indicating the primary purpose: initial contract establishment, contract renewal, cost change request, markdown support negotiation, promotional allowance, or annual review.

attributes.name: new_cost_price
attributes.description: Newly negotiated cost price per unit effective from the effective_date. Single source of truth for supplier commercial terms. Stored in base currency.

attributes.name: old_cost_price
attributes.description: Previous cost price per unit before the negotiation. Used to calculate cost change impact and COGS variance. Stored in base currency.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms with the supplier, typically expressed as Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30, etc. Impacts cash flow and working capital management.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this negotiation record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.

products.name: markdown_event
products.description: Record of a planned or executed markdown decision capturing affected SKUs or category, store cluster scope, markdown type (permanent, temporary/POS), markdown percentage or new price point, effective and end dates, markdown reason (seasonal clearance, slow seller, competitive response, end-of-life, damaged), projected sell-through lift, actual sell-through result, and approval status. Represents the merchandising team's margin sacrifice decision distinct from pricing domain execution rules. Links to vendor markdown support agreements captured in vendor negotiations.

attributes.name: markdown_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the markdown event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Markdown events are frequently coordinated with marketing campaigns (clearance sales, seasonal promotions, flash sales). Retail operations track which campaign drove the markdown to measure promotiona

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category affected by this markdown event when the markdown applies to an entire category rather than individual SKUs. Supports category-level clearance and promotional strategies.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store cluster or group to which this markdown applies. Enables regional or performance-based markdown strategies. Null indicates enterprise-wide markdown.

attributes.name: compliance_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Markdowns triggered by compliance issues (expired food, product recalls, mislabeled goods, safety violations) reference the originating audit finding for financial reconciliation and root cause analys

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Markdowns may be allocated to cost centers for promotional expense tracking and marketing budget management. Required when markdown events are funded by specific promotional budgets or departments.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise department affected by this markdown event when the markdown applies at department level. Enables department-wide pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effectiveness_kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Markdown events measure effectiveness via KPIs (sell-through lift, revenue impact, margin impact). Markdown analysis reports reference KPI definitions for standardized metrics. Pricing teams use KPI-d

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Markdowns post to specific GL accounts (markdown expense, promotional allowance, inventory write-down) for P&L impact. Required for markdown accounting, gross margin reporting, and financial statement

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Linked pricing markdown

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Markdown events execute in specific price zones for regional clearance strategies. Geographic zones have different clearance timing needs based on climate, competitive intensity, and inventory positio

attributes.name: primary_markdown_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandising manager, buyer, or finance approver who authorized this markdown event. Null for markdowns not requiring approval or still pending approval. Critical for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Markdowns are tracked by profit center (store cluster, channel, region) for margin impact analysis and promotional effectiveness. Essential for channel/region markdown P&L reporting and performance ev

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Markdowns are often coordinated with promotional campaigns (clearance events, seasonal transitions). Merchandising and promotion teams collaborate on timing, depth, and marketing support. Essential fo

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific SKU affected by this markdown event. Links to product master data. Null when markdown applies to category or department level.

attributes.name: tertiary_markdown_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this markdown event record. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Null if record has never been modified after creation.

attributes.name: vendor_allowance_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to vendor markdown support or co-op agreement where the supplier shares markdown cost burden. Null when markdown is fully retailer-funded. Critical for vendor chargeback and Return to Vendor (RTV) processing.

attributes.name: actual_margin_impact
attributes.description: Realized gross margin dollar impact of the markdown event, calculated from actual sales and COGS data. Used for post-markdown profitability analysis and GMROI performance measurement. Null until markdown period completes.

attributes.name: actual_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Realized total revenue impact of the markdown event, calculated from actual sales data. Used for post-markdown financial analysis and Return on Investment (ROI) measurement. Null until markdown period completes.

attributes.name: actual_sell_through_lift_percentage
attributes.description: Realized increase in sell-through rate after the markdown was executed, expressed as a percentage. Measured post-markdown for effectiveness analysis and future markdown planning. Null until markdown period completes.

attributes.name: actual_units_sold
attributes.description: Realized quantity of units sold during the markdown period. Captured from Point of Sale (POS) transaction data for markdown effectiveness measurement. Null until markdown period completes.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this markdown event requires formal approval based on markdown amount thresholds, markdown percentage limits, or organizational authorization policies. True requires approval workflow; false allows auto-execution.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the markdown event was formally approved. Null for markdowns not requiring approval or still pending. Used for approval cycle time analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and markdown planning lead time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this markdown event (original_price, markdown_price, markdown_amount). Supports multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the markdown pricing becomes active and applicable to transactions. Aligns with Point of Sale (POS) system pricing updates and promotional calendar.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the markdown pricing expires and reverts to standard or new pricing. Null for permanent markdowns. Critical for temporary and promotional markdown management.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: The absolute dollar value reduction per unit, calculated as original_price minus markdown_price. Used for total markdown dollar impact calculation and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.

attributes.name: markdown_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage reduction from original price to markdown price, calculated as ((original_price - markdown_price) / original_price) * 100. Key metric for promotional intensity and margin sacrifice analysis.

attributes.name: markdown_price
attributes.description: The new reduced retail price after the markdown is applied. Represents the new selling price point for the affected merchandise.

attributes.name: markdown_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for initiating the markdown event. Seasonal clearance indicates end-of-season inventory reduction; slow seller indicates poor sell-through performance; competitive response indicates market-driven pricing adjustment; end-of-life indicates product discontinuation; damaged indicates impaired merchandise; obsolete indicates outdated or superseded products.

attributes.name: markdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the markdown event. Draft indicates initial planning; pending approval indicates awaiting merchandising or finance authorization; approved indicates authorized but not yet effective; active indicates currently in effect; completed indicates markdown period has ended; cancelled indicates markdown was revoked before or during execution.

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown event indicating the nature and duration of the price reduction. Permanent markdowns are irreversible price changes; temporary markdowns are time-bound promotional reductions; clearance markdowns are end-of-season or end-of-life inventory liquidation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this markdown event record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Null if record has never been modified after creation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, business rationale, or special instructions related to the markdown event. Used for capturing merchandising strategy details, competitive intelligence, or execution guidance not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The regular retail price before the markdown is applied. Represents the baseline Average Unit Retail (AUR) for margin impact calculation.

attributes.name: projected_margin_impact
attributes.description: Forecasted gross margin dollar impact of the markdown event, accounting for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and markdown amount. Critical for Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) target management and merchandising profitability planning.

attributes.name: projected_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Forecasted total revenue impact of the markdown event, calculated as (markdown_price * projected_units_sold) minus baseline revenue. Negative values indicate revenue sacrifice; used for Profit and Loss (P&L) planning.

attributes.name: projected_sell_through_lift_percentage
attributes.description: Forecasted increase in sell-through rate as a result of the markdown, expressed as a percentage. Used for markdown effectiveness planning and inventory turn optimization. Based on historical markdown elasticity models.

attributes.name: projected_units_sold
attributes.description: Forecasted quantity of units expected to sell during the markdown period. Used for inventory planning and Open to Buy (OTB) budget impact assessment.

attributes.name: vendor_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount contributed by the vendor toward the markdown cost as per vendor support agreement. Used for vendor chargeback processing and net markdown cost calculation. Zero or null when no vendor support exists.

products.name: category_campaign_placement
products.description: This association product represents the operational placement of merchandise categories within marketing campaigns. It captures the budget allocation, sales targets, priority ranking, and featured status for each category-campaign combination. Each record links one category to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific promotional relationship, enabling retailers to plan, execute, and measure category-level campaign performance.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, marketing campaigns routinely feature multiple merchandise categories (e.g., a Back-to-School campaign promotes apparel, electronics, and stationery simultaneously), and each category participates in multiple campaigns throughout the year (seasonal promotions, clearance events, brand campaigns). Retailers actively manage these category-campaign placements as operational entities, setting category-specific budgets, sales targets, priority rankings, and featured status for each campaign. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational planning and execution process where marketing and merchandising teams collaborate to allocate resources and measure performance at the category-campaign intersection.

products.name: tier
products.description: Reference master defining the qualification tiers within a loyalty program (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captures tier name, tier rank/order, qualification threshold (spend or points), maintenance threshold, tier benefits summary, tier badge color, upgrade rules, downgrade rules, and tier validity period. Owned by the loyalty domain as the authoritative tier taxonomy.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent loyalty program to which this tier belongs. A loyalty program may have multiple tiers (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum).

attributes.name: badge_color
attributes.description: Hex color code or color name for the tier badge displayed in digital channels and physical membership cards (e.g., #C0C0C0 for Silver, #FFD700 for Gold, #E5E4E2 for Platinum, #B9F2FF for Diamond).

attributes.name: badge_icon_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tier Badge Icon URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: URL to the digital asset (icon or badge image) representing this tier in mobile apps, websites, and digital communications.

tag_set.value: Tier Badge Icon URL (Uniform Resource Locator)

attributes.name: benefits_summary
attributes.description: Textual summary of key benefits and privileges associated with this tier (e.g., free shipping, priority customer service, exclusive access to sales, birthday rewards, concierge service). Used for customer communication and marketing.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier within the program (e.g., SILVER, GOLD, PLAT, DIAM). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Sequence number controlling the display order of tiers in customer-facing interfaces (websites, mobile apps, marketing materials). Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: downgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the rules and conditions under which a customer is downgraded from this tier (e.g., automatic if maintenance threshold not met, grace period of 3 months, no downgrades for lifetime tiers).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this tier definition is no longer active for new qualifications. Null indicates the tier is currently active with no planned end date. Existing members may retain status beyond this date per program rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this tier definition becomes active and available for customer qualification. Used for managing tier launches and program changes.

attributes.name: grace_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months a customer retains tier status after failing to meet maintenance threshold before being downgraded. Null if no grace period is offered.

attributes.name: invitation_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is available only by invitation from the company (True) or can be achieved through standard qualification rules (False). Typically used for ultra-premium or VIP tiers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lifetime_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier, once achieved, is retained for the customer's lifetime regardless of future activity (True) or is subject to periodic review and potential downgrade (False).

attributes.name: maintenance_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the maintenance threshold must be met to retain tier status (e.g., 12 for annual review). Null if no maintenance requirement.

attributes.name: maintenance_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value a customer must achieve to maintain this tier after initial qualification. Often lower than qualification threshold to encourage retention. Null if maintenance equals qualification.

attributes.name: marketing_description
attributes.description: Extended marketing copy describing the tier's value proposition, benefits, and aspirational messaging. Used in promotional materials, program brochures, and enrollment campaigns.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the loyalty tier displayed to customers (e.g., Silver Member, Gold Member, Platinum Elite, Diamond VIP).

attributes.name: points_earning_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning rate for members of this tier (e.g., 1.0 for base tier, 1.5 for Gold, 2.0 for Platinum). Higher tiers earn points faster.

attributes.name: points_redemption_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to points required for redemption rewards for this tier (e.g., 0 for base tier, 10 for Gold means 10% fewer points needed, 20 for Platinum). Enhances redemption value for premium tiers.

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which the qualification threshold must be met (e.g., 12 for annual qualification, 3 for quarterly). Null indicates lifetime qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_type
attributes.description: The metric used to determine tier qualification: spend (total monetary spend), points (loyalty points earned), transactions (number of purchases), or hybrid (combination of multiple metrics).

attributes.name: qualification_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric value a customer must achieve to qualify for this tier (e.g., $5000 annual spend, 10000 points earned, 50 transactions). Interpretation depends on qualification_threshold_type.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of the tier within the loyalty program hierarchy. Lower numbers indicate entry-level tiers; higher numbers indicate premium tiers (e.g., 1=Silver, 2=Gold, 3=Platinum, 4=Diamond).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: URL to the legal terms and conditions document governing this tier's benefits, qualification rules, and member obligations.

tag_set.value: Terms and Conditions URL (Uniform Resource Locator)

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier. Active tiers are available for customer enrollment and qualification; inactive tiers are no longer offered but may have legacy members; deprecated tiers are being phased out; planned tiers are under development.

attributes.name: upgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the rules and conditions under which a customer is upgraded to this tier (e.g., automatic upon reaching threshold, manual review required, invitation-only for top tier).

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Immutable append-only ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty membership, including tier-change qualification events. Each entry captures transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, bonus, transfer, reversal, tier_qualify), signed points amount, source reference (POS transaction, order, promotion, partner, tier evaluation), channel, location, timestamp, running balance, and optional tier-change metadata (previous tier, new tier, qualifying period). Serves as the financial-grade audit trail for points liability management, ASC 606 compliance evidence, tier history reporting, and CLTV calculation. No updates or deletes — corrections are posted as reversal entries. Tier qualification events include the qualifying spend/points amount and evaluation period for complete audit trail.

attributes.name: points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each points ledger entry. Primary key for the immutable append-only ledger.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.accrual_rule. Business justification: Points ledger entries of type 'earn' should reference which accrual rule generated the points. This is critical for audit trail, analytics (which rules drive the most engagement), and dispute resoluti

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who processed the transaction or manual adjustment. Null for automated system transactions. Used for customer service audit and clienteling attribution.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the targeted engagement or marketing campaign that triggered this points transaction. Null for organic transactions. Enables campaign effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ecommerce.cart. Business justification: Points redemption can occur at cart level before order placement; tracking cart enables pre-order points reservation, cart abandonment recovery with points incentives, and real-time points balance upd

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the e-commerce or omnichannel order that generated this points transaction. Null for in-store POS transactions not linked to an order. Enables order-to-loyalty reconciliation.

attributes.name: liability_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Points accrual creates financial liability that must be recorded in specific GL accounts (typically deferred revenue or loyalty liability accounts). Every points transaction requires GL account mappin

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the transaction occurred. Null for online, mobile, or partner channels. Used for store-level loyalty performance reporting.

attributes.name: member_loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: FK to loyalty.membership.membership_id — Points ledger to membership is the core loyalty accounting join. Every points balance inquiry, tier qualification check, and loyalty statement requires this link.

attributes.name: partner_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.partner_transaction. Business justification: Points earned or redeemed through coalition partners should reference the partner_transaction record. Currently points_ledger has a generic partner_id field, but linking to the specific partner_transa

attributes.name: points_loyalty_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership account for which this points transaction was recorded.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.pos_transaction. Business justification: Majority of loyalty points are earned at POS; direct link enables real-time posting, receipt printing with earned points, POS-loyalty reconciliation, and audit trail for in-store transactions.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing promotion or campaign that triggered bonus points or special earn rate. Null for standard earn transactions. Supports promotion ROI analysis.

attributes.name: redemption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption. Business justification: Critical reconciliation link. When a redemption occurs, it generates a points_ledger entry (debit). The ledger should reference the redemption transaction for full traceability. Currently points_ledge

attributes.name: redemption_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.redemption_rule. Business justification: Points ledger entries of type 'redeem' should reference which redemption rule was applied. Parallel to accrual_rule_id, this enables audit trail for rule enforcement, compliance reporting, and analyti

attributes.name: reversal_reference_points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Points ledger ID of the original transaction being reversed. Populated only for transaction_type = reversal. Creates audit trail linking correction to original entry.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for manual points adjustments. Populated only for transaction_type = adjust. Provides business context for non-standard transactions requiring audit trail.

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value in base currency (USD, EUR, etc.) that generated the points earn. Used to calculate points-per-dollar ratio and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV). Null for non-purchase transactions.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for bulk processing batch if this transaction was part of a batch operation (e.g., monthly expiration run, partner file import). Null for real-time individual transactions.

attributes.name: breakage_rate
attributes.description: Expected percentage of points that will never be redeemed (expire or go unused). Applied at transaction time for liability calculation. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% breakage).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the points transaction was initiated: store (physical retail location), online (e-commerce website), mobile_app (branded mobile application), call_center (customer service phone interaction), partner (third-party loyalty partner), kiosk (self-service terminal).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this ledger entry was created in the data platform. Distinct from transaction_timestamp which reflects the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base currency amount. Null if no monetary value is associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: earn_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base earn rate for this transaction. Standard earn is 1.0, promotional or tier-based accelerators may be 2.0, 3.0, etc. Null for non-earn transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the points from this earn transaction will expire if not redeemed. Null for transactions that do not generate expiring points (redemptions, adjustments). Critical for points liability forecasting.

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this points transaction was part of a promotional or bonus program (True) or standard program rules (False). Used to segment promotional vs. organic points activity.

attributes.name: new_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty membership tier after this transaction. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Records the tier achieved through qualification event.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional free-text notes providing additional context for the transaction. Used for customer service annotations, special handling instructions, or audit clarifications.

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: Signed points value for this transaction. Positive for earn/bonus/transfer-in, negative for redeem/expire/transfer-out. Supports fractional points for partner conversions.

attributes.name: points_liability_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary liability (in base currency) associated with the points in this transaction. Calculated using breakage-adjusted redemption value. Critical for ASC 606 deferred revenue accounting.

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty membership tier before this transaction. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Captures tier transition history for member journey analysis.

attributes.name: qualification_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the evaluation period used to assess tier qualification. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Completes the qualification window definition.

attributes.name: qualification_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the evaluation period used to assess tier qualification. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Defines the rolling window or calendar period for tier assessment.

attributes.name: qualifying_points_amount
attributes.description: Total points earned that qualified the member for tier change. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Alternative or complementary qualification metric to spend.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total spend amount that qualified the member for tier change. Populated only for transaction_type = tier_qualify. Provides evidence for tier qualification audit.

attributes.name: redemption_value_per_point
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value (in base currency) of one loyalty point at time of transaction. Used to calculate points liability. May vary by tier, promotion, or partner agreement.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for reversing a prior points transaction: return (product returned), cancellation (order cancelled), fraud (fraudulent activity detected), system_error (technical issue correction), customer_service (goodwill adjustment). Populated only for reversal transactions.

attributes.name: running_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative points balance for the membership after this transaction is applied. Provides snapshot of available points at this moment in time.

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating transaction or event in the source system. Links back to POS transaction ID, order number, promotion code, partner transaction ID, or adjustment ticket number for full audit trail.

attributes.name: source_reference_type
attributes.description: Category of the originating business event that triggered this points transaction: pos_transaction (in-store purchase via Point of Sale), order (e-commerce or omnichannel order), promotion (marketing campaign or offer), partner (third-party loyalty partner activity), tier_evaluation (automated tier qualification assessment), manual_adjustment (customer service or program admin correction), campaign (targeted engagement initiative). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pos_transaction|order|promotion|partner|tier_evaluation|manual_adjustment|campaign — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the points transaction: posted (successfully recorded and balance updated), pending (awaiting confirmation or settlement), reversed (cancelled via reversal entry), failed (transaction rejected by system). Immutable ledger typically contains only posted entries.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the points transaction occurred in the source system. Business event timestamp for the points movement.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of points movement: earn (points accrued from purchase or activity), redeem (points spent on rewards), expire (points lapsed due to inactivity or time limit), adjust (manual correction by program administrator), bonus (promotional or campaign points grant), transfer (points moved between accounts or partners), reversal (correction of a prior transaction), tier_qualify (points milestone triggering tier change). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|expire|adjust|bonus|transfer|reversal|tier_qualify — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: accrual_rule
products.description: Defines the business rules governing how points are earned by members. Captures rule name, program association, earning rate (points per dollar spent, per unit purchased, per visit), applicable product categories or SKUs, applicable channels (in-store, online, BOPIS), minimum spend threshold, bonus multiplier conditions, rule effective dates, and rule priority for conflict resolution. Supports EDLP and Hi-Lo earning strategies.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty points accrual rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_store_format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Earning rules vary by store format (hypermarkets 1x, premium formats 2x) to reflect margin structures and customer expectations. Retail loyalty programs differentiate point accrual by format for profi

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Loyalty earning rules routinely target product categories/hierarchies (e.g., '2x points on electronics', 'bonus points in grocery'). Category-based earning is a core retail loyalty mechanic requiring

attributes.name: liability_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accrual rules define which GL accounts receive liability postings when points are earned. Different accrual rules (base earn, bonus, promotional) may post to different GL accounts for financial report

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program to which this accrual rule belongs.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Accrual rates frequently vary by price zone (e.g., 2x points in premium urban zones, 1x in discount zones). Supports zone-based earning strategies, competitive positioning in high-value markets, and z

attributes.name: primary_accrual_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this accrual rule record.

attributes.name: product_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Brand-based earning rules are core loyalty strategy (e.g., '3x points on private label', 'double points on partner brands'). Brand-level earning rules support strategic merchandising objectives requir

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific promotion campaign if this accrual rule is tied to a promotional event. Null if not promotion-specific.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: SKU-specific earning rules are common for promotions (e.g., 'bonus 500 points on featured item #12345', 'triple points on new product launch'). SKU-level earning rules are real promotional mechanics r

attributes.name: tertiary_accrual_approved_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this accrual rule. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual rule: draft (under development), active (in use), inactive (disabled), expired (past effective period), suspended (temporarily paused).

attributes.name: applicable_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel(s) where this accrual rule applies: all channels, in-store (POS), online (e-commerce), mobile app, BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store), ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store).

attributes.name: applicable_product_category
attributes.description: Product category or categories to which this accrual rule applies. Null if rule applies to all categories. Comma-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: applicable_sku_list
attributes.description: Specific SKUs to which this accrual rule applies. Null if rule applies broadly. Comma-separated list if multiple SKUs.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this accrual rule: pending (awaiting approval), approved (ready for activation), rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accrual rule was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: bonus_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base earning rate for bonus promotions (e.g., 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus). Null if not a multiplier rule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accrual rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: day_of_week_restriction
attributes.description: Specific days of the week when this accrual rule applies (e.g., 'Monday,Wednesday,Friday'). Null if rule applies all days.

attributes.name: earning_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which points are earned: spend amount (dollars spent), unit quantity (items purchased), transaction count (number of transactions), or visit count (store visits).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this accrual rule expires and stops applying to transactions. Null for open-ended rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this accrual rule becomes active and begins applying to qualifying transactions.

attributes.name: excluded_product_category
attributes.description: Product categories explicitly excluded from this accrual rule (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, gift cards). Null if no exclusions. Comma-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: excluded_sku_list
attributes.description: Specific SKUs explicitly excluded from this accrual rule. Null if no exclusions. Comma-separated list if multiple SKUs.

attributes.name: external_rule_code
attributes.description: Identifier of this accrual rule in the source system, used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic scope where this accrual rule applies (e.g., specific countries, states, regions, or store locations). Null if no geographic restriction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accrual rule record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_points_per_transaction
attributes.description: Cap on the number of points that can be earned in a single transaction under this rule. Null if no cap.

attributes.name: member_tier_eligibility
attributes.description: Loyalty program membership tier(s) eligible for this accrual rule. 'all' if rule applies to all tiers, or specific tier names.

attributes.name: minimum_spend_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount required for the accrual rule to apply. Null if no minimum threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this accrual rule.

attributes.name: payment_method_restriction
attributes.description: Specific payment methods required for this accrual rule to apply (e.g., 'store_credit_card', 'mobile_wallet'). Null if no payment method restriction.

attributes.name: points_per_unit
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points earned per unit of the earning basis (e.g., 1 point per dollar spent, 10 points per item purchased).

attributes.name: pricing_strategy_alignment
attributes.description: Indicates which pricing strategy this accrual rule supports: EDLP (Everyday Low Price), Hi-Lo (High-Low promotional pricing), or hybrid.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the accrual rule, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the accrual rule, including business rationale, conditions, and examples.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the accrual rule describing its purpose (e.g., 'Base Earn Rate', 'Grocery Bonus', 'BOPIS Double Points').

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for conflict resolution when multiple accrual rules apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest).

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accrual rule by its application logic: base earning rate, bonus multiplier, category-specific, SKU-specific, channel-specific, or tier-specific.

attributes.name: stacking_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrual rule can be combined (stacked) with other accrual rules in the same transaction. True = stacking allowed, False = exclusive rule.

attributes.name: time_of_day_restriction
attributes.description: Specific time windows when this accrual rule applies (e.g., '09:00-12:00', 'happy hour'). Null if rule applies all day.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this accrual rule, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit history.

products.name: redemption_rule
products.description: Defines the business rules governing how members can redeem points for rewards. Captures minimum redemption threshold, redemption rate (points to currency conversion), eligible reward types, blackout dates, channel restrictions, partial redemption flag, rounding rules, and rule effective dates. Distinct from accrual rules as redemption has its own approval workflow, liability impact, and POS integration requirements.

attributes.name: redemption_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the redemption rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_store_format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Redemption policies restrict or enhance by format (premium rewards only at flagship stores, discount outlets exclude certain types). Retail operations align redemption rules to format capabilities and

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Redemption restrictions commonly apply by category (e.g., 'points not valid on alcohol/tobacco', 'redeem only in health & beauty'). Category-level redemption rules are standard retail loyalty practice

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: SKU-level redemption restrictions exist (e.g., 'points not valid on clearance SKUs', 'exclude gift cards from point redemption'). SKU-specific redemption rules are real business constraints requiring

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow process to be triggered when requires_approval_flag is True. Nullable if no approval required.

attributes.name: blackout_end_date
attributes.description: End date of blackout period during which redemptions under this rule are not allowed. Nullable if no blackout applies.

attributes.name: blackout_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of blackout period during which redemptions under this rule are not allowed. Nullable if no blackout applies.

attributes.name: combinable_with_promotions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption rule can be combined with other promotional offers (True) or must be used exclusively (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the redemption rule expires and is no longer available for member use. Nullable for open-ended rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the redemption rule becomes active and available for member use.

attributes.name: eligible_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels where this redemption rule can be applied (e.g., store, online, mobile_app, call_center).

attributes.name: eligible_reward_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of reward types that can be redeemed under this rule (e.g., merchandise, gift_card, discount, cashback, travel).

attributes.name: excluded_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product category codes that are excluded from redemption under this rule (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, gift cards). Nullable if no exclusions.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this redemption rule is valid. Nullable for global applicability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption rule record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: liability_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of how this redemption rule impacts loyalty points liability accounting (immediate recognition, deferred, conditional on fulfillment, or no impact).

attributes.name: marketing_message
attributes.description: Customer-facing marketing message or promotional text to be displayed when presenting this redemption rule to members.

attributes.name: maximum_points_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of loyalty points that can be redeemed in a single transaction under this rule. Nullable for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: maximum_redemptions_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of redemption transactions allowed per member per day under this rule. Nullable for unlimited daily usage.

attributes.name: maximum_redemptions_per_member
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single member can use this redemption rule within the effective period. Nullable for unlimited usage.

attributes.name: minimum_membership_tier
attributes.description: Minimum loyalty program tier required for a member to use this redemption rule (e.g., bronze, silver, gold, platinum). Nullable if no tier restriction.

attributes.name: minimum_points_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of loyalty points required to initiate a redemption transaction under this rule.

attributes.name: partial_redemption_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can redeem points in amounts less than the full reward value (True) or must redeem in full increments only (False).

attributes.name: pos_integration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption rule requires real-time integration with Point of Sale (POS) systems for in-store redemptions (True) or can be processed offline (False).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking to determine precedence when multiple redemption rules could apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: redemption_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary value associated with point redemptions.

attributes.name: redemption_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate defining how many points equal one unit of currency or reward value (e.g., 100 points = 1 USD).

attributes.name: redemption_rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the redemption rule indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: requires_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether redemptions under this rule require manager or system approval before processing (True) or are auto-approved (False).

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rule for rounding points during redemption calculations when fractional points result from conversion.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the redemption rule, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the redemption rule, including business purpose and usage guidelines.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the redemption rule for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the redemption rule based on its business purpose and application context.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: URL link to the full legal terms and conditions document governing this redemption rule.

attributes.name: version_number

Supports refer-a-friend programs, social advocacy tracking, and program growth attribution. Drives referral-sourced enrollment KPIs and program viral coefficient measurement.

attributes.name: referral_code

attributes.name: conversion_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: enrollment_date

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral code or offer expires. After this date, the referral is no longer valid for qualification or reward issuance.

attributes.name: first_purchase_amount

attributes.name: first_purchase_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the first purchase amount. Supports multi-currency loyalty program operations.

attributes.name: first_purchase_date

attributes.name: fraud_detection_score

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: qualification_date

attributes.name: qualification_met_flag

attributes.name: referee_reward_date

attributes.name: referee_reward_type

attributes.name: referee_reward_value
attributes.description: Monetary or points value of the reward granted to the referred individual. Denominated in points or currency depending on reward type.

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the referral was initiated by the referring member. Represents the business event timestamp for the referral action.

attributes.name: referral_timestamp

attributes.name: referrer_reward_currency_code

attributes.name: referrer_reward_date
attributes.description: Date when the reward was granted to the referring member. Null if the reward has not yet been issued.

attributes.name: referrer_reward_type

attributes.name: referrer_reward_value
attributes.description: Monetary or points value of the reward granted to the referring member. Denominated in points or currency depending on reward type.

attributes.name: source

attributes.name: viral_coefficient_contribution

products.name: campaign_storefront_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment of a loyalty engagement campaign to a specific digital storefront. It captures storefront-specific campaign configuration, launch timing, budget allocation, and performance metrics that exist only in the context of this campaign-storefront pairing. Each record links one engagement_campaign to one storefront with attributes tracking how that campaign performs on that specific channel.. Existence Justification: Loyalty engagement campaigns are deployed across multiple digital storefronts simultaneously as part of omnichannel marketing strategies, and each storefront hosts multiple campaigns concurrently. The business actively manages campaign-storefront deployments as operational entities, tracking storefront-specific launch timing, budget allocation, enrollment counts, participation metrics, and conversion rates. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where campaign managers deploy campaigns TO storefronts and monitor performance BY storefront.

attributes.name: campaign_storefront_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this campaign-storefront deployment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: engagement_campaign_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Campaign Storefront Deployment - Engagement Campaign Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the loyalty engagement campaign being deployed

tag_set.value: Campaign Storefront Deployment - Engagement Campaign Id

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the digital storefront where the campaign is deployed

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign-storefront deployment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this campaign deployment on this storefront. Scheduled indicates pre-launch; active indicates currently running; paused indicates temporarily suspended; completed indicates successfully concluded; cancelled indicates terminated before completion.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deployment record was last modified, typically updated as performance metrics are refreshed.

attributes.name: storefront_budget_allocation
attributes.description: The portion of the campaign's total budget allocated to this specific storefront, used for channel-specific promotional spend, incentives, or advertising.

attributes.name: storefront_conversion_rate
attributes.description: The conversion rate (percentage) of enrolled members who became active participants on this specific storefront, calculated as (storefront_participation_count / storefront_enrollment_count) * 100.

attributes.name: storefront_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this campaign concluded on this specific storefront. May differ from the campaign's global end_date to accommodate storefront-specific timing strategies.

attributes.name: storefront_enrollment_count
attributes.description: The number of members who enrolled or opted into the campaign through this specific storefront channel.

attributes.name: storefront_launch_date
attributes.description: The date when this campaign was launched on this specific storefront. May differ from the campaign's global start_date to accommodate storefront-specific timing strategies.

attributes.name: storefront_participation_count
attributes.description: The number of members who actively participated in the campaign (completed qualifying actions) through this specific storefront channel.

domains.name: ecommerce
domains.description: Manages digital commerce operations including online storefronts, product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows, digital payment processing, session tracking, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), AOV (Average Order Value), and GMV (Gross Merchandise Value). Tracks digital customer journeys, abandoned carts, and online-to-offline attribution. Integrates with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for unified digital commerce platform.

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront or online channel operated by Retail, including the main e-commerce site, mobile app storefronts, and marketplace presences. Captures storefront identity, locale, currency, domain URL, platform configuration (the e-commerce platform site ID, channel-specific settings, feature flags, theme/template references), launch date, status, supported payment methods, and supported fulfillment modes (BOPIS, ship-to-home, drop-ship). SSOT for digital channel identity and configuration within the e-commerce domain. Domain ownership principle: the ecommerce domain owns digital commerce operations from storefront configuration through checkout completion. Customer identity is owned by the customer domain; post-checkout order lifecycle is owned by the order domain; promotional campaign definitions are owned by the promotion domain; product master data is owned by the product domain.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each digital storefront or online channel record. Primary key for the storefront master data product within the e-commerce domain.

attributes.name: digital_catalog_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product catalog assigned to this storefront within the e-commerce platform or the PIM system. Determines which assortment of SKUs, categories, and product content is surfaced to customers on this channel. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) assortment planning and the customer master data system product golden records.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Storefronts often represent specific physical stores' online presence for store-specific inventory visibility, local pricing, BOPIS fulfillment, and "shop my store" features. Real business process: st

attributes.name: pci_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.pci_assessment. Business justification: Each storefront accepting card payments requires PCI compliance assessment. Retail must track which assessment covers each storefront's payment processing to maintain valid Attestation of Compliance (

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the price book or pricing list assigned to this storefront, sourced from Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or the e-commerce platform. Governs the base retail prices (AUR — Average Unit Retail) and EDLP (Everyday Low Price) rules applied to products displayed on this channel. Critical for channel-specific pricing strategy execution.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Each storefront (site, channel, locale) maps to a profit center for P&L reporting, segment analysis, management accounting, and channel profitability tracking in retail finance systems.

attributes.name: analytics_tracking_code
attributes.description: The web analytics platform tracking identifier assigned to this storefront (e.g., Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID 'G-XXXXXXXXXX' or Adobe Analytics Report Suite ID). Used to attribute digital customer journey events, CTR (Click-Through Rate), CR (Conversion Rate), and session data to the correct storefront channel. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary analytics configuration.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront has activated the CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' opt-out mechanism, required for storefronts serving California consumers. Governs data sharing controls and consumer rights workflows.

tag_set.value: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Enabled Flag

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the digital commerce channel operated by this storefront. Segments storefronts by their primary consumer interface: web (desktop/browser), mobile_app (iOS/Android native), marketplace (third-party platform such as Amazon or eBay), social_commerce (shoppable social media), or dark_store (fulfillment-only digital channel). Drives channel-specific analytics including CTR, CR, and GMV reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the primary geographic market served by this storefront (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Used for regulatory compliance scoping (GDPR, CCPA, FTC), tax jurisdiction assignment, and regional assortment planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was first created in the system of record (the e-commerce platform or the customer master data system). Represents the audit trail creation event for data governance and lineage tracking purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transactional currency for this storefront (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR'). Governs pricing display, checkout totals, AOV calculations, and GMV reporting. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) currency configuration.

attributes.name: customer_service_email
attributes.description: The operational customer service email address displayed to customers on this storefront for support inquiries, returns (RMA — Return Merchandise Authorization), and complaints. Routed to the case management system for case management. Classified confidential as an organizational contact identifier.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was or is scheduled to be permanently retired and removed from active digital commerce operations. Nullable for currently active storefronts. Used for channel sunset planning, data retention scheduling, and regulatory compliance archival.

attributes.name: default_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the default display language for this storefront (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es'). Used when a customer's browser language preference cannot be resolved or when the storefront operates in a single-language mode. Distinct from locale_code which also encodes regional formatting.

attributes.name: domain_url
attributes.description: The primary public-facing domain URL for this storefront (e.g., 'https://www.retail.com' or 'https://m.retail.com'). Used for SEO configuration, SSL certificate management, CDN routing, and digital marketing attribution. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary digital infrastructure configuration.

attributes.name: free_shipping_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum order value (in the storefront's primary currency) at which free standard shipping is automatically applied at checkout. A key lever for AOV (Average Order Value) optimization and customer acquisition. Configured in Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) or the e-commerce platform promotion rules.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is subject to GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) consent requirements, triggering cookie consent banners, data processing notices, and opt-in workflows for customers in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives compliance configuration in the e-commerce platform and CRM systems.

attributes.name: is_bopis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports the BOPIS (Buy Online Pick Up In Store) fulfillment mode, allowing customers to purchase online and collect from a physical store location. Drives fulfillment routing logic in the OMS (Order Management System) and store operations workflows.

tag_set.value: Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports drop-ship fulfillment, where vendors ship products directly to customers without passing through Retail's DC (Distribution Center). Relevant for extended assortment and marketplace-style operations. Aligns with supplier management and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration.

attributes.name: is_loyalty_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront is integrated with Retail's customer loyalty and engagement program, enabling points accrual, redemption, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tracking at the digital channel level. Drives loyalty-specific promotional targeting and RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) segmentation.

attributes.name: is_ropis_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ROPIS (Reserve Online Pick Up In Store), allowing customers to reserve items online without payment and collect them in-store. Distinct from BOPIS in that no payment transaction occurs at the digital checkout stage.

tag_set.value: Reserve Online Pick Up In Store (ROPIS) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: is_ship_from_store_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports SFS (Ship-from-Store) fulfillment, where physical store locations act as fulfillment centers for online orders. Enables distributed inventory utilization and faster last-mile delivery. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS for store-level pick/pack/ship operations.

attributes.name: is_ship_to_home_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports ship-to-home fulfillment, where orders are dispatched from a DC (Distribution Center) or store directly to the customer's delivery address. Governs last-mile delivery eligibility and carrier integration activation for this channel.

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether product prices displayed on this storefront include taxes (tax-inclusive, common in EU/UK markets) or exclude taxes (tax-exclusive, common in US markets). Governs price display logic at the product listing and checkout stages. Aligns with Oracle Retail Price Management (RPM) tax display configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this storefront record was most recently updated in the system of record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this storefront was first made publicly available to customers. Used for channel age analysis, anniversary promotions, and historical performance benchmarking. Represents the effective-from date for the storefront's commercial lifecycle.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code defining the primary language and regional formatting for this storefront (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA', 'es_MX'). Controls language display, date/number formatting, and content localization within the e-commerce platform. Critical for omnichannel customer experience consistency.

attributes.name: max_cart_line_items
attributes.description: The maximum number of distinct line items (SKUs) permitted in a single shopping cart session on this storefront. Governs cart capacity limits configured in the e-commerce platform to manage checkout performance and order processing capacity. Relevant for B2B or bulk-purchase storefronts.

attributes.name: min_order_amount
attributes.description: The minimum cart value (in the storefront's primary currency) required for a customer to complete checkout on this storefront. Used to enforce MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) value thresholds, qualify for free shipping promotions, or meet marketplace seller requirements. Configured in the e-commerce platform checkout rules.

attributes.name: storefront_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the digital storefront or online channel (e.g., 'Retail Main Site', 'Retail Mobile App', 'Retail Marketplace — Amazon'). Used in reporting dashboards, operational tooling, and business communications.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) merchant compliance level assigned to this storefront, determined by annual card transaction volume (Level 1: >6M transactions; Level 2: 1M–6M; Level 3: 20K–1M; Level 4: <20K). Governs the scope of annual security assessments and SAQ (Self-Assessment Questionnaire) requirements. Classified confidential as it reveals security posture.

attributes.name: platform_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the the e-commerce platform (SFCC) platform release deployed for this storefront (e.g., 'SFCC 23.7', 'B2C Commerce 22.10'). Used for release management, compatibility tracking, and upgrade planning across the digital commerce estate.

attributes.name: robots_indexing_policy
attributes.description: The default robots meta directive applied to this storefront, controlling whether search engine crawlers may index pages and follow links (e.g., 'index_follow' for the main site, 'noindex_nofollow' for staging or dark-store channels). Impacts organic search visibility and SEO strategy.

attributes.name: seo_meta_title
attributes.description: The default HTML meta title tag content for the storefront's homepage, used by search engines for indexing and SERP (Search Engine Results Page) display. Impacts organic search traffic and digital marketing performance. Managed within the e-commerce platform site preferences.

attributes.name: session_timeout_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes of customer inactivity after which a shopping session is automatically expired on this storefront. Governs cart abandonment timing, session-based analytics, and security compliance for authenticated customer sessions. Configured in the e-commerce platform site security settings.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique site identifier assigned within the e-commerce platform (SFCC) for this storefront. Used as the operational reference key across digital commerce platform configurations, API calls, and integration touchpoints. Aligns to the SFCC Site object's siteID field.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this storefront record was sourced or last updated (e.g., 'SFCC' for the e-commerce platform, 'MDM' for the customer master data system, 'MANUAL' for manually entered records). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and master data governance within the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: storefront_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the storefront. 'active' indicates the storefront is live and accepting customer traffic; 'maintenance' indicates a temporary service window; 'draft' indicates pre-launch configuration; 'decommissioned' indicates the channel has been permanently retired. Governs whether the storefront is eligible for traffic routing, promotional targeting, and digital commerce operations.

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of payment methods accepted at checkout on this storefront (e.g., 'credit_card,debit_card,paypal,apple_pay,google_pay,gift_card,buy_now_pay_later'). Governs payment gateway configuration and PCI DSS compliance scope for this channel. Managed within the e-commerce platform payment processor settings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|gift_card|buy_now_pay_later|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary tax jurisdiction applicable to this storefront for sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation purposes (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON', 'GB'). Used by the tax engine integrated with the e-commerce platform to apply correct tax rates at checkout. Aligns with FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition and FTC pricing transparency requirements.

attributes.name: theme_code
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the visual theme or template applied to this storefront within the e-commerce platform (e.g., 'sfra-retail-v3', 'pwa-kit-2024'). Controls the storefront's UI/UX presentation layer, including layout, typography, and brand styling. Used by digital merchandising and visual merchandising teams for planogram-equivalent digital shelf configuration.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the storefront's primary operating time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling promotional campaigns, flash sales, maintenance windows, and business-hours-based SLA calculations. Aligns with the e-commerce platform site time zone configuration.

products.name: digital_catalog

This is the digital presentation layer — distinct from the master product catalog in the product domain which owns canonical SKU/UPC definitions and the master merchandise hierarchy.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Product pages display active promotions; linking enables merchandising teams to verify promotional pricing accuracy across catalog, SEO teams to optimize promotional landing pages, and compliance team

attributes.description: The date and time when this digital catalog record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and content age analysis. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the online_price for this digital catalog record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency storefronts in international e-commerce operations.

attributes.name: has_video

attributes.name: hazmat_flag

attributes.name: image_count
attributes.description: Total number of product images published for this SKU on the storefront, including hero, alternate angles, lifestyle, and swatch images. Used to measure digital content completeness and identify SKUs requiring additional imagery.

attributes.name: is_drop_ship_eligible

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been manually designated as a featured product by digital merchandisers, qualifying it for placement in featured product carousels, homepage spotlights, or category hero positions on the storefront.

attributes.name: is_online_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is currently available for purchase on the digital storefront. Distinct from publication_status — a product may be published but temporarily unavailable due to inventory depletion or fulfillment constraints. Drives add-to-cart eligibility.

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a private label (store brand) product owned and sold exclusively by the retailer. Private label products typically carry higher gross margins and are a key strategic differentiator in assortment planning.

attributes.name: is_searchable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is indexed and returned in on-site search results on the digital storefront. A product may be published but excluded from search (e.g., exclusive landing page products or clearance items managed via direct URL only).

attributes.name: last_published_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this digital catalog record was most recently published or re-published to the live storefront. Used for content freshness tracking, cache invalidation, and audit trails in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code specifying the language and regional variant for this digital catalog record (e.g., en-US, fr-CA, es-MX). Supports multi-locale storefront content management and international e-commerce operations in the e-commerce platform.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Full consumer-facing product description displayed on the product detail page (PDP), including features, benefits, materials, and usage instructions. Supports rich HTML formatting. Managed in the e-commerce platform content management.

attributes.name: primary_image_url
