attributes.description: Date when the disposition action was fully executed (item restocked, shipped to vendor, transferred to liquidator, or destroyed). Used for cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Quality assessment grade assigned during inspection. A=New/Unopened, B=Like New/Minor Packaging Damage, C=Good/Visible Wear, D=Fair/Functional Defects, F=Unsellable/Damaged. Drives disposition type and recovery value estimation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disposition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for recovery value amounts. Supports multi-currency operations for global retail operations.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date when the disposition decision was made by the returns processing team or system. Key timestamp for cycle time analytics.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the disposition decision was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and process timing analysis.

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific defect or damage type found during inspection. Used for quality analytics and vendor chargeback justification.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposition action. Tracks progress from decision through execution.

attributes.name: disposition_type
attributes.description: The final fate decision for the returned item. Determines the next step in the reverse logistics workflow and impacts inventory valuation and recovery value.

attributes.name: estimated_recovery_value
attributes.description: Projected financial recovery value for the item based on disposition type and condition grade. Used for shrinkage forecasting and reverse logistics ROI analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the returned item was physically inspected and condition grade was assigned. Precedes disposition decision date.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the returned item is classified as hazardous material requiring special disposition handling and compliance with EPA and DOT regulations.

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the item has a unique serial number requiring individual tracking through disposition process. Common for electronics and high-value goods.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this disposition record was last updated. Tracks changes to disposition decisions or status updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the returns processor providing additional context about the disposition decision, item condition, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU being dispositioned under this record. Typically 1 for individual item returns, may be greater for bulk returns.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the disposition decision. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: restock_location_code
attributes.description: Specific inventory location code where the item will be restocked if disposition type is restock_sellable or restock_clearance. May be a bin, aisle, or zone identifier within the facility.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of restocking fee charged if restocking_fee_applied is true. Contributes to reverse logistics cost recovery.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_applied
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a restocking fee was charged to the customer for this return. Impacts refund amount and customer satisfaction metrics.

attributes.name: rma_number
attributes.description: The return merchandise authorization number associated with this disposition. Links to the customer-facing return authorization.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the returned item if is_serialized is true. Used for warranty tracking, theft prevention, and individual item lifecycle management.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The stock keeping unit identifier for the returned item being dispositioned. Used for inventory tracking and product identification.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the disposition quantity. EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack, BX=Box. Aligns with inventory management standards.

products.name: refund
products.description: Financial refund transaction record representing the monetary reimbursement issued to a customer as resolution of a return. Captures refund method (original payment method, store credit, gift card, check), refund amount, restocking fee deducted, original transaction reference, refund authorization code, processing timestamp, refund status (pending, processed, failed, reversed), and payment processor response. Integrates with financial accounting for accounts payable and revenue reversal under ASC 606.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Primary key for refund

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: header_id

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location where the refund was processed, if applicable. Used for store-level financial reconciliation and performance analysis.

attributes.name: primary_refund_approved_by_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or authorized employee who approved the refund, if approval was required. Used for compliance and authorization audit trail.

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.description: Reference to the parent return transaction that triggered this refund. Links refund to the originating return merchandise authorization (RMA).

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional positive or negative adjustment applied to the refund for reasons such as damage, missing components, promotional credits, or goodwill gestures.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Unique authorization or approval code issued by the payment processor confirming the refund transaction was approved. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The customer-facing channel or touchpoint through which the refund was initiated and processed. Enables omnichannel analytics and channel performance measurement.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this refund record was first created in the database. Used for data lineage and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: expected_settlement_date

attributes.name: fraud_score

attributes.name: merchandise_amount

attributes.name: method

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_processor

attributes.name: processed_timestamp

attributes.name: processor_response_code

attributes.name: shipping_amount

attributes.description: The sales tax or value-added tax (VAT) amount being refunded to the customer. Must align with original tax calculation and jurisdiction requirements.

attributes.name: total_refund_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount refunded to the customer after all fees, taxes, and adjustments. This is the actual monetary value transferred back to the customer.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction identifier or reference number from the payment processor. Links internal refund record to external payment system for reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this refund record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: exchange_order_number

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange based on the relationship between returned and replacement items.

attributes.name: returned_sku

attributes.name: rma_id

attributes.name: shipping_cost_waived_flag

attributes.name: special_instructions

attributes.name: vendor_return_eligible

Triggers inventory adjustment transactions to update on-hand quantities in the warehouse management and inventory systems.

attributes.name: disposition_id

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Restock events occur at specific nodes (DC, store, warehouse). Essential for location-level inventory reconciliation, return processing KPIs by facility, and capacity planning. Retail operations track

attributes.name: restocked_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or store associate who performed the restocking action. Links to the workforce master data for accountability and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating return merchandise authorization that triggered this restock event. Links the restock back to the customer return or vendor return transaction.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Restock operations require SKU reference for inventory accuracy, markdown decision workflows, and return-to-stock cycle time measurement. Critical for retail inventory management, condition-based pric

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Restocking returned merchandise updates specific inventory positions at bin/location level. Critical for real-time ATP calculation, inventory accuracy, and reconciling physical stock after return proc

attributes.name: aisle_number
attributes.description: The aisle identifier where the restocked item was placed on the sales floor or in the warehouse. Supports store operations and inventory locating.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: The specific bin, shelf, or storage location identifier within the warehouse or store where the item was placed during restocking. Used for precise inventory tracking and picking operations.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: The assessed condition grade of the returned item at the time of restocking. Determines whether the item goes back to full-price inventory, clearance, or requires further disposition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this restock event record was first created in the data platform. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this restock event. Supports multi-currency operations for international retail.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-by date for perishable or time-sensitive products being restocked. Critical for food safety, pharmaceutical compliance, and inventory rotation (FIFO/FEFO).

attributes.name: inspection_completed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether required quality inspection has been completed for the restocked item. True when inspection is finished and item is cleared for sale.

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the restocked item requires additional quality inspection before being made available for sale. True for items with condition concerns or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when quality inspection was completed for the restocked item. Null if no inspection was required or inspection is still pending.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_posted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inventory adjustment transaction has been successfully posted to the warehouse management system and inventory ledger. True when the on-hand quantity has been updated.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the inventory adjustment transaction was posted to the WMS and inventory systems. May differ from restock_timestamp if there is a processing delay.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The inventory status assigned to the restocked item. Determines whether the item is available for sale at full price, marked for clearance, held for inspection, or quarantined.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer lot or batch number for the restocked item. Critical for traceability of food, pharmaceutical, and regulated products subject to recall management.

attributes.name: markdown_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of price reduction applied to the restocked item if it was moved to clearance or discounted inventory. Zero if restocked at full price.

attributes.name: markdown_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the restocked item relative to its original retail price. Zero if no markdown was applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the restock event. Captures special handling instructions, condition observations, or operational exceptions noted by the restocking associate.

attributes.name: original_cost
attributes.description: The original cost of goods sold (COGS) for the restocked item. Used for inventory valuation and financial reconciliation of returned merchandise.

attributes.name: quantity_restocked
attributes.description: The quantity of units restocked back into inventory in this event. Supports fractional quantities for items sold by weight or volume.

attributes.name: restock_location_type
attributes.description: The type of facility where the item was restocked. Indicates whether restocking occurred at a retail store, distribution center (DC), micro-fulfillment center (MFC), dark store, or was returned to vendor.

attributes.name: restock_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this item was restocked. Distinguishes between customer returns that passed inspection, vendor returns, warranty exchanges, and other restock scenarios.

attributes.name: restock_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the restocking action was completed and the item was placed back into available inventory. This is the principal business event timestamp for the restock transaction.

attributes.name: restocked_value
attributes.description: The inventory value assigned to the restocked item after any markdown or condition adjustment. Represents the expected recoverable value of the returned merchandise.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number for serialized items such as electronics, appliances, or high-value goods. Enables individual unit tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: shelf_position
attributes.description: The specific shelf or position identifier within the aisle where the item was restocked. Enables precise planogram compliance and inventory locating.

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source system that generated this restock event. Enables traceability back to the originating system record for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the restocked quantity. Defines whether the quantity represents individual units, cases, pallets, or weight/volume measures.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this restock event record was last modified in the data platform. Audit field for tracking record changes and data quality monitoring.

products.name: liquidation_batch
products.description: Batch record grouping returned merchandise designated for liquidation sale to third-party buyers or auction channels. Captures batch number, liquidation channel (auction, bulk buyer, online marketplace), total units, total cost value, reserve and final sale price, liquidation partner reference, batch and sale dates, and net recovery amount. Includes item-level detail: individual SKU, UPC, quantity, condition grade (A-New through F-Unsellable), estimated and actual recovery value per unit, and originating RMA and disposition references. Supports reverse logistics cost recovery tracking, COGS write-off calculations, and shrinkage accounting at both batch and item granularity.

attributes.name: environmental_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.environmental_event. Required for regulat

attributes.name: primary_liquidation_associate_id

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id

attributes.name: category_mix

attributes.name: condition_grade_mix

attributes.name: final_sale_price

attributes.name: gl_posting_reference

attributes.name: inspection_notes

attributes.name: is_hazmat

attributes.name: liquidation_channel

attributes.name: liquidation_fees

attributes.name: liquidation_partner_reference

attributes.name: manifest_document_url

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount

attributes.name: pallet_count

attributes.name: credit_type

attributes.name: credit_variance_amount

Supports loss prevention operations, shrinkage reporting, and customer risk scoring.

attributes.name: return_fraud_case_id

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id

attributes.name: case_opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the formal fraud investigation case was opened and assigned for review.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fraud investigation case. Open indicates initial detection; under investigation means active review is in progress; pending review awaits management decision; closed confirmed means fraud was verified; closed unsubstantiated means insufficient evidence; escalated indicates senior management involvement; law enforcement referred means case was submitted to authorities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_investigation|pending_review|closed_confirmed|closed_unsubstantiated|escalated|law_enforcement_referred — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: civil_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount sought or recovered through civil demand letter or restitution process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fraud case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated fraud value amount.

attributes.name: customer_return_count_90d
attributes.description: Total number of returns initiated by this customer in the 90 days prior to case detection, used to identify serial returner patterns.

attributes.name: customer_return_value_90d
attributes.description: Total monetary value of returns initiated by this customer in the 90 days prior to case detection.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the suspected fraud was initially identified. Associate flag indicates store employee reported suspicious activity; automated rule means system-based detection triggered; loss prevention review indicates proactive audit; customer service escalation means case originated from service interaction; analytics model indicates AI/ML detection; third party alert means external fraud service notification.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the suspected fraud was first detected or flagged in the system.

attributes.name: enforcement_action_taken
attributes.description: Action taken by the retailer in response to confirmed fraud. None indicates no action; RMA denial means return was rejected; account restriction limits future returns; account suspension temporarily blocks account; account termination permanently closes account; law enforcement referral involves police; civil demand letter seeks restitution; store ban prohibits physical store access. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|rma_denial|account_restriction|account_suspension|account_termination|law_enforcement_referral|civil_demand_letter|store_ban — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimated_fraud_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the fraudulent activity in the transaction currency, used for shrinkage reporting and loss quantification.

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of evidence collected during the investigation, including witness statements, video surveillance references, receipt analysis, product inspection findings, and other supporting documentation.

attributes.name: fraud_indicators
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific fraud indicators or red flags that triggered the investigation, such as high return frequency, missing tags, altered receipts, mismatched serial numbers, or suspicious timing patterns.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score (0-100) calculated by fraud detection algorithms based on customer return history, transaction patterns, and behavioral indicators. Higher scores indicate greater fraud likelihood.

attributes.name: fraud_typology
attributes.description: Classification of the type of return fraud detected. Wardrobing refers to purchasing items for temporary use and returning them; receipt fraud involves fraudulent or altered receipts; empty box is returning packaging without merchandise; stolen merchandise return is attempting to return stolen goods; serial returner pattern indicates abuse through excessive returns; refund abuse involves exploiting return policies; price switching is manipulating price tags; counterfeit return is returning fake merchandise. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wardrobing|receipt_fraud|empty_box|stolen_merchandise_return|serial_returner_pattern|refund_abuse|price_switching|counterfeit_return — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: investigation_outcome
attributes.description: Final determination of the fraud investigation. Fraud confirmed means evidence supports fraudulent intent; fraud unsubstantiated means insufficient evidence; customer error indicates unintentional mistake; policy misunderstanding means customer misinterpreted return policy; system error indicates operational or technical issue; pending means investigation incomplete.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the fraud case based on estimated value, customer history, and fraud typology. Critical cases involve high-value fraud or organized retail crime; high priority involves significant loss or repeat offenders; medium priority is standard investigation; low priority is minor suspected abuse.

attributes.name: investigator_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and observations recorded by the assigned investigator during the case review process.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fraud case record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_case_number
attributes.description: Official case number assigned by law enforcement agency if the fraud case was referred for criminal prosecution.

attributes.name: linked_rma_count
attributes.description: Total number of RMA records associated with this fraud investigation, used to identify patterns across multiple return transactions.

attributes.name: management_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case requires senior management or legal review before enforcement action, typically true for high-value cases or law enforcement referrals.

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Status of civil recovery efforts. Not applicable means no recovery attempted; demand sent means civil demand letter issued; partial recovery indicates some payment received; full recovery means complete restitution; uncollectible means recovery efforts abandoned.

attributes.name: related_case_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of other fraud case IDs that are related to this case, used to track organized retail crime rings or coordinated fraud patterns across multiple customers or locations.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when management review was completed and case disposition was approved.

attributes.name: third_party_fraud_service_code
attributes.description: External fraud detection service case identifier if the case was flagged or validated by a third-party fraud prevention vendor.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: SSOT for financial accounting, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, revenue recognition (ASC 606), P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, budgeting, forecasting, COGS, gross margin, lease accounting (ASC 842), and financial close processes. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules for enterprise financial management and FASB-compliant regulatory reporting.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for organizational cost centers used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for expense allocation, P&L reporting, and budget tracking. Each cost center represents a distinct organizational unit (store, DC, corporate department) responsible for incurring costs. Includes cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, and validity periods.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center (DC) associated with this cost center, when the cost center represents a DC or fulfillment location. Supports supply chain cost allocation and COGS tracking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store associated with this cost center, when the cost center represents a store-level organizational unit. Enables store-level P&L, comp sales (SSS), and footfall-to-cost analysis.

attributes.name: primary_cost_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee designated as the responsible manager (cost center owner) for this cost center in SAP S/4HANA (field: VERAK). Accountable for budget adherence, expense approvals, and financial close sign-off.

attributes.name: actual_ytd_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenses posted to this cost center from the start of the fiscal year to the current reporting period. Sourced from SAP FI/CO actuals. Used for budget variance, EBITDA tracking, and financial close reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct posting, SAP assessment cycle, distribution cycle, activity-based costing). Governs how overhead is spread across stores, DCs, and product categories.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, expressed in the cost center currency. Used for Open to Buy (OTB) tracking, budget vs. actuals variance analysis, and financial planning.

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2025) to which the annual budget amount applies. Aligns with the SAP fiscal year variant for period-based budget vs. actuals comparison.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area (GSBER) to which this cost center is assigned. Enables cross-company-code P&L reporting by business segment (e.g., Grocery, Apparel, E-Commerce). Supports FASB ASC 280 segment disclosures.

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP cost center category (KOSAR) that controls which business transactions are allowed for this cost center (e.g., 'A' for general cost centers, 'E' for production cost centers). Governs posting rules in FI/CO.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the cost center within the controlling area, as defined in SAP S/4HANA CO module (field: KOSTL). Used in P&L reporting, budget allocation, and expense posting.

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total open purchase order and contract commitment amounts encumbered against this cost center's budget but not yet invoiced. Supports available budget calculation and OTB management in SAP CO-OM.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP Company Code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned. Used for statutory financial reporting, P&L consolidation, and FASB-compliant revenue and expense recognition.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area (KOKRS) to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers within a controlling area share the same chart of accounts and fiscal year variant.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' = open for postings; 'locked' = temporarily blocked for new postings (SAP lock indicator); 'inactive' = no longer in use; 'pending' = awaiting activation; 'archived' = closed and retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by organizational unit type. Drives expense allocation rules, budget templates, and P&L reporting hierarchies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store|distribution_center|corporate|regional_office|ecommerce|shared_services|manufacturing|logistics — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this cost center's organizational unit is physically located. Used for multi-country P&L reporting, tax jurisdiction assignment, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA CO). Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost center's controlling area currency (SAP field: WAERS). All budget, actual, and commitment amounts for this cost center are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Long-form description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of expenses, and organizational context. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA field LTEXT.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant (PERIV) assigned to this cost center's controlling area. Defines the fiscal calendar (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March). Critical for period-based budget vs. actuals comparison and FASB-compliant financial close.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Functional Area (FKBER) classifying the cost center by business function (e.g., Sales, Administration, Production, Logistics). Used for cost-of-sales accounting and functional P&L reporting per FASB ASC 220.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Primary General Ledger account code associated with this cost center for default expense postings. Links cost center activity to the chart of accounts in SAP FI for P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: headcount_budget
attributes.description: Approved headcount (number of full-time equivalent employees) budgeted for this cost center in the current fiscal year. Used for workforce cost planning, Workday HCM integration, and labor cost as a percentage of sales analysis.

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Node within the standard cost center hierarchy (SAP field: KOSAR/KHINR) that positions this cost center in the enterprise organizational tree. Used for roll-up reporting in P&L, EBITDA tracking, and budget consolidation.

attributes.name: internal_order_code
attributes.description: SAP Internal Order (AUFNR) code linked to this cost center for detailed cost monitoring of specific activities or projects (e.g., marketing campaigns, store remodels). Enables granular expense tracking beyond standard cost center reporting.

attributes.name: is_locked_for_posting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is currently locked against new financial postings (SAP lock indicator). True = no new postings allowed; False = postings permitted. Used during period-end close and cost center restructuring.

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is a statistical cost center (SAP field: STAT). Statistical cost centers receive postings for informational/reporting purposes only and do not carry real costs. True = statistical; False = real cost center.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this cost center record in the source system (SAP S/4HANA CO). Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and financial close reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the enterprise cost center hierarchy (1 = top/enterprise, higher numbers = more granular). Enables hierarchical roll-up queries for consolidated P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cost center as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (field: KTEXT). Describes the organizational unit, e.g., 'Store 042 - Chicago Loop', 'DC Atlanta', 'Corporate Finance'.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Profit Center (PRCTR) to which this cost center is assigned. Enables P&L reporting at the profit center level, supporting GMROI analysis and segment-level financial performance tracking.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal regional classification code for the cost center's geographic location (e.g., 'NORTHEAST', 'WEST', 'EMEA'). Supports regional P&L roll-up, comp sales (SSS) analysis, and regional budget allocation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this cost center master record was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA'). Supports data lineage, MDM golden record management via Informatica MDM, and audit traceability.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code

attributes.name: wbs_element_code

attributes.name: valid_from

attributes.name: budget_period

attributes.name: business_area_code

attributes.name: profit_center_category

attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center master record was first created in the source system (SAP CO-PCA). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and financial close governance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the profit center's local management reporting currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). All revenue, COGS, gross margin, and EBITDA figures for this profit center are reported in this currency. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category (principal quantitative context).

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this profit center was deactivated or archived. Null if the profit center is currently active. Used for historical P&L analysis, store closure reporting, and comp sales (SSS) exclusion logic.

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the profit center's purpose, scope, and the business unit it represents. Provides context for financial analysts, auditors, and management reporting consumers.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether intercompany transactions for this profit center are subject to elimination during consolidated financial reporting (True = elimination required). Used in group consolidation to remove internal P&L and balance sheet effects per FASB ASC 810.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal calendar for this profit center (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March). Determines period-end close dates, budget cycles, and financial reporting periods for EBITDA and P&L tracking.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the business function of this profit center (e.g., 'SALES', 'PRODUCTION', 'ADMIN', 'DISTRIBUTION'). Used for cost-of-sales accounting and P&L by function reporting per IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default General Ledger (GL) account code associated with this profit center for automatic account determination in SAP FI/CO. Used to route revenue and cost postings to the correct GL account during financial close.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the standard hierarchy node to which this profit center is assigned in SAP CO-PCA. Enables rollup P&L reporting across organizational levels (e.g., store → region → banner → enterprise). Used for segment reporting per ASC 280.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this profit center master record. Used for change data capture (CDC), MDM synchronization, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lease_accounting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center has active lease obligations subject to ASC 842 lease accounting (True = lease obligations exist). Triggers right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability recognition in the financial close process for store and DC profit centers.

attributes.name: profit_center_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this profit center within the management accounting hierarchy (e.g., 1 = enterprise, 2 = banner, 3 = region, 4 = store). Used for hierarchical P&L rollup, drill-down reporting, and segment aggregation.

attributes.name: mdm_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the authoritative source system from which this profit center master record was originated or last mastered (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA', 'INFORMATICA_MDM'). Supports data lineage, MDM golden record management, and audit traceability.

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the profit center (e.g., 'Chicago Flagship Store', 'US E-Commerce Channel', 'Private Label Apparel'). Used in P&L reports, dashboards, and management presentations. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial postings to this profit center are currently blocked (True = blocked, False = open). Set during financial close periods, audits, or when a profit center is being restructured. Prevents erroneous postings during sensitive periods.

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the profit center master record. 'active' — open for postings; 'inactive' — temporarily closed; 'locked' — blocked for new postings (e.g., during financial close); 'pending' — awaiting activation; 'archived' — historical record, no postings allowed. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the autonomous business unit represented by this profit center. Determines the nature of P&L reporting: 'store' (physical retail location), 'channel' (e-commerce, BOPIS, DSD), 'product_line' (private label, electronics, apparel), 'banner' (hypermarket, discount outlet), 'region' (geographic grouping), 'corporate' (shared services). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code to which this profit center belongs (e.g., 'NORTHEAST', 'MIDWEST', 'WEST_COAST', 'EMEA'). Used for regional P&L rollup, comp sales analysis, and management reporting by geography.

attributes.name: responsible_manager
attributes.description: Full name or employee ID of the manager accountable for this profit center's financial performance. Used in management reporting, budget approval workflows, and P&L accountability assignments in SAP CO-PCA.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Financial reporting segment assigned to this profit center per FASB ASC 280 (Segment Reporting). Maps profit centers to reportable segments (e.g., 'GROCERY', 'APPAREL', 'ECOMMERCE', 'INTERNATIONAL') for external financial disclosures and SEC filings.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the profit center used in space-constrained reports, POS system displays, and financial dashboards (e.g., 'CHI-FLAGSHIP', 'ECOM-US').

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: Physical store identifier associated with this profit center when profit_center_type is 'store'. Links to the store master for footfall, planogram, and comp sales (SSS) reporting. Null for non-store profit centers.

attributes.name: transfer_price_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfer pricing rules apply to transactions involving this profit center (True = transfer pricing active). Relevant for intercompany transactions between profit centers, particularly for cross-border operations subject to OECD transfer pricing guidelines.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this profit center is valid and open for financial postings in SAP CO-PCA. Defines the start of the profit center's active period for time-dependent master data management and fiscal year planning.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this profit center is valid for financial postings. After this date, the profit center is locked for new transactions. Null indicates an open-ended validity period. Used for profit center lifecycle management and financial close.

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger chart of accounts master data aligned to SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Defines every account used in financial postings including P&L accounts (revenue, COGS, operating expenses), balance sheet accounts (assets, liabilities, equity), and statistical accounts. Includes account type, financial statement version assignment, tax category, and FASB/GAAP classification.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the general ledger account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the gl_account master data product.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Add column chart_of_accounts_id (BIGINT) to finance.gl_account with FK to finance.chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id because GL accounts must belong to a chart of accounts. P11: connect_table: finance.gl_account** - add column chart_of_

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP account group (KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account. Groups accounts by functional category such as cash accounts, receivables, payables, revenue accounts, COGS accounts, and operating expense accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|receivables|payables|revenue|cogs|opex|assets|liabilities|equity|statistical — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: Extended descriptive name of the GL account providing full business context beyond the short name. Used in detailed financial reporting, audit documentation, and regulatory disclosures.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short description of the GL account as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (SKAT table). Used in financial statements, P&L reports, and EBITDA dashboards for display and labeling purposes.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known GL account number as defined in the SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts (SKA1/SKB1 tables). Used in all financial postings, journal entries, and regulatory reporting. Typically a 6–10 digit numeric code aligned to the company's account numbering scheme.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. 'active' permits financial postings; 'blocked' prevents new postings while retaining history; 'marked_for_deletion' flags the account for archival after period-end close; 'inactive' denotes accounts no longer in use. Maps to SAP field XSPEB (posting block) and XLOEV (deletion flag).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental classification of the GL account per GAAP balance sheet and income statement structure. Drives financial statement placement: asset/liability/equity for balance sheet; revenue/expense for P&L. Maps to SAP field KTOKS (account group) and XBILK (balance sheet indicator).

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Country-specific or group-level alternative account number used for local statutory reporting or group consolidation mapping. Enables cross-mapping between the operational chart of accounts and a group/statutory chart of accounts. Maps to SAP field ALTKT in SKB1.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a balance sheet account (True) or a P&L income statement account (False). Balance sheet accounts carry forward balances at year-end; P&L accounts are closed to retained earnings. Maps to SAP field XBILK in SKA1.

attributes.name: commitment_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment management (budget encumbrance) is active (True) for this GL account. When enabled, purchase orders and purchase requisitions create budget commitments against this account, supporting Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget control in merchandise planning.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which this GL account is active. Drives financial statement segregation, tax reporting, and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is linked to a CO (Controlling) cost element and its category. 'primary' cost elements correspond to P&L accounts (e.g., COGS, operating expenses); 'secondary' are internal allocation accounts; 'not_applicable' for balance sheet accounts. Drives EBITDA and P&L cost center reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GL account master record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and financial close process governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account currency in which balances are maintained (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). If set, postings to this account must be made in this currency. Maps to SAP field WAERS in SKB1.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is used to record deferred revenue (True), such as gift card liabilities, loyalty point deferrals, or advance payments not yet recognized under ASC 606. Supports balance sheet classification and revenue recognition scheduling.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account became active and available for financial postings. Supports temporal validity tracking for chart of accounts changes during fiscal year transitions and regulatory reporting periods.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this GL account is no longer valid for new financial postings. Null indicates an open-ended account with no planned expiry. Used to manage account lifecycle during chart of accounts restructuring and fiscal year-end close.

attributes.name: fasb_classification
attributes.description: FASB Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) topic or subtopic to which this GL account is primarily aligned (e.g., 'ASC 606' for revenue recognition accounts, 'ASC 842' for lease liability/ROU asset accounts, 'ASC 330' for inventory/COGS accounts). Supports FASB-compliant regulatory reporting and audit readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASC_606|ASC_842|ASC_330|ASC_350|ASC_360|ASC_420 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group code (e.g., G001, G004) assigned to this GL account that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry. Enforces data quality and completeness rules at the point of financial posting.

attributes.name: financial_statement_version
attributes.description: SAP Financial Statement Version (FSV) code that determines how this account is grouped and displayed in statutory financial statements (balance sheet, P&L). Supports GAAP, IFRS, and management reporting views. Maps to SAP table T011.

attributes.name: fs_item_code
attributes.description: The financial statement line item code to which this GL account is assigned within the Financial Statement Version. Enables aggregation of multiple GL accounts into a single P&L or balance sheet line for external reporting and FASB-compliant disclosures.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area classification that segments costs by business function for cost-of-sales P&L reporting (e.g., 'SALES', 'ADMIN', 'LOGISTICS', 'MARKETING', 'STORE_OPS'). Enables functional income statement presentation per IFRS IAS 1 and management reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales|administration|logistics|marketing|store_operations|ecommerce|supply_chain — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: house_bank_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a bank account (True) linked to a house bank in SAP FI-TR (Treasury). Bank GL accounts are used for cash management, bank reconciliation, and PCI DSS-compliant payment processing.

attributes.name: intercompany_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for intercompany transactions (True) between legal entities within the retail group. Intercompany accounts are eliminated during group consolidation. Maps to SAP intercompany account configuration.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this GL account master record in SAP S/4HANA. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit compliance, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control documentation.

attributes.name: lease_account_type
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account's role under FASB ASC 842 lease accounting. 'rou_asset' identifies Right-of-Use asset accounts for operating and finance leases; 'lease_liability' identifies corresponding liability accounts; 'lease_expense' identifies amortization/interest expense accounts; 'not_applicable' for non-lease accounts. Critical for ASC 842 compliance reporting in retail store lease portfolios.

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items posted to this account are stored and displayable (True) in the FI line item report. Required for accounts needing detailed transaction-level audit trails. Maps to SAP field XKRES in SKB1.

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is active (True) for this account, enabling individual line items to be matched and cleared (e.g., for clearing accounts, GR/IR accounts, bank clearing). Maps to SAP field XOPVW in SKB1.

attributes.name: planning_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is included in financial planning and budgeting processes (True). Planning-relevant accounts are available for budget entry in SAP BPC or S/4HANA Financial Planning, supporting annual budgeting and rolling forecast cycles.

attributes.name: posting_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial postings to this GL account are currently blocked (True) or permitted (False). A blocked account cannot receive new journal entries but retains its historical balance. Maps to SAP field XSPEB in SKA1/SKB1.

attributes.name: profit_center_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are distributed to profit centers (True) for segment and store-level P&L reporting. Profit center-relevant accounts enable comparable store sales (Comp Sales/SSS) analysis and GMROI reporting by retail location.

attributes.name: profit_loss_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the GL account within the P&L statement structure. Enables EBITDA tracking, gross margin analysis, and COGS reporting. 'revenue' includes net sales and other income; 'cogs' covers Cost of Goods Sold; 'gross_margin' is a subtotal indicator; 'operating_expense' covers SG&A and store operations; 'ebitda' marks EBITDA-relevant accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|cogs|gross_margin|operating_expense|ebitda|depreciation|interest|tax|not_applicable — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this GL account serves as a reconciliation (control) account for a subledger. 'customer' links to accounts receivable subledger; 'vendor' links to accounts payable subledger; 'asset' links to fixed asset subledger; 'none' indicates a standalone GL account. Maps to SAP field MITKZ in SKB1.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Specifies the ASC 606 revenue recognition pattern applicable to this revenue GL account. 'point_in_time' applies to standard retail POS and e-commerce sales; 'over_time' applies to gift card breakage, loyalty program deferrals, and subscription revenues; 'not_applicable' for non-revenue accounts. Drives automated revenue recognition scheduling in SAP FI.

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Three-digit SAP sort key that determines which document field is used to populate the allocation field in line items posted to this account (e.g., '001' = posting date, '012' = document number). Drives line item sorting in account statements and aging reports.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this GL account master record was ingested (e.g., 'SAP_S4HANA_PROD', 'SAP_S4HANA_QA'). Supports multi-system data lineage and Informatica MDM golden record traceability.

attributes.name: statistical_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical GL account (True) used for management reporting and KPI tracking without affecting the legal financial statements. Statistical accounts capture quantities or values for internal analytics such as footfall, units sold, or headcount.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Defines the tax relevance of the GL account for input/output tax determination. Controls whether tax codes are required, optional, or not applicable during posting. Maps to SAP field MWSKZ in SKB1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax|output_tax|not_relevant|tax_only|deferred_tax|use_tax — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_posting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax code is mandatory (True) when posting to this GL account. Enforces tax compliance controls at the point of financial entry, ensuring all taxable transactions are properly coded for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: SAP tolerance group assigned to this GL account that defines acceptable variance thresholds for payment differences, rounding, and clearing. Controls automatic clearing of small differences during accounts payable and receivable processing.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core general ledger journal entry header capturing all financial postings in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL, including accrual entries, scheduled reversals, and period-end closing entries. Records accounting documents for sales revenue, COGS, expense accruals, revenue accruals, deferred revenue, adjustments, intercompany eliminations, depreciation, lease expense, and reclassifications. Includes document type, posting date, fiscal period, company code, document/local currency, FX rate, reference document, posting status, accrual/reversal indicators, source module (FI-AP, FI-AR, FI-AA, FI-TX), and business justification. FASB-compliant audit trail for all financial transactions supporting accurate period-end P&L, balance sheet, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Primary key for the journal_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which the journal entry is assigned for management accounting and internal P&L reporting. Enables cost allocation across store operations, distribution centers, and corporate functions.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to specific fiscal periods. The journal_entry table has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to financial_period master. This FK enables joining to get period

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary General Ledger account associated with this journal entry header. In SAP FI-GL, the header-level GL account is used for document-level classification and routing. Supports P&L, balance sheet, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA ledger identifier specifying which accounting ledger the entry is posted to (e.g., '0L' = Leading Ledger for GAAP/FASB, 'N1' = Non-Leading Ledger for IFRS parallel accounting). Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP plant (store, distribution center, or warehouse) associated with this journal entry. Links financial postings to physical retail locations for store-level P&L, COGS, and inventory accounting (e.g., COGS postings from goods issue, DSD receipts).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO profit center for segment-level P&L reporting. Enables gross margin, EBITDA, and revenue tracking by business unit, store, or product category in retail financial reporting.

attributes.name: violation_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation_notice. Business justification: Retail violation notices (health dept fines, OSHA penalties, environmental citations) trigger financial postings for penalty accruals and payments. Finance links journal entries to notices for audit t

attributes.name: accrual_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an accrual posting (True) — i.e., an expense or revenue recognized in the current period but not yet cash-settled. Supports accrual accounting under FASB ASC 606 and period-end close processes.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry was approved for posting in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Distinct from entry_timestamp (creation) and posting_date (ledger date). Supports SOX audit trail and financial close process monitoring.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the approver who authorized the journal entry posting, particularly for parked documents and manual adjustments. Supports dual-control requirements under SOX Section 302/404 and internal audit controls.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: SAP FI assignment field (ZUONR) used for sorting and matching open items in accounts payable and receivable clearing. Typically populated with the purchase order number, sales order number, or payment reference for automated clearing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area code representing an organizational unit for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be created. Used in retail for segment reporting across hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets, and e-commerce channels.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA four-character company code identifying the legal entity or organizational unit for which the journal entry is posted. Aligns with the FI-GL company code configuration and supports intercompany elimination and entity-level P&L reporting.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal entry header represents a debit (D) or credit (C) posting at the document level. Fundamental double-entry bookkeeping indicator used in SAP FI-GL for balance validation and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry records deferred revenue (True) — i.e., cash received but revenue not yet recognized per FASB ASC 606 performance obligation criteria. Relevant for gift cards, loyalty points, subscription services, and BOPIS/ROPIS prepayments in retail.

attributes.name: document_amount
attributes.description: Gross total amount of the journal entry in the document (transaction) currency. Represents the sum of all debit or credit line items before netting. Used for financial reporting, reconciliation, and audit trail in retail P&L and balance sheet analysis.

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the transaction currency in which the journal entry amounts are originally recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Distinct from local/company code currency. Required for multi-currency retail operations and FX reporting.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract, etc.) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from the posting date and is used for aging analysis, vendor/customer reconciliation, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number uniquely identifying the journal entry within a company code and fiscal year. This is the externally-known business identifier used in audit trails, reconciliation, and cross-system references (e.g., EDI, ERP).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP FI two-character document type code classifying the nature of the accounting document (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AA=Asset Posting, AB=Accounting Document, ZP=Payment Clearing, RV=Revenue). Drives number range assignment and account type determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AA|AB|ZP|RV|KZ|DZ|WA|WE|RE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entered_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created the journal entry in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Required for FASB-compliant audit trail, SOX internal controls, and financial close accountability.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the journal entry record was first created and saved in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for audit trail and FASB-compliant financial close documentation.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by its accounting purpose: 'standard' = normal business transaction; 'accrual' = expense/revenue accrual; 'reversal' = reversal of a prior entry; 'adjustment' = period-end correction; 'intercompany' = elimination entry; 'depreciation' = fixed asset depreciation; 'lease' = ASC 842 lease expense; 'reclassification' = account reclassification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|accrual|reversal|adjustment|intercompany|depreciation|lease|reclassification|deferred_revenue|cogs — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16 in SAP, including special periods 13–16 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year in which the journal entry is posted. Critical for period-end close, accrual management, and financial reporting cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the journal entry is recorded (e.g., 2024). Used for period-end financial close, P&L reporting, and EBITDA tracking aligned with the retail fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP FI functional area code classifying the journal entry by business function for cost-of-sales P&L reporting (e.g., COGS, Selling, Administration, Distribution, Marketing). Supports income statement presentation under FASB ASC 606.

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to translate document currency amounts to local currency at the time of posting. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables. Critical for multi-currency retail operations, FX gain/loss accounting, and FASB ASC 830 compliance.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description or business justification entered at the journal entry header level in SAP FI-GL. Provides context for the posting (e.g., 'Q3 Rent Accrual', 'COGS Adjustment - Store 1042', 'Intercompany Elimination - FY2024 Q4'). Required for audit trail and financial close documentation.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry involves a transaction between two legal entities within the same corporate group (True). Used for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements under FASB ASC 810.

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was last modified in SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Supports audit trail requirements, change tracking, and financial close process monitoring.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the journal entry translated into the company code's local (functional) currency using the FX rate at posting date. Used for statutory P&L, balance sheet, and EBITDA reporting under FASB standards.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency. Used for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance. Amounts are translated from document currency to local currency using the FX rate.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and determines the fiscal period assignment. Distinct from the document date and entry date. Governs period-end P&L, balance sheet, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP FI two-digit posting key controlling the debit/credit assignment, account type, and field selection for the journal entry (e.g., 40=Debit G/L, 50=Credit G/L, 01=Customer Invoice, 31=Vendor Invoice). Fundamental SAP FI-GL configuration element.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the journal entry in the SAP FI-GL workflow. 'draft' = entry in preparation; 'posted' = fully posted to ledger; 'parked' = saved but not yet posted (pending approval); 'held' = temporarily saved; 'reversed' = entry has been reversed; 'error' = posting failed validation.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or cross-system reference document number associated with the journal entry (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, sales order number, EDI transaction reference). Enables cross-module and cross-system reconciliation in SAP FI-GL.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted document (True) or an original posting (False). Used in SAP FI-GL for accrual reversal management and period-end close processes.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP accounting document number of the original entry that this journal entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Provides the audit trail link between reversal and original posting for FASB-compliant financial close.

attributes.name: scheduled_reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which SAP S/4HANA is scheduled to automatically reverse this journal entry (typically the first day of the following period for accrual entries). Populated when accrual_indicator is True. Supports automated period-end close and accrual management.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA segment identifier for FASB ASC 280 segment reporting. Classifies the journal entry by reportable business segment (e.g., Grocery, Apparel, Electronics, E-Commerce, Private Label). Enables segment-level P&L and EBITDA disclosure.

attributes.name: source_module
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA module that originated the journal entry posting (e.g., FI-AP=Accounts Payable, FI-AR=Accounts Receivable, FI-AA=Asset Accounting, FI-TX=Tax Accounting, MM=Materials Management, SD=Sales & Distribution, CO=Controlling).
