attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount (sales tax, VAT, or use tax) included in or associated with the journal entry in document currency. Relevant for FI-TX (Tax Accounting) postings and compliance with FTC pricing transparency and FDA labeling requirements for grocery retail.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the intercompany trading partner involved in this journal entry. Populated only when intercompany_indicator is True. Required for intercompany reconciliation and elimination in consolidated P&L and balance sheet reporting.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each general ledger journal entry, representing individual debit and credit postings to GL accounts. Captures GL account, cost center, profit center, amount in document and local currency, tax code, assignment field, and line item text. Enables drill-down from financial statements to source transactions. Aligns to SAP FI-GL line item table (BSEG).

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry line item in the general ledger. Primary key for this silver-layer data product, aligned to SAP FI-GL line item table (BSEG).

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this line item posting, corresponding to SAP BSEG-KOSTL. Enables cost allocation and departmental P&L reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL account to which this line item is posted, corresponding to SAP BSEG-HKONT. Drives P&L, balance sheet, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header (BKPF in SAP FI) to which this line item belongs. Enables drill-down from financial statements to individual debit/credit postings.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center associated with this line item, corresponding to SAP BSEG-PRCTR. Supports segment-level P&L and EBITDA reporting by business unit or store.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.purchase_order. Business justification: Line-level detail for PO-related postings including freight charges, import duties, and purchase price variances. Supports detailed cost accounting and variance analysis required in retail operations.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type indicator (KOART): A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor), K=Vendor (Creditor), M=Material, S=GL Account. Determines the sub-ledger reconciliation account and financial statement classification.

attributes.name: amount_doc_currency
attributes.description: The transaction amount in the document (transaction) currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-WRBTR. Used for multi-currency financial reporting and foreign exchange analysis.

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: The transaction amount translated to the group (consolidation) currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-KURSF-derived group currency amount. Supports consolidated P&L and EBITDA reporting across all legal entities.

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The transaction amount translated to the company code local currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-DMBTR. Used for statutory financial reporting and local GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: assignment
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field used for line item sorting and allocation, corresponding to SAP BSEG-ZUONR. Typically populated with a reference number (e.g., purchase order, cost object) to facilitate reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code (GSBER) representing an organizational unit for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be created. Used for segment reporting across store formats (hypermarket, e-commerce, discount).

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared (AUGDT in SAP BSEG). Null for uncleared items. Used for days-payable-outstanding (DPO) and days-sales-outstanding (DSO) calculations.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP clearing document number (AUGBL) assigned when this open item is cleared against a payment or offsetting entry. Null for uncleared items. Used in accounts payable/receivable reconciliation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity for which this journal entry line is posted. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this journal entry line record was first created in the system, corresponding to SAP BKPF-CPUDT and CPUTM combined. Used for audit trail, financial close monitoring, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting, corresponding to SAP BSEG-SHKZG. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and trial balance validation.

attributes.name: doc_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the document (transaction) currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-WAERS. Enables multi-currency P&L and balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (invoice, receipt, etc.), corresponding to SAP BSEG-BLDAT. May differ from posting date; used for accrual and cutoff analysis.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code (e.g., SA=GL posting, KR=vendor invoice, DR=customer invoice, AB=accounting document), corresponding to SAP BKPF-BLART. Classifies the nature of the journal entry for reporting and audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AB|KZ|DZ|WA|WE|RE|RV — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate the document currency amount to local currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-KURSF. Used for FX gain/loss analysis and multi-currency reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal posting period (1–16, including special periods) within the fiscal year, corresponding to SAP BSEG-MONAT. Drives monthly financial close and period-end reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this journal entry line is posted, corresponding to SAP BSEG-GJAHR. Used for annual financial close, budgeting, and year-over-year P&L comparisons.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area (FKBER) used for cost-of-sales accounting, classifying expenses by business function (e.g., COGS, selling, administration, distribution). Supports P&L by function reporting.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP internal order (AUFNR) to which this line item is assigned. Used for project-level cost tracking, capital expenditure monitoring, and marketing campaign cost allocation.

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry line has been reversed (True) or is active (False), derived from SAP BKPF-STBLG. Reversed entries must be excluded from financial statement totals to prevent double-counting.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: SAP ledger group (LDGRP) identifying the accounting principle under which this line is posted (e.g., leading ledger for GAAP, non-leading ledger for IFRS). Supports parallel accounting for multi-GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text for this journal entry line item, corresponding to SAP BSEG-SGTXT. Provides narrative context for auditors, financial analysts, and during financial close review.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent journal entry, corresponding to SAP BSEG-BUZEI. Used to order and uniquely identify each debit or credit posting within a document.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-PSWSL. Required for statutory reporting and local GAAP financial statements.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR in BSEG) corresponding to the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) associated with this line item. Populated for inventory valuation, COGS, and goods movement postings. Enables drill-down from GL to product-level cost analysis.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this line item is posted to the general ledger, corresponding to SAP BSEG-BUDAT. Determines the fiscal period and year for financial reporting.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit SAP posting key (BSCHL) that determines the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field selection for this line item. Examples: 40=GL debit, 50=GL credit, 31=vendor credit, 01=customer debit.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity associated with this line item (MENGE in SAP BSEG), applicable for material-related postings such as goods receipts, inventory adjustments, and COGS entries. Enables unit-level cost analysis.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (XBLNR from BKPF) such as a vendor invoice number, purchase order number, or customer order number. Enables cross-system reconciliation between ERP and source operational systems.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the reversing entry (STBLG from BKPF), if this line has been reversed. Enables audit trail tracing from original posting to reversal for financial close and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special GL indicator (UMSKZ) used for down payments, guarantees, and other special transactions that are posted to alternative reconciliation accounts. Blank for standard postings.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (VAT/sales tax) associated with this line item in document currency, corresponding to SAP BSEG-WMWST. Required for tax compliance reporting and accounts payable/receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code assigned to this line item for VAT/sales tax determination, corresponding to SAP BSEG-MWSKZ. Drives tax reporting, compliance, and accounts payable/receivable tax calculations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (MEINS in SAP BSEG), such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), or CS (case). Required for material-related GL postings to support COGS and inventory valuation analysis.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and bank reconciliation purposes, corresponding to SAP BSEG-VALUT. Used in treasury and accounts payable/receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP WBS element (PROJK) for project-based cost assignment, corresponding to capital expenditure projects such as store openings, DC expansions, or IT implementations. Supports CAPEX tracking and ASC 842 lease accounting.

Standard AP three-way match process in retail supply chain.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: SAP automatic payment program run identifier (F110 run ID combining run date and identification key) that processed this invoice for payment. Used to trace payment execution and remittance details.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: AP invoices have profit_center_code (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This FK enables P&L allocation and profit center reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is matched during three-way match (PO/GR/Invoice) processing in SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) master record who issued this invoice. Links to the supplier/vendor master in SAP S/4HANA MM and Informatica MDM golden record.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the invoice payment as a vendor compliance penalty (chargeback) for violations such as late delivery, labeling errors, or EDI non-compliance. Reduces net payment to vendor.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the open AP invoice item was cleared (settled) in the SAP FI-AP subledger, either by payment, credit memo offset, or manual clearing. Marks the end of the invoice lifecycle.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number of the clearing transaction (AUGBL) that settled this invoice item. Enables full audit trail from invoice receipt through payment clearing for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity or organizational unit responsible for this AP invoice. Determines the chart of accounts, fiscal year variant, and currency for financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the AP invoice record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA FI-AP) or ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage for period-end close.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: Last date by which payment must be made to capture the early payment cash discount offered by the vendor (e.g., 2/10 Net 30 — discount expires on day 10). Critical for cash discount capture optimization.

attributes.name: dispute_reason

Drives dispute resolution workflow and vendor communication in SAP FI-AP and Salesforce Service Cloud. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_discrepancy|quantity_discrepancy|duplicate_invoice|missing_po|quality_issue|chargeback|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date plus payment terms net days in SAP FI-AP.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company code local currency at the time of posting. Used for foreign currency AP revaluation and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year (GJAHR) in which the invoice is posted. Used for period-end AP close, financial reporting, and year-over-year AP aging and spend analysis.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number (MBLNR) for the goods receipt that is matched against this invoice during three-way match. Confirms that goods or services were received before payment is authorized.

attributes.name: gross_amount

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date printed on the vendor invoice document. Used as the baseline date for payment terms calculation (e.g., Net 30 from invoice date) and cash discount eligibility. Corresponds to BLDAT in SAP FI.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned invoice number as provided by the vendor on the invoice document. Used for vendor reconciliation, EDI matching, and dispute resolution. Corresponds to BELNR field in SAP FI-AP.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the AP invoice through the invoice-to-payment cycle. Drives AP aging analysis, payment run eligibility, and period-end close. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|approved|posted|scheduled|paid|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type as defined in SAP FI-AP document type configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|credit_memo|debit_memo|recurring|intercompany|proforma — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_edi_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice was received electronically via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transmission from the vendor, as opposed to paper or email. EDI invoices (e.g., ANSI X12 810) enable straight-through processing.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., monthly rent, lease payments under ASC 842, or standing service contracts). Recurring invoices are auto-generated in SAP FI-AP.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net payable amount after applying all applicable discounts, deductions, and chargebacks. Represents the actual cash outflow obligation. Used for cash flow forecasting and AP aging analysis.

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: Indicator specifying whether and why the invoice is blocked from automatic payment processing. Corresponds to ZLSPR in SAP FI-AP. A value of 'none' means the invoice is eligible for the next payment run.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which payment was executed and disbursed to the vendor via the selected payment method (ACH, wire, check). Populated upon successful payment run completion in SAP FI-AP.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number generated for the payment transaction that clears this invoice. Used for bank reconciliation, remittance advice, and audit trail of the payment-to-invoice clearing.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the invoice will be or was settled (e.g., ACH electronic transfer, wire transfer, check, virtual card, EFT). Corresponds to ZLSCH in SAP FI-AP and determines payment run processing logic.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (ZTERM) defining the agreed payment conditions with the vendor, including net days, discount percentages, and discount periods (e.g., ZB14 = 2% 10 days Net 30). Drives due date and discount date calculation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was posted to the SAP general ledger and AP subledger. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting and period-end close. Corresponds to BUDAT in SAP FI.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor invoice was physically or electronically received by the AP department. Used to measure invoice processing cycle time and SLA compliance for vendor payment.

attributes.name: remittance_reference

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: Internal SAP FI document number (BELNR) assigned upon posting of the invoice in SAP S/4HANA. Used for cross-reference with the general ledger and FI-AP subledger.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) included in or applicable to the invoice as determined by SAP FI tax code configuration. Required for tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way matching process comparing the purchase order (PO), goods receipt (GR), and vendor invoice quantities and amounts in SAP FI-AP/MM. Exceptions require AP team resolution before payment approval.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the AP invoice record, including status changes, payment updates, or dispute resolution actions. Supports change data capture (CDC) and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the vendor bank account used for payment disbursement. Stored in compliance with PCI DSS requirements. Full account details are maintained in SAP FI-AP vendor master banking data.

attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (sales tax, VAT, or applicable jurisdiction tax). Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the AR invoice record in the source system. Supports change data capture and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible bad debt for this invoice. Used for bad debt expense reporting, allowance for doubtful accounts calculation, and FASB-compliant AR reserve management.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice balance was written off as bad debt in SAP FI-AR. Null until a write-off is executed. Required for bad debt aging and allowance for doubtful accounts reporting.

products.name: revenue_recognition_event
products.description: ASC 606 revenue recognition event capturing the five-step revenue recognition model for retail transactions including gift card breakage, loyalty point redemptions, franchise fees, and extended warranties. Records performance obligation identification, transaction price allocation, satisfaction date, recognized amount, deferred revenue balance, and contract modification events. Ensures FASB ASC 606 compliance.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ASC 606 revenue recognition event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for the revenue-generating activity, used for P&L reporting and EBITDA tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account to which the recognized revenue amount is posted in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer contract or sales agreement under which this revenue recognition event is triggered. Aligns with ASC 606 Step 1: Identify the contract with a customer.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store or e-commerce channel location where the originating transaction occurred. Supports comp sales and SSS (Same-Store Sales) reporting.

attributes.name: original_event_revenue_recognition_event_id
attributes.description: For reversal or adjustment events, the revenue_recognition_event_id of the original recognition event being reversed or corrected. Null for original (non-reversal) events. Supports audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer party associated with the contract generating this revenue recognition event. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition events do not have a profit_center FK. In retail, revenue is tracked by profit center (store, channel, product line) for P&L reporting. This FK enables P&L allocation for ASC 606 r

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this revenue recognition event is posted. Used for period-end financial close, P&L reporting, and EBITDA tracking in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

attributes.name: allocated_transaction_price
attributes.description: The portion of the total transaction price allocated to this specific performance obligation under ASC 606 Step 4 (Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations), based on relative standalone selling prices.

attributes.name: asc606_step
attributes.description: Identifies which of the five ASC 606 revenue recognition steps this event record primarily documents: Step 1 (Identify contract), Step 2 (Identify performance obligations), Step 3 (Determine transaction price), Step 4 (Allocate transaction price), Step 5 (Recognize revenue). Supports compliance audit and FASB disclosure reporting.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel through which the originating transaction was executed. Supports omnichannel revenue disaggregation per ASC 606-10-50-5. BOPIS = Buy Online Pick Up In Store; ROPIS = Reserve Online Pick Up In Store.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: The cost of goods sold (COGS) associated with the recognized revenue event. Used to compute gross margin and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) at the transaction level for P&L reporting.

attributes.name: contract_modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event was triggered by a contract modification (e.g., price change, scope change, return, exchange). True = event results from a contract modification per ASC 606-10-25-10 through 25-13.

attributes.name: contract_modification_type
attributes.description: The accounting treatment applied to the contract modification per ASC 606. 'new_contract' = treated as a separate contract; 'modification_existing' = prospective adjustment to existing contract; 'cumulative_catchup' = cumulative catch-up adjustment to revenue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and financial close process monitoring.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this recognition event (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retail operations and FASB foreign currency translation.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unrecognized revenue balance for this performance obligation as of the recognition event date. Represents the contract liability on the balance sheet per ASC 606. Applicable for gift cards, extended warranties, and loyalty programs.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this revenue recognition event, formatted as RRE- followed by a 10-digit sequence. Used for audit trails, financial close reconciliation, and FASB ASC 606 compliance reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this revenue recognition event belongs. Supports annual P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, and year-over-year comp sales analysis.

attributes.name: gift_card_breakage_rate
attributes.description: The estimated breakage rate (as a decimal proportion, e.g., 0.0850 = 8.50%) applied to gift card balances to recognize breakage income proportionally as redemptions occur. Applicable only when revenue_category = 'gift_card_breakage'. Based on historical redemption patterns per ASC 606-10-55-48.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: The gross margin amount for this recognition event, calculated as recognized_amount minus cogs_amount. Supports P&L reporting and EBITDA tracking at the transaction level.

attributes.name: loyalty_point_fair_value
attributes.description: The estimated standalone selling price (fair value) per loyalty point at the time of the originating transaction, used for transaction price allocation under ASC 606 Step 4. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: The number of loyalty program points redeemed in this recognition event. Used to calculate the standalone selling price of the loyalty performance obligation and the allocated transaction price for loyalty redemptions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the finance team regarding this revenue recognition event, such as rationale for variable consideration estimates, contract modification details, or audit reviewer comments.

attributes.name: obligation_satisfaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the distinct performance obligation was fully satisfied (e.g., delivery date for product sale, activation date for extended warranty, redemption date for loyalty points). Aligns with ASC 606 Step 5.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue recognition journal entry was posted to the General Ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. May differ from transaction_date due to period-end cut-off adjustments or delayed recognition.

attributes.name: recognition_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the revenue recognition period for over-time performance obligations (e.g., extended warranty coverage end, franchise agreement expiry). Null for point-in-time recognition events.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: ASC 606 Step 5 recognition pattern. 'point_in_time' = revenue recognized at a single moment (e.g., product sale, gift card redemption); 'over_time' = revenue recognized progressively (e.g., extended warranty, franchise fee, subscription).

attributes.name: recognition_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the revenue recognition period for over-time performance obligations (e.g., extended warranty coverage start, franchise agreement commencement). Null for point-in-time recognition events.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue recognition event. 'pending' = awaiting performance obligation satisfaction; 'recognized' = revenue posted to GL; 'deferred' = revenue deferred to future period; 'reversed' = recognition reversed due to contract modification or return; 'cancelled' = event voided.

attributes.name: recognition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the performance obligation was satisfied and revenue was recognized in the General Ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp for this entity.

attributes.name: recognized_amount
attributes.description: The actual revenue amount recognized in the current accounting period for this event. For point-in-time recognition, equals the allocated transaction price. For over-time recognition, represents the portion earned in the current period.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue stream type per ASC 606 disaggregation disclosure requirements. Covers retail-specific categories including gift card breakage (unredeemed gift card income), loyalty point redemptions, franchise fees, extended warranties, and standard product sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_sale|gift_card_breakage|loyalty_redemption|franchise_fee|extended_warranty|service_fee — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recognition event is a reversal of a previously posted revenue entry (e.g., due to a return, contract cancellation, or correction). True = this is a reversal entry with a negative recognized_amount.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The business document number of the originating transaction (e.g., SAP sales order number, POS transaction ID, invoice number) that generated this revenue recognition event. Used for end-to-end audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: The type of originating source document that triggered this revenue recognition event. Supports audit trail and reconciliation back to SAP S/4HANA SD module or SAP CAR POS transaction data.

attributes.name: standalone_selling_price
attributes.description: The standalone selling price (SSP) of the performance obligation at contract inception, used as the basis for transaction price allocation under ASC 606 Step 4. Determined by observable prices, adjusted market assessment, or expected cost plus margin approach.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the originating retail transaction (POS sale, e-commerce order, gift card purchase, etc.) occurred. Used for period-end revenue cut-off and financial close.

attributes.name: transaction_price
attributes.description: The total transaction price allocated to the contract as determined under ASC 606 Step 3 (Determine the transaction price). Represents the gross amount before allocation to individual performance obligations. Includes variable consideration estimates.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks updates from contract modifications, reversals, or period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: variable_consideration_amount
attributes.description: The estimated variable consideration included in the transaction price (e.g., volume discounts, rebates, returns allowances, markdown adjustments). Constrained per ASC 606 variable consideration constraint guidance.

products.name: finance_budget
products.description: [SSOT Owner] Authoritative source for all organizational budgets and financial plans. Tracks planned, committed, actual, and forecast amounts across cost centers, profit centers, and GL accounts.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each budget record in the financial planning system. Primary key for the budget data product in SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Retail compliance programs (food safety, PCI, OSHA) have dedicated budget allocations. Compliance managers track planned vs actual spending against programs for annual planning and variance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center or profit center responsible for this budget line. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO cost center master data for P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: DC operating budgets (labor, utilities, equipment) are planned and tracked by facility. Standard retail budgeting process requires facility-level budget allocation and variance reporting.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Budget records are tied to specific fiscal periods. The budget table has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) as separate columns, but no FK to the financial_period master. This FK enables joinin

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account associated with this budget line item, enabling line-item granularity for financial reporting and FASB-compliant disclosures.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail business unit (e.g., hypermarket, e-commerce, department store) to which this budget is allocated, supporting channel-level P&L and EBITDA projections.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plan version record defining whether this budget entry belongs to the original budget, revised budget, rolling forecast, or annual plan. Maps to SAP CO plan version.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual financial amount posted to the GL account and cost center for this budget period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI actuals for budget vs. actual variance analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record received final approval from the authorized approver. Required for audit trail and financial governance compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the budget record within the financial planning approval cycle. Tracks progression from draft through submission, review, approval, rejection, or period lock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|locked — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the financial authority (e.g., CFO, Finance Director, Cost Center Manager) who approved this budget record. Supports approval workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level financial classification of the budget line: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), Operating Expenditure (OPEX), Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), labor costs, or revenue. Drives P&L and EBITDA reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the budget record, used in financial planning communications, approval workflows, and audit trails. Format: BDG-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The retail channel (store, e-commerce, omnichannel, wholesale, marketplace) for which this budget is planned. Enables channel-level revenue, COGS, and gross margin projections.

attributes.name: cogs_projection
attributes.description: Planned Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for the budget period, used to project gross margin and support merchandise planning and Open to Buy (OTB) calculations.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the budget that has been formally committed through purchase orders or contracts but not yet expensed. Supports Open to Buy (OTB) integration and encumbrance accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the financial planning system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and financial close process tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency financial planning and consolidation.

attributes.name: ebitda_projection
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Projection
attributes.description: Planned Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) for the budget period. Key metric for investor financial guidance and enterprise P&L reporting.

tag_set.value: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Projection

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (1–13, where 13 is a special closing period) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Supports monthly and period-level budget vs. actual variance analysis in SAP CO.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) within the fiscal year for this budget record. Used for quarterly reforecast cycles, investor financial guidance, and quarterly P&L reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this budget record applies. Aligns with the retail fiscal calendar in SAP S/4HANA FI for annual financial planning and investor guidance.

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The latest forward-looking financial estimate for this budget line, updated during rolling forecast or reforecast cycles. Used for forecast vs. prior forecast variance analysis and investor guidance.

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to derive the forecast or budget amounts: top-down (executive-driven allocation), bottom-up (cost center aggregation), driver-based (KPI-linked), statistical (model-driven), or zero-based budgeting.

attributes.name: gross_margin_projection
attributes.description: Planned gross margin (revenue minus COGS) for the budget period and business unit. Supports Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis and financial close reporting.

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record has been locked for the period, preventing further edits. True when the period is closed or the budget has been formally locked post-approval.

attributes.name: is_reforecast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record represents a reforecast (True) rather than the original budget plan (False). Distinguishes reforecast iterations from baseline budget entries for variance tracking.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record was locked to prevent further modifications, typically at period-end close. Supports financial close process integrity and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for financial planners to document assumptions, rationale, or commentary associated with this budget record. Supports audit trail and management review during financial planning cycles.

attributes.name: otb_amount
attributes.description: The Open to Buy (OTB) amount representing the remaining purchasing budget available for merchandise procurement in this period. Calculated as planned inventory budget minus committed and received inventory costs.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period covered by this budget record. Defines the effective close of the budget window for financial reporting and period-end close processes.

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period covered by this budget record. Defines the effective beginning of the budget window for financial close and reporting alignment.

attributes.name: plan_version_type
attributes.description: Classifies the budget record by planning cycle type: original budget (initial annual plan), revised budget (approved amendment), rolling forecast (monthly update), quarterly reforecast, or annual plan. Maps to SAP CO plan version category.

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The original planned financial amount for this budget line item in the functional currency. Represents the baseline against which actuals and forecasts are compared in budget vs. actual reporting.

attributes.name: prior_forecast_amount
attributes.description: The forecast amount from the immediately preceding forecast cycle, retained for forecast vs. prior forecast variance analysis and trend tracking in financial planning.

attributes.name: revenue_projection
attributes.description: Forward-looking revenue estimate for the business unit and channel in this budget period. Supports top-line financial planning, investor guidance, and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) tracking.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget record was formally submitted for approval in the financial planning workflow. Supports submission tracking and planning cycle compliance.

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the person who submitted this budget record for approval. Supports submission tracking and financial planning accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between planned amount and actual amount (actual_amount minus planned_amount) for this budget line. Positive value indicates overspend; negative indicates underspend. Supports budget vs. actual reporting.

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage variance between planned and actual amounts ((actual - planned) / planned * 100). Used in financial dashboards and P&L reporting to flag material variances requiring management action.

products.name: financial_period
products.description: Fiscal calendar and financial period master defining the retail fiscal year structure (4-5-4 or 4-4-5 calendar), accounting periods, quarter boundaries, and year-end close dates. Includes period open/close status, period type (regular, adjustment, closing), and fiscal year variant. Controls posting periods in SAP S/4HANA FI and drives financial close scheduling.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the financial period record in the retail fiscal calendar. Primary key for the financial_period data product.

attributes.name: comparable_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding financial period in the prior fiscal year used for same-store sales (SSS/Comp Sales) and year-over-year (YoY) financial comparisons. Accounts for 53-week year shifts in the NRF retail calendar.

attributes.name: primary_prior_year_period_financial_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exact same period number in the immediately preceding fiscal year. Used for year-over-year (YoY) financial variance analysis, P&L comparisons, and FASB comparative financial statement preparation. Distinct from comparable_period_id which accounts for 53-week calendar shifts.

attributes.name: ap_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts payable (AP) postings are permitted for this financial period. AP periods may be managed independently from GL periods in SAP S/4HANA to support vendor invoice processing timelines and COGS accruals.

attributes.name: ar_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts receivable (AR) postings are permitted for this financial period. AR periods may be managed independently to support customer payment processing, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and loyalty program financial settlements.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the budget or plan version associated with this financial period (e.g., 'ORIGINAL', 'REVISED_Q2', 'FORECAST_V3'). Links the period to the corresponding financial plan in SAP CO for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial planning cycles.

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: The retail fiscal calendar convention used for this period. The 4-5-4 and 4-4-5 calendars are NRF industry standards that divide the fiscal year into 4-week and 5-week periods to align comparable store sales (SSS) reporting across years.

attributes.name: close_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days allocated for completing the financial close process for this period (from period end date to scheduled close date). A KPI for finance operations efficiency; industry benchmark for retail is typically 5–10 business days for month-end close.

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Status of the financial close process for this period. Tracks progression through the month-end or year-end close cycle. 'not_started' indicates close activities have not begun; 'in_progress' means close tasks are underway; 'completed' means the period is fully closed and reconciled; 'reopened' means a closed period was reopened for corrections.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code (Buchungskreis) to which this financial period configuration applies. A company code represents an independent legal entity within the retail enterprise (e.g., a specific banner, subsidiary, or country operation).

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code associated with this financial period. The controlling area defines the organizational unit for cost accounting, P&L reporting, and EBITDA tracking within SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial period record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and financial close governance per ISO 27001 and FASB standards.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the functional currency of the company code during this financial period (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Governs currency translation for consolidated P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the financial period (inclusive). Defines the upper boundary for transaction posting, revenue recognition cutoff, and financial close. For 53-week fiscal years, the final period end date may extend one week beyond the standard calendar.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The retail fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Retail fiscal years may not align with the calendar year; typically begins in late January or early February per the 4-5-4 or 4-4-5 retail calendar convention.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal year structure (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March, or a custom retail variant). Determines how posting periods map to calendar months in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.

attributes.name: gl_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether general ledger (GL) journal entry postings are currently permitted for this financial period. Derived from posting_status but maintained as an explicit business flag for integration with downstream systems that check posting eligibility.

attributes.name: is_53_week_year
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fiscal year containing this period is a 53-week year. Under the NRF 4-5-4 calendar, a 53rd week occurs approximately every 5–6 years to realign the fiscal calendar with the Gregorian calendar. Impacts comparable store sales (SSS) comparisons and year-over-year financial analysis.

attributes.name: is_adjustment_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (periods 13–16 in SAP) used exclusively for year-end audit adjustments, accrual reversals, and FASB-required restatements. Adjustment periods do not correspond to calendar time.

attributes.name: is_quarter_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is the final period of a fiscal quarter, triggering quarterly close procedures, quarterly P&L reporting, and SEC 10-Q filing preparation for publicly traded retail entities.

attributes.name: is_year_end_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this period is the final period of the fiscal year requiring year-end close procedures, including balance sheet finalization, retained earnings posting, and annual financial statement preparation per FASB standards.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA ledger group identifier that this period applies to (e.g., '0L' for leading ledger, 'L1' for local GAAP ledger, 'L2' for IFRS ledger). Supports parallel accounting for multi-GAAP retail entities operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: mm_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials management (MM) postings — including goods receipts, inventory adjustments, and COGS postings — are permitted for this financial period in SAP S/4HANA MM module. Critical for inventory valuation and COGS accuracy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary associated with this financial period (e.g., 'Holiday season period — extended close window', 'Includes 53rd week adjustment', 'Restatement applied per ASC 606 guidance'). Used by finance teams for period-specific documentation.

attributes.name: period_close_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the financial period was officially closed in SAP S/4HANA FI, preventing further postings. Critical for financial close scheduling, audit compliance, and FASB revenue recognition cutoff enforcement.

attributes.name: period_length_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in the financial period (typically 28 or 35 days for 4-week or 5-week NRF periods). Used for daily average calculations, proration of fixed costs, and lease accounting (ASC 842) period allocations.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the financial period (e.g., 'FY2024 Period 1', 'Q1 FY2024 Week 1', 'January 2024'). Used in financial reports, P&L statements, and EBITDA dashboards for period labeling.

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year (1–12 for regular periods, 13–16 for special/adjustment periods). Maps to SAP S/4HANA posting period (MONAT) in table BKPF. Controls which periods are open for posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: period_open_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the posting period was officially opened for journal entry postings in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for financial close audit trails and compliance with FASB reporting timelines.

attributes.name: period_short_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code uniquely identifying the financial period across systems (e.g., 'FY2024P01', 'FY2024P13'). Used as a business key for cross-system integration between SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS), and financial reporting tools.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the period by its accounting purpose. 'regular' periods are standard operating periods; 'adjustment' periods are used for year-end adjustments; 'closing' periods are used for financial close entries; 'opening' periods for balance carryforward; 'special' for audit or correction postings.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current open/close status of the posting period in the general ledger. 'open' allows new journal entries; 'closed' prevents further postings; 'blocked' restricts posting pending review; 'future' indicates the period is not yet active. Controls SAP S/4HANA FI posting period management (OB52).

attributes.name: quarter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable fiscal quarter label (e.g., 'Q1 FY2024', 'Q4 FY2023'). Used in financial reporting dashboards, investor relations materials, and comparable store sales (SSS/Comp Sales) analysis.

attributes.name: quarter_number
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter (1–4) to which this period belongs within the fiscal year. Used for quarterly P&L reporting, EBITDA tracking, and SEC/FASB quarterly financial disclosures.

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously closed financial period was reopened for additional postings or corrections. Populated only when close_status is 'reopened'. Supports audit trail requirements for FASB restatements.

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reopening a previously closed financial period (e.g., 'Audit adjustment required', 'Revenue recognition restatement per ASC 606', 'Vendor chargeback correction'). Required for SOX compliance and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: scheduled_close_date
attributes.description: The planned/target date for completing the financial close process for this period, as defined in the financial close calendar. Used to track close cycle performance and SLA adherence for the finance operations team.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the financial period. Defines the inclusive lower boundary for transaction posting, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial close scheduling.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this financial period record (e.g., status change, reopen event, close date update). Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: week_number
attributes.description: Fiscal week number within the fiscal year (1–52 or 1–53 for 53-week years). Critical for weekly retail performance reporting, same-store sales (SSS) comparisons, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning cycles.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master and depreciation lifecycle record for retail capital assets including store fixtures, POS terminals, warehouse equipment, vehicles, and leasehold improvements in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA. Captures asset class, acquisition details, useful life, depreciation method and key, periodic depreciation run results (run date, depreciation amount, depreciation area), accumulated depreciation, net book value, and asset location. Supports CAPEX tracking, monthly depreciation close, GAAP vs. tax book reconciliation, EBITDA reporting (D&A add-back), and FASB ASC 360 impairment testing.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Material handling equipment, racking systems, and automation assets are assigned to specific distribution centers. Required for asset management, depreciation allocation, and facility-level P&L report

attributes.name: fixed_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for the custody and maintenance of the asset. Used for accountability and asset tracking.

attributes.name: fixed_created_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the fixed asset record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: fixed_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the fixed asset record. Audit trail for change accountability.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: Fixed assets have lease_indicator_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating whether the asset is leased, but no FK to lease_contract. This FK links leased assets to their governing lease contracts (ASC 842 compliance

attributes.name: primary_fixed_gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor from whom the asset was purchased. Links to accounts payable and procurement records.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total cumulative depreciation expense recognized since acquisition. Subtracted from acquisition cost to calculate net book value.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or capitalized cost of the fixed asset including installation and setup costs. Basis for depreciation calculation.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was acquired or placed in service. Marks the start of the depreciation lifecycle.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code defining the type of fixed asset (e.g., store fixtures, POS terminals, warehouse equipment, vehicles, leasehold improvements). Determines depreciation rules and useful life.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset including make, model, and distinguishing characteristics.

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location of the asset (store number, distribution center code, warehouse ID, or corporate office location).

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset identifier assigned by the enterprise asset management system. Used for physical tagging and tracking.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Active assets are in service and depreciating; under construction assets are capitalized but not yet depreciating; retired/disposed assets are no longer in use.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was capitalized and added to the fixed asset register. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts (acquisition cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value).

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area code distinguishing book depreciation (GAAP) from tax depreciation and other parallel valuations (e.g., 01=book, 15=tax).

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key code that defines the calculation rule, useful life, and period control for depreciation runs.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense. Straight-line is most common for retail fixed assets.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received from sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the asset has been identified for impairment testing under FASB ASC 360. True if impairment indicators are present.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized when the carrying value exceeds the recoverable amount. Reduces net book value and is reported in P&L.

attributes.name: last_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Depreciation expense amount posted in the most recent depreciation run. Used for monthly P&L reporting and EBITDA add-back calculation.

attributes.name: last_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic depreciation calculation run for this asset. Updated monthly during financial close.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the asset.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or part number identifying the specific asset configuration or variant.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the asset's value on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the asset was procured. Provides audit trail to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired from service or disposed. Marks the end of the depreciation lifecycle.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Subtracted from acquisition cost to determine depreciable base.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique equipment identifier for trackable assets such as POS terminals, vehicles, and warehouse equipment.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years as determined by asset class and accounting policy. Used to calculate annual depreciation.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires. Used for maintenance planning and risk assessment.

products.name: lease_contract
products.description: Retail lease contract master record with full payment lifecycle for store locations, DC facilities, and equipment leases under FASB ASC 842. Captures lessor, lease term, classification (operating vs. finance), ROU asset value, lease liability, incremental borrowing rate, payment schedule with individual payment records (payment date, amount, principal/interest split, variable lease payments), ROU amortization, lease liability reduction, renewal options, and GL posting references. Supports monthly lease accounting close, ASC 842 balance sheet recognition, payment tracking, and disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the lease contract record. Primary key for the lease_contract data product in the finance domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lease contracts have gl_cost_center (STRING) but no FK to cost_center master. This FK enables cost allocation for lease expenses (ASC 842 compliance).

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or facility location covered by this lease. Links to the store master record for operational reporting, comp sales (SSS) analysis, and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: rou_asset_gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rou Asset Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Lease contracts have gl_account_rou_asset (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This FK links to the GL account for right-of-use asset under ASC 842. This is the FIRST of two FKs from lease_contrac

tag_set.value: Rou Asset Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessor's master supplier/vendor record in the MDM system (Informatica MDM). Enables linkage to supplier payment terms, banking details, and vendor compliance records.

attributes.name: base_rent_monthly
attributes.description: Fixed monthly base rent payment amount as stipulated in the lease contract, excluding variable lease components (e.g., percentage rent, CAM charges). Used as the primary input for lease payment schedule generation and ASC 842 liability measurement.

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease term begins and the lessee obtains the right to use the underlying asset. This is the measurement date for initial ROU asset and lease liability recognition under ASC 842.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the lease contract, used in correspondence with lessors, auditors, and legal teams. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO lease contract object (RE-FX module).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease contract record was first created in the system (SAP S/4HANA RE-FX or finance data product). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and financial close process tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this lease contract (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency lease portfolios for international retail operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the non-cancellable lease term. Used to calculate remaining lease term, schedule final payments, and trigger renewal option evaluation workflows.

attributes.name: gl_account_lease_liability
attributes.description: SAP GL account number for the lease liability recognized on the balance sheet at lease commencement under ASC 842. Tracks the present value of future lease payments for balance sheet disclosure.

attributes.name: implicit_rate
attributes.description: The rate of interest implicit in the lease as defined by the lessor, used as the discount rate when readily determinable. Takes precedence over the incremental borrowing rate (IBR) for lease liability measurement under ASC 842. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: incremental_borrowing_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate the lessee would have to pay to borrow funds on a collateralized basis over a similar term and in a similar economic environment, used to discount future lease payments to present value when the implicit rate is not readily determinable. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%). Required for ASC 842 lease liability measurement.

attributes.name: initial_direct_cost
attributes.description: Incremental costs incurred by the lessee directly attributable to negotiating and arranging the lease (e.g., legal fees, broker commissions). Added to the initial ROU asset value at commencement under ASC 842.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent lease payment was made to the lessor. Used for payment reconciliation, delinquency monitoring, and lease liability roll-forward calculations during monthly close.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lease contract record, including remeasurements, modifications, and status changes. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lease_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total lease incentives received from the lessor (e.g., tenant improvement allowances, rent-free periods, moving allowances). Reduces the initial ROU asset value at commencement under ASC 842 and is amortized over the lease term.

attributes.name: lease_liability_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding lease liability balance as of the last accounting close, reflecting initial recognition less principal payments made to date. Split into current and non-current portions for balance sheet classification per ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_liability_initial
attributes.description: Present value of future lease payments discounted at the applicable rate (implicit rate or IBR) at lease commencement date. Represents the initial lease liability recognized on the balance sheet under ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease contract. Drives accounting treatment, payment processing, and disclosure eligibility. 'Modified' indicates a lease modification event requiring remeasurement under ASC 842.

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Total non-cancellable lease term expressed in months, including any renewal periods that are reasonably certain to be exercised. Used for amortization schedule generation and ASC 842 disclosure of weighted-average remaining lease term.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: ASC 842 classification of the lease as either an operating lease (expense recognized straight-line on P&L) or a finance lease (ROU asset amortized separately from interest expense). Drives balance sheet recognition and disclosure treatment.

attributes.name: leased_asset_category
attributes.description: Category of the underlying leased asset. Retail-specific categories include store locations (hypermarkets, department stores, discount outlets), distribution centers (DC), dark stores, micro-fulfillment centers (MFC), equipment, and vehicles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: store_location|distribution_center|office|equipment|vehicle|dark_store|micro_fulfillment_center — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lessor (landlord or equipment owner) as stated in the lease agreement. Used for counterparty identification in AP processing, EDI transactions, and disclosure reporting.

attributes.name: low_value_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the low-value asset practical expedient (typically assets with an underlying value below $5,000 when new). When True, lease payments are recognized as expense on a straight-line basis without balance sheet recognition.

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: Date on which a lease modification event occurred (e.g., extension of lease term, addition of leased space, change in rent). Triggers remeasurement of the ROU asset and lease liability at the modification date under ASC 842.

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the most recent lease modification event. Determines whether the modification is accounted for as a separate new lease or a remeasurement of the existing lease under ASC 842.

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled lease payment is due to the lessor. Used for AP cash management, payment run scheduling, and short-term lease liability classification on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which lease payments are due under the contract terms. Drives payment schedule generation, cash flow forecasting, and AP payment run scheduling in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: purchase_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option for the lessee to purchase the underlying asset. A purchase option that is reasonably certain to be exercised is a criterion for finance lease classification under ASC 842.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains one or more renewal options. When True, renewal_option_term_months and renewal_reasonably_certain_flag must be evaluated for inclusion in the lease term under ASC 842.

attributes.name: renewal_option_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the renewal option period(s) available under the lease contract. Included in the lease term measurement when the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the option.

attributes.name: renewal_reasonably_certain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has determined it is reasonably certain to exercise the renewal option, requiring inclusion of the renewal period in the lease term and remeasurement of ROU asset and lease liability under ASC 842.

attributes.name: rou_asset_carrying_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the ROU asset after accumulated amortization (finance lease) or straight-line adjustments (operating lease) as of the last accounting close date. Used for balance sheet presentation and ASC 842 disclosure.

attributes.name: rou_asset_initial_value
attributes.description: Initial carrying amount of the Right-of-Use (ROU) asset recognized at lease commencement, equal to the initial lease liability plus any lease payments made at or before commencement, less any lease incentives received, plus initial direct costs. Expressed in functional currency (USD).

attributes.name: short_term_lease_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease qualifies for the short-term lease practical expedient under ASC 842 (lease term of 12 months or less at commencement). When True, the lessee is not required to recognize an ROU asset or lease liability on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the lease was terminated early (if applicable). Triggers derecognition of the ROU asset and lease liability and recognition of any gain or loss on termination under ASC 842.

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract contains an early termination option. When True, the termination option must be assessed for reasonable certainty of exercise, which may shorten the lease term used in ASC 842 measurement.

attributes.name: variable_lease_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes variable lease payments (e.g., percentage rent based on store sales, CPI-indexed escalations, or CAM charges). Variable payments not dependent on an index or rate are excluded from lease liability measurement but disclosed separately under ASC 842.

attributes.name: variable_payment_basis
attributes.description: Describes the basis on which variable lease payments are calculated. 'sales_percentage' is common in retail (percentage rent tied to store revenue). 'cpi_index' indicates CPI-linked escalation. 'cam_charges' covers common area maintenance. Drives variable payment disclosure under ASC 842.

attributes.name: weighted_avg_remaining_term
attributes.description: Weighted average remaining lease term in years as of the reporting date, calculated across the lease portfolio. Required ASC 842 disclosure for both operating and finance leases in the financial statement footnotes.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record capturing cross-entity postings between retail subsidiaries, international entities, and corporate holding companies in SAP S/4HANA FI. Includes sending/receiving company codes, transaction type (management fee, shared service allocation, inventory transfer, loan, dividend), amount, document and local currency, FX conversion rate, netting status, elimination flag, and reconciliation status. Supports legal entity consolidation, intercompany elimination entries, transfer pricing documentation, and multi-currency settlement.
products.reference: SAP FI Intercompany Posting (BKPF with IC indicator)

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for cross-entity financial postings between retail subsidiaries, international entities, and corporate holding companies.

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_period. Business justification: Intercompany transactions are posted to fiscal periods. The table has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to financial_period master. This FK enables period-level reconciliation and cl

attributes.name: netting_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the netting run in which this intercompany transaction was included for multilateral settlement optimization.

attributes.name: sending_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have gl_account_sending (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This is the FIRST of two FKs from intercompany_transaction to gl_account, so the FK column name has a disting

attributes.name: sending_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have sending_profit_center (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This is the FIRST of two FKs from intercompany_transaction to profit_center, so the FK column name has

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was first created in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_date
