attributes.description: The date on the source document or invoice that originated this intercompany transaction. May differ from posting date for timing differences.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP FI document number for this intercompany transaction. Used for audit trail and reconciliation across legal entities.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for settlement between the sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: elimination_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the consolidation elimination journal entry document that offsets this intercompany transaction in group reporting.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking whether this intercompany transaction requires elimination entries during consolidation to remove intra-group transactions from consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert the document currency to local currencies. Critical for multi-currency intercompany settlement and consolidation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange rate used (spot rate, monthly average, budget rate, or fixed rate) for currency conversion.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this intercompany transaction is assigned.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this intercompany transaction is assigned for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account_receiving
attributes.description: General ledger account number in the receiving company code chart of accounts where the intercompany transaction is posted.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount_receiving
attributes.description: Transaction amount converted to the local currency of the receiving company code for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount_sending
attributes.description: Transaction amount converted to the local currency of the sending company code for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: local_currency_receiving
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the receiving company code's local currency for statutory books.

attributes.name: local_currency_sending
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the sending company code's local currency for statutory books.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction has been included in a multilateral netting process to reduce settlement volumes and FX exposure.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the due date calculation and settlement terms for this intercompany transaction (e.g., NET30, NET60).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger. Used for period assignment and financial reporting.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction (creditor side in most cases).

attributes.name: receiving_profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center within the receiving company code that is charged or credited for this intercompany transaction. Used for internal P&L reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction was successfully reconciled and confirmed by both sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the intercompany reconciliation process indicating whether sending and receiving entries match and have been confirmed by both entities.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference to the originating business document (purchase order, invoice, contract) that triggered this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity originating the intercompany transaction (debtor side in most cases).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the intercompany transaction was settled through cash transfer, netting, or other settlement mechanism.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to settle the intercompany transaction (cash transfer, multilateral netting, bilateral offset, or in-kind settlement).

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the document currency. Represents the gross amount before any adjustments.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional business context and details about the nature and purpose of this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction in the financial close and consolidation workflow.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the cross-entity posting (management fee, shared service allocation, inventory transfer, loan, dividend, royalty).

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the supporting transfer pricing documentation, study, or agreement that justifies the pricing of this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-compliant transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arm's length price for this intercompany transaction for tax compliance.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and treasury purposes, particularly relevant for intercompany loans and settlements.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference identified during intercompany reconciliation between sending and receiving entity records. Zero indicates perfect match.

products.name: tax_posting
products.description: Tax transaction record capturing sales tax, VAT, use tax, and excise duty postings on retail transactions in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX. Includes tax code, tax jurisdiction (state/county/city/country), taxable base amount, tax amount, tax rate, tax type (input/output), tax determination date, reporting period, nexus indicator, exempt flag, and source document reference. Supports multi-jurisdiction sales tax compliance, Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) reporting, tax return preparation, tax audit defense, and regulatory reporting to federal, state, and local tax authorities.

attributes.name: tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax posting transaction record in SAP S/4HANA FI-TX.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tax postings have cost_center (STRING) but no FK to cost_center master. This FK enables cost allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supplychain.dc_facility. Business justification: Sales and use tax postings by facility location for nexus determination, tax jurisdiction assignment, and compliance reporting. Required for multi-state retail tax compliance and audit defense.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax postings have gl_account_number (STRING) but no FK to gl_account master. This FK enables account validation for tax postings.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the retail store location where the taxable transaction occurred (for POS sales tax postings).

attributes.name: original_posting_tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax posting ID that this record reverses (populated only when reversal_flag is true).

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the customer for output tax postings on sales transactions.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tax postings have profit_center (STRING) but no FK to profit_center master. This FK enables P&L allocation for tax expenses.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supplier/vendor for input tax postings on purchase transactions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to supporting documentation for tax audit defense (original invoice, receipt, exemption certificate, tax calculation log).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area code for cross-company-code financial reporting and segment analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for this tax posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA FI-TX system.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number from which this tax posting originated (invoice, receipt, credit memo).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of source accounting document that generated this tax posting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to local currency for GL posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company's local reporting currency for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was last modified (for correction postings or adjustments).

attributes.name: nexus_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the retailer has established tax nexus (physical or economic presence) in this jurisdiction, triggering tax collection obligation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax transaction was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which this tax posting is assigned for tax return preparation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this posting is a reversal of a previously posted tax transaction (for corrections or cancellations).

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reverse charge VAT transaction where the customer is responsible for self-assessing and remitting VAT.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount posted to the tax GL account, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The tax amount converted to local reporting currency for financial statement consolidation.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the government tax authority to which this tax will be remitted (e.g., California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, IRS).

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code that defines the tax type, rate, and GL account assignment for this posting.

attributes.name: tax_determination_date
attributes.description: The business event date used to determine applicable tax rates and jurisdiction (typically transaction date or delivery date).

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is input tax (paid to suppliers) or output tax (collected from customers).

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction qualified for tax exemption (e.g., resale certificate, government entity, non-profit exemption).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The exemption certificate number provided by the customer to support tax-exempt status (resale certificate, government ID, non-profit certificate).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for city-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Composite jurisdiction code uniquely identifying the complete tax authority (country-state-county-city combination).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the tax jurisdiction where the tax obligation arises.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_county
attributes.description: County or district name for county-level sales tax jurisdictions (applicable in US multi-jurisdiction tax scenarios).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code within the country for state-level sales tax (US) or provincial tax (Canada).

attributes.name: tax_point_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax liability arises for VAT purposes (typically invoice date or goods delivery date per VAT regulations).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The effective tax rate percentage applied to the taxable base (e.g., 8.25000 for 8.25% sales tax).

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The retailer's tax registration number with the jurisdiction's tax authority (sales tax permit number, VAT registration number, GST number).

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax being posted (sales tax, VAT, use tax, excise duty, withholding tax, customs duty).

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The gross transaction amount subject to tax before tax calculation, in transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the tax transaction was recorded.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Corporate bank account master record for retail entity bank accounts used for AP disbursements, AR collections, payroll funding, and treasury operations in SAP S/4HANA FI-TR. Captures bank name, account number, routing/SWIFT/IBAN, account type (operating, payroll, concentration, lockbox), currency, bank key, daily balance positions, authorized signatories, account status, and GL reconciliation account. Supports cash position reporting, daily bank statement processing, payment method determination, and bank reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the corporate bank account record. Primary key for the bank account entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bank accounts have gl_account_code (STRING) representing the GL account for bank reconciliation, but no FK to gl_account master. This FK links the bank account to its corresponding GL account in the c

attributes.name: account_closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was permanently closed, if applicable. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The legal name or business description of the bank account as registered with the financial institution.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The financial institution account number used for AP disbursements, AR collections, payroll funding, and treasury operations. Confidential financial identifier.

attributes.name: account_opened_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the bank account indicating whether it is available for transactions, temporarily suspended, permanently closed, or awaiting activation.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The functional classification of the bank account indicating its primary business purpose: operating (general business transactions), payroll (employee compensation), concentration (cash pooling), lockbox (AR collections), disbursement (AP payments), or collection (customer payments).

attributes.name: ach_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bank account is enabled for ACH electronic funds transfer processing for domestic US transactions.

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee names or identifiers authorized to approve transactions and sign on behalf of the company for this bank account.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The available balance for withdrawal or payment processing, accounting for pending transactions, holds, and minimum balance requirements.

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the bank in the SAP system, used for payment processing and bank statement reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution where the account is held.

attributes.name: branch_address
attributes.description: The physical street address of the bank branch where the account is held, used for correspondence and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: branch_city
attributes.description: The city where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: branch_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166 country code representing the country where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled.

attributes.name: branch_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the bank branch location.

attributes.name: branch_state
attributes.description: The state or province where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: check_printing_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bank account is enabled for physical check printing and disbursement.

attributes.name: collection_method_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bank account is enabled for incoming payment collection (AR receipts, customer payments, lockbox processing).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns this bank account, used for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the denomination of the bank account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance in the bank account as of the last bank statement processing or real-time update, used for cash position reporting and treasury management.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: The International Bank Account Number used for identifying bank accounts across international borders, primarily in European and other international transactions.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to the account balance, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%), used for interest income calculation.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the last successful bank reconciliation was completed for this account, aligning bank statement balances with GL balances.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent bank statement processed for this account, used for reconciliation tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum balance that must be maintained in the account per the bank agreement to avoid fees or maintain account status.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified this bank account record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank account record was last modified in the SAP S/4HANA system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or comments related to the bank account management and usage.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The initial balance of the bank account when it was first opened or migrated into the system, used as the baseline for reconciliation.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: The maximum overdraft or line of credit limit authorized by the bank for this account, used for short-term liquidity management.

attributes.name: payment_method_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bank account is enabled for outgoing payment processing (AP disbursements, payroll, vendor payments).

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number for domestic US bank transfers and ACH transactions.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: The Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Bank Identifier Code (BIC) used for international wire transfers and cross-border payments.

attributes.name: wire_transfer_enabled

attributes.name: created_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments related to this payment run for internal reference and audit purposes.

attributes.name: payment_batch_code

attributes.name: payment_channel

attributes.name: payment_file_format

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: profit_center_code

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment run was successfully reconciled with bank statements.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the bank reconciliation process for this payment run, tracking whether payments have been matched to bank statements.

attributes.name: run_number

attributes.name: run_type

attributes.name: scheduled_date

attributes.name: payment_run_status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: posted_to_gl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the netting run results have been posted to the general ledger, confirming financial statement impact.

attributes.name: processing_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds taken to complete the netting run processing, supporting performance monitoring and optimization.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this netting run has been reversed, supporting error correction and period adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reversing this netting run, supporting audit and compliance documentation requirements.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the netting run, formatted as NR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the netting run based on its purpose and timing within the financial close cycle.

attributes.name: netting_run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the netting run within the financial close workflow.

attributes.name: total_gross_payable_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of payables included in the netting run before netting adjustments are applied.

attributes.name: total_gross_receivable_amount

attributes.name: total_netted_amount
attributes.description: The net amount after offsetting payables and receivables, representing the actual settlement obligation or receivable.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual transactions included in this netting run for processing and reconciliation tracking.

products.name: scenario
products.description: Master reference table for scenario. Referenced by scenario_id.

attributes.name: scenario_id
attributes.description: Primary key for scenario

attributes.name: financial_period_id
attributes.description: Add column financial_period_id (BIGINT) to finance.scenario with FK to finance.financial_period.financial_period_id because budget/forecast scenarios relate to financial periods. P13: connect_table: finance.scenario** - add column financial

attributes.name: parent_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent scenario from which this scenario was derived or versioned. Nullable for original scenarios. Enables hierarchical scenario relationships and version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: primary_baseline_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baseline scenario used for variance analysis and comparison. Typically points to the approved budget or prior year actual scenario.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this scenario was formally approved. Critical for establishing the official baseline for financial planning and reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the scenario in the financial governance workflow. Pending indicates awaiting review; Approved indicates formally accepted; Rejected indicates not accepted; Under Review indicates in approval process.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or committee who approved this scenario. Used for audit trail and governance compliance.

attributes.name: assumptions_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key financial and business assumptions underlying this scenario (e.g., revenue growth rates, cost inflation, market conditions, strategic initiatives). Critical for scenario interpretation and sensitivity analysis.

attributes.name: business_unit_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of business units, divisions, or legal entities included in this scenario. Defines the organizational scope of the scenario for segmented reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: scenario_category
attributes.description: Business category of the scenario indicating its primary use case. Operational for day-to-day financial management; Strategic for long-term planning; Regulatory for compliance reporting; Management for internal decision-making; Consolidated for enterprise-wide aggregation.

attributes.name: scenario_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the scenario for external reference and reporting (e.g., ACTUAL, BUDGET_2024, FORECAST_Q1).

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Method used for consolidating financial data in this scenario. Full for 100% consolidation of subsidiaries; Proportional for consolidation based on ownership percentage; Equity for equity method accounting; None for standalone entity reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scenario record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the reporting currency for this scenario (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All financial amounts in this scenario are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary system or process that generated or maintains this scenario (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Hyperion Planning, Excel-based planning model). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: scenario_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scenario, including its purpose, assumptions, key drivers, and intended use cases. Provides business context for financial analysts and planners.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which this scenario remains effective. Nullable for scenarios with indefinite validity (e.g., rolling forecasts).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this scenario becomes effective and can be used for financial planning, reporting, and analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year to which this scenario applies. Format: Q1-Q4 for quarters, M01-M12 for months, H1-H2 for half-years, FY for full year.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this scenario applies (e.g., 2024). Used for period-based financial planning and reporting alignment.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of geographic regions or countries included in this scenario (e.g., North America, EMEA, Global). Defines the geographic coverage for regional financial planning and reporting.

attributes.name: is_consolidated
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this scenario represents consolidated financial data across multiple entities or business units. True for enterprise-wide consolidated scenarios; False for standalone entity scenarios.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default scenario for reporting and analysis. True if this scenario should be used as the primary reference; False otherwise. Only one scenario per fiscal period should be marked as default.

attributes.name: is_public
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this scenario is used for external public reporting and disclosure. True for scenarios used in SEC filings, earnings releases, and investor communications; False for internal management scenarios.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this scenario record. Used for audit trail and accountability in financial data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scenario record was last updated. Critical for change tracking and ensuring users are working with the most current scenario version.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which this scenario was locked to prevent further modifications. Ensures data integrity for finalized scenarios used in reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the financial scenario (e.g., Actual Results, Annual Budget 2024, Rolling Forecast Q1 2024).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or documentation related to this scenario. Used for capturing ad-hoc information, special instructions, or context that does not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or team responsible for maintaining and updating this scenario. Typically a financial planning analyst, FP&A manager, or controller.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_months
attributes.description: Number of months into the future that this scenario covers. Used for forecasting and planning scenarios to define the projection period (e.g., 12 for annual budget, 36 for strategic plan).

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scenario indicating its purpose in financial planning and analysis. Actual represents realized results; Budget represents approved annual plan; Forecast represents updated projections; Plan represents strategic multi-year plan; Projection represents long-term estimates; Baseline represents reference point for variance analysis.

attributes.name: scenario_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scenario. Draft indicates scenario is being prepared; Active indicates scenario is in use for reporting and analysis; Locked indicates scenario is finalized and no further changes allowed; Archived indicates scenario is retained for historical reference; Superseded indicates scenario has been replaced by a newer version; Cancelled indicates scenario was abandoned.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for scenarios that undergo revisions. Enables tracking of scenario evolution and comparison across versions (e.g., Budget v1, Budget v2).

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master reference table for legal_entity. Referenced by legal_entity_id.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Primary key for legal_entity

attributes.name: parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: FK reference to finance.legal_entity.legal_entity_id

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy.

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to consolidate this legal entity into group financial statements (e.g., full consolidation, equity method, cost method).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially dissolved, liquidated, or ceased operations.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or fictitious business name under which the legal entity operates, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business identification and credit reporting.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this legal entity record becomes effective for financial reporting and operational purposes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this legal entity record is effective; null indicates the record is currently active.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current operational and legal status of the entity (e.g., active, inactive, dissolved, suspended, merged, acquired).

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: The legal structure and classification of the entity (e.g., corporation, LLC, partnership, sole proprietorship, branch, subsidiary).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: The month in which the legal entity's fiscal year ends (1-12, where 1=January, 12=December).

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The primary currency in which the legal entity conducts its business operations and maintains its books, using ISO 4217 three-letter code.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered with the governing authority.

attributes.name: incorporation_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country, state, or province where the legal entity is incorporated or registered.

attributes.name: industry_classification_code
attributes.description: The standard industry classification code for the entity's primary business activity (e.g., NAICS, SIC, GICS).

attributes.name: is_public_company
attributes.description: Indicates whether the legal entity is a publicly traded company with securities listed on a stock exchange.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this legal entity record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the entity as it appears on incorporation documents and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character alphanumeric Legal Entity Identifier code used for financial transaction reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership interest held by the parent entity, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for wholly-owned, 51.00 for majority-owned).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person or registered agent.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person or registered agent for the legal entity.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person or registered agent.

attributes.name: registered_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the official registered address of the legal entity as filed with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: registered_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the official registered address (suite, floor, building name, etc.).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: The city of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province of the official registered address.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The unique registration or incorporation number assigned by the government or regulatory authority.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency used for consolidated financial reporting and regulatory filings, using ISO 4217 three-letter code.

attributes.name: stock_exchange_code
attributes.description: The code or symbol of the stock exchange where the entity's securities are listed (e.g., NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE).

attributes.name: stock_ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The ticker symbol used to identify the entity's publicly traded securities on the stock exchange.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The tax identification number assigned by the tax authority for tax reporting and compliance purposes (e.g., EIN in the US).

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master reference table for chart_of_accounts. Referenced by chart_of_accounts_id.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Primary key for chart_of_accounts

attributes.name: parent_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on chart_of_accounts (parent_chart_of_accounts_id)

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: The sub-classification within the account type, providing additional granularity for financial statement presentation and analysis (e.g., current vs. non-current assets, operating vs. non-operating revenue).

attributes.name: account_level
attributes.description: The level in the account hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-accounts, 3 for detail accounts), supporting multi-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the account (e.g., Cash and Cash Equivalents, Accounts Receivable, Cost of Goods Sold).

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number used to identify this account in the general ledger. This is the externally-known business identifier used in financial transactions and reporting.

attributes.name: account_subcategory
attributes.description: Further detailed classification within the account category for more granular reporting and analysis (e.g., Trade Receivables, Inventory - Raw Materials, Salaries and Wages).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account based on the accounting equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity) and income statement categories.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit or division code associated with this account for organizational reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The account number in the consolidated chart of accounts that this account maps to for group-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The default cost center code associated with this account for management accounting and cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for accounts that are denominated in a specific currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for multi-currency accounts.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and what types of transactions should be posted to this account.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this account is no longer active for new transactions. Null for accounts with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account becomes active and available for use in financial transactions.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The code or line item reference used for external regulatory reporting (e.g., SEC filing line items, tax authority reporting codes).

attributes.name: financial_statement
attributes.description: The primary financial statement where this account is reported (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, or Statement of Changes in Equity).

attributes.name: is_control_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a control account (summary account) that is reconciled to subsidiary ledgers (e.g., Accounts Receivable control account reconciled to customer sub-ledger).

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions that require elimination during consolidation.

attributes.name: is_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct transaction posting is allowed to this account. Summary/control accounts typically do not allow direct posting.

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation (e.g., bank accounts, intercompany accounts, suspense accounts).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this chart of accounts record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chart of accounts record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account normally carries a debit or credit balance based on accounting principles (assets and expenses are debit; liabilities, equity, and revenue are credit).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the use and management of this account.

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the parent account in a hierarchical chart of accounts structure, enabling roll-up reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The default profit center code associated with this account for profitability analysis and segment reporting.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account indicating whether it is available for posting transactions.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category or tax line item classification for this account, used for tax reporting and compliance (e.g., taxable income, deductible expense, non-deductible expense).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this chart of accounts record.

products.name: payment_instrument
products.description: Vault-adjacent payment instrument store isolated for PCI DSS scope. Tokenized payment methods linked to customer profiles. Non-payment workloads should not join to this table directly.

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_method

attributes.name: billing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: payment_method has embedded billing address fields (billing_address_line1, billing_address_line2, billing_city, billing_state_province, billing_postal_code, billing_country_code) that should be normal

attributes.name: primary_payment_digital_wallet_account_id
attributes.description: Tokenized identifier for the digital wallet account. Used for digital wallet transactions and reconciliation.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this payment method. Links to the customer master record for omnichannel recognition and clienteling.

attributes.name: bin_number
attributes.description: First six digits of the card number (Bank Identification Number). Used for card type identification, fraud detection, and routing. Not considered sensitive under PCI DSS.

attributes.name: bnpl_provider
attributes.description: Buy-now-pay-later provider. Free-text field; common values include klarna, affirm, afterpay, zip.

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: Brand of the payment card. Free-form string; common values include: visa, mastercard, amex, discover, diners_club, jcb, unionpay.

attributes.name: card_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the card was issued. Derived from BIN lookup. Used for fraud detection and international transaction processing.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Full name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment instrument. PII-sensitive; masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: consent_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer provided consent to store this payment method (web, mobile app, POS, call center, in-store). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer provided consent to store this payment method. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and customer lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method was deactivated. Null if the payment method is still active. Used for lifecycle tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the payment method was deactivated. Used for customer service, fraud analysis, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_provider
attributes.description: Digital wallet provider. Free-form string; common values include: apple_pay, google_pay, paypal, samsung_pay, venmo.

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: Expiration month of the payment card (1-12). Used to validate card validity at checkout and trigger proactive customer notifications for expiring cards.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: Expiration year of the payment card (four-digit year). Used to validate card validity at checkout and trigger proactive customer notifications for expiring cards.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance
attributes.description: Current balance remaining on the gift card. Updated after each transaction. Applicable only when payment_method_type is gift_card.

attributes.name: gift_card_number
attributes.description: Tokenized or masked gift card number. Applicable only when payment_method_type is gift_card. Used for gift card balance inquiries and redemption.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment method is currently active and available for use. Inactive methods are retained for historical transaction reference but cannot be used for new purchases.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the customers default payment method for one-click checkout and recurring purchases. Only one payment method per customer should be marked as default.

attributes.name: issuing_bank
attributes.description: Name of the bank or financial institution that issued the payment card. Used for transaction routing and fraud detection.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the card number for customer recognition and display purposes. Used in clienteling and checkout confirmation screens.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date when this payment method was last used for a transaction. Used for RFM (Recency Frequency Monetary) analytics and customer engagement.

attributes.name: nickname
attributes.description: Customer-defined nickname for this payment method (e.g., My Visa, Work Card, Personal Checking). Used for customer convenience in payment selection.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument. Allowed values: credit_card, debit_card, wallet, gift_card, store_credit, bnpl.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment processor or gateway used to process transactions with this payment method (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Cybersource). Used for transaction routing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: processor_token
attributes.description: Payment processor-specific token for this payment method. Used for transaction processing and vault management.

attributes.name: store_credit_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of store credit available to the customer. Typically issued from returns or promotional campaigns. Applicable only when payment_method_type is store_credit.

attributes.name: token
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliant tokenized reference to the payment instrument. No raw PAN (Primary Account Number) is stored. Token is used for recurring purchases and one-click checkout.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment method record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this payment method has been used for transactions. Used for RFM analytics and customer behavior analysis.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment method was last verified. Used for compliance and fraud prevention tracking.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of payment method verification (e.g., AVS check, CVV verification, micro-deposit confirmation). Used for fraud prevention and risk management.

attributes.name: wallet_provider
attributes.description: Digital wallet provider. Free-form string; common values include: apple_pay, google_pay, paypal, samsung_pay, venmo.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages retail workforce including store associates, distribution center staff, and corporate employees. Owns employee master records, scheduling, time and attendance, payroll, benefits, talent acquisition, performance management, training programs, labor cost allocation, OSHA compliance records, and headcount planning. Integrates with Workday HCM for unified human capital management across all retail locations.

products.name: associate
products.description: Master record for all retail workforce members including store associates, DC staff, and corporate employees. Sourced from Workday HCM as the golden record. Captures employee ID, legal name, preferred name, employment type (full-time, part-time, seasonal, temporary), job classification, FLSA status (exempt/non-exempt), hire date, termination date, rehire eligibility, work authorization status (I-9 verification date, document type, expiration date), primary work location (store, DC, corporate), cost center, pay grade, pay type (hourly/salaried), standard hours per week, manager employee ID, HR business partner, union membership flag, union local code, collective bargaining agreement identifier, badge number, Workday worker ID, and multi-location assignment history including temporary transfers, cross-training assignments, and seasonal redeployments between stores and DCs.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail workforce member. Primary key for the associate entity.

attributes.name: collective_bargaining_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collective bargaining agreement governing the associate's terms and conditions of employment. Null for non-union associates. Used for contract compliance and labor cost modeling.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center where the associate is primarily assigned. Null for store and corporate associates. Used for DC labor reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store where the associate is primarily assigned. Null for DC and corporate associates. Used for store-level labor reporting and scheduling.

attributes.name: manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Associate ID of the direct manager or supervisor. Used for organizational hierarchy reporting, approval workflows, and performance management.

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical badge or access card number used for facility access, time clock punches, and POS system login.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting code for labor cost allocation. Maps to the organizational unit (store, DC, department) responsible for the associate's compensation expenses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this associate record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Corporate email address assigned to the associate for business communications, system access, and internal collaboration.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person to contact in case of workplace emergency or injury. Required for OSHA compliance and duty of care.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person. Required for OSHA compliance and duty of care.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the associate's employment. Active indicates currently working, leave-of-absence for approved absences (medical, parental, personal), suspended for disciplinary actions, terminated for ended employment.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment relationship defining work schedule expectations, benefits eligibility, and labor cost allocation. Full-time typically 35+ hours/week, part-time under 35 hours/week, seasonal for peak periods (holidays, back-to-school), temporary for fixed-duration assignments.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification determining overtime eligibility under FLSA. Exempt employees are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay at 1.5x regular rate for hours over 40/week.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the associate was originally hired by the organization. Used for seniority calculations, benefits vesting, anniversary recognition, and tenure reporting.

attributes.name: hr_business_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the HR business partner assigned to support this associate. Used for HR case routing, employee relations, and policy guidance.

attributes.name: i9_document_type
attributes.description: Type of documentation provided for I-9 verification. Examples: US Passport (List A), Driver's License + Social Security Card (List B+C), Permanent Resident Card (List A).

attributes.name: i9_verification_date
attributes.description: Date the employer completed Section 2 of Form I-9 verifying the associate's identity and employment authorization. Required within 3 business days of hire date.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the job classification for compensation, workforce planning, and labor reporting. Maps to pay grade and FLSA status.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title reflecting the associate's role and responsibilities. Examples: Sales Associate, Department Manager, Distribution Center Picker, Merchandising Coordinator, Store Manager.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review or appraisal. Used for performance management cycle tracking and development planning.

attributes.name: last_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the associate most recently completed a required training program. Used for compliance tracking (safety, harassment prevention, food safety) and skills development monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name as recorded on government-issued identification and payroll records. Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) as recorded on government-issued identification and payroll records. Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial as recorded on government-issued identification. Optional field used for formal documentation.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation band or level within the organization's pay structure. Determines salary range or hourly rate range for the position.

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Compensation structure indicating whether the associate is paid based on hours worked (hourly) or a fixed annual salary (salaried).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary work phone number for the associate. May be a direct line, extension, or mobile number depending on role and location.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the associate prefers to be called in day-to-day work interactions. Used for name badges, internal communications, and scheduling displays.

attributes.name: primary_work_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the associate's primary work location. Used for labor cost allocation, workforce planning, and facility capacity management.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the associate is eligible for rehire based on their employment history and termination circumstances. True indicates eligible, False indicates not eligible.

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Expected number of hours the associate is scheduled to work per week under normal conditions. Used for labor planning, benefits eligibility determination, and FTE calculations.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the associate's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for turnover analysis, final payroll processing, and benefits termination.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Classification of the reason for employment termination. Used for turnover analysis, unemployment claims, and rehire eligibility determination.

attributes.name: union_local_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the local union chapter to which the associate belongs. Null for non-union associates. Used for dues deduction, grievance processing, and contract administration.

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the associate is a member of a labor union. True indicates union member, False indicates non-union. Used for collective bargaining compliance and labor relations reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this associate record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit trails.

attributes.name: work_authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of work authorization documentation for non-citizens. Null for citizens and permanent residents. Used to trigger reverification requirements.

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Legal authorization status for employment in the jurisdiction. Used for I-9 compliance verification and work eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: External unique identifier from Workday HCM system. Golden record reference for workforce data integration.

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Reference catalog of all job profiles and roles defined across the retail organization. Captures job code, job title, job family, job level, FLSA classification, minimum and maximum pay range, standard hours, required certifications, physical requirements, department, division, and whether the role is store-facing, DC-facing, or corporate. Sourced from Workday HCM job catalog. Used for headcount planning, compensation benchmarking, and talent acquisition.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job profile. Primary key for the job profile reference catalog. Sourced from Workday HCM job catalog.

attributes.name: semantic_layer_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.semantic_layer_entity. Business justification: Job profiles are dimensional entities in workforce analytics semantic models. BI tools expose job_profile as a certified dimension for slicing labor metrics by role, level, and job family in retail wo

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pay range (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Used for multi-currency compensation management in global retail operations.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Primary department or functional area where this job profile is typically assigned (e.g., Store Operations, Distribution Center, Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Higher-level organizational division or business unit where this job profile resides (e.g., Retail Operations, Corporate, Supply Chain, E-Commerce).

attributes.name: eeoc_job_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category
attributes.description: Standard EEOC job category classification for this profile (e.g., Executive/Senior Level Officials and Managers, Professionals, Sales Workers, Service Workers). Used for EEO-1 reporting and compliance.

tag_set.value: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was retired or became inactive. Null for currently active profiles. Used for historical tracking and organizational change management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile became active and available for use in the organization. Used for historical tracking and organizational change management.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment classification indicating whether the role is full-time, part-time, seasonal, temporary, or contractor. Used for benefits eligibility and workforce planning.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the role is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll and labor cost compliance.

attributes.name: is_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for performance-based bonuses or incentive compensation. Used for total compensation planning and performance management.

attributes.name: is_commission_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for sales commission or variable compensation based on sales performance. Used for sales compensation planning.

attributes.name: is_corporate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is a corporate or headquarters position. Used for organizational structure reporting and overhead cost allocation.

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role involves direct interaction with customers (e.g., sales associates, customer service representatives). Used for customer experience planning and training programs.

attributes.name: is_dc_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is primarily assigned to distribution center or warehouse locations. Used for supply chain workforce planning.

attributes.name: is_leadership_role
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this job profile is a leadership or management position with direct reports. Used for leadership development programs and organizational structure analysis.

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is eligible for overtime pay. Typically aligns with FLSA non-exempt classification. Used for payroll and labor cost forecasting.

attributes.name: is_store_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this role is primarily assigned to retail store locations. Used for store headcount planning and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: is_union_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this job profile is eligible for union membership or collective bargaining representation. Used for labor relations and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the job profile for system identification and reporting. Used in payroll, headcount planning, and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the job profile including responsibilities, duties, and expectations. Used for job postings, performance management, and organizational documentation.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational grouping that categorizes similar roles together (e.g., Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, Merchandising). Used for career pathing and talent development.

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or grade of the job within the organization (e.g., Entry Level, Mid-Level, Senior, Manager, Director, Executive). Used for compensation planning and organizational structure.

attributes.name: job_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. Active profiles are available for hiring and assignment; inactive profiles are no longer used but retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title as displayed on employee records, offer letters, and organizational charts. Human-readable name for the job profile.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was last reviewed for accuracy and relevance by Human Resources. Used for job profile maintenance and compliance audits.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary work location type for this job profile. Used for workforce planning, real estate allocation, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: maximum_pay_range
attributes.description: Maximum annual or hourly compensation for this job profile. Used for compensation benchmarking, offer generation, and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_pay_range
attributes.description: Minimum annual or hourly compensation for this job profile. Used for compensation benchmarking, offer generation, and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: minimum_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this job profile. Used for talent acquisition and career progression planning.

attributes.name: onet_code

products.name: staffing_plan
products.description: This association product represents the workforce allocation plan between organizational units and job profiles. It captures the planned and actual headcount allocation of standardized job roles to specific organizational units (stores, departments, distribution centers, corporate divisions). Each record links one org unit to one job profile with budgeted FTE counts, actual headcount, effective dates, and approval status. This is a core workforce planning entity managed jointly by HR and Finance through formal planning cycles and budget approval workflows.. Existence Justification: This is a genuine operational M:N relationship representing workforce staffing plans in retail. One organizational unit (store, department, DC) requires multiple job profiles to operate (cashiers, managers, stockers, etc.), and one job profile is allocated across multiple organizational units (e.g., Store Manager role exists in hundreds of stores). The business actively manages these allocations through formal workforce planning cycles with approval workflows, budget constraints, and variance tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key to org_unit. Identifies which organizational unit this staffing allocation applies to.

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Current actual FTE headcount for this job profile within this organizational unit. Updated as employees are hired, transferred, or terminated.

attributes.name: annual_labor_budget
attributes.description: Annual labor cost budget allocated to this organizational unit in local currency. Used for variance analysis and cost control. [Moved from org_unit: Labor budget is allocated by job profile within each org unit, not as a single lump sum. The total labor budget for an org unit is the SUM of staffing_plan.annual_labor_cost_budget across all job profile allocations. This should be removed from org_unit and calculated from the association.]

The actual headcount for an org unit is the SUM of staffing_plan.actual_headcount across all job profiles. This should be a derived metric, not stored on org_unit.]

products.name: org_unit_compliance_scope
products.description: This association product represents the Scope Assignment between org_unit and compliance_program. It captures which compliance programs apply to which organizational units and tracks the program-specific implementation details at the org unit level. Each record links one org_unit to one compliance_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this scoping relationship, including responsible parties, audit schedules, and effective dates for that specific org unit-program combination.. Existence Justification: In retail operations, organizational units (stores, departments, distribution centers) are subject to multiple compliance programs simultaneously (FDA food safety, OSHA workplace safety, PCI payment security, environmental regulations), and each compliance program applies to multiple organizational units across the enterprise. The business actively manages these scope assignments, tracking which programs apply to which org units with program-specific implementation details including responsible parties, audit schedules, risk assessments, and compliance status at the org unit-program level.
