products.name: privacy_assessment
products.description: Privacy impact assessment (PIA) and data protection impact assessment (DPIA) records conducted for retail business processes, systems, and data initiatives involving personal data. Captures assessment name, assessment type (PIA, DPIA, LIA — Legitimate Interest Assessment), triggering event (new system, process change, third-party sharing, marketing campaign), personal data categories involved, data subjects affected (customers, employees, minors), risk level (low, medium, high), privacy risks identified, mitigations applied, DPO review date, and assessment outcome. Required for GDPR Article 35 and CCPA compliance.
products.reference: GDPR DPIA / CCPA Privacy Impact Assessment

attributes.name: privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the privacy assessment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Privacy assessments (PIAs, DPIAs) are conducted under privacy compliance programs (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). This FK links each assessment to the master compliance program record. Cardinality: Many assessmen

attributes.name: prior_privacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on privacy_assessment (prior_privacy_assessment_id)

attributes.name: assessment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the privacy assessment was finalized and approved.

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: Framework or methodology used to conduct the privacy assessment (e.g., 'ISO/IEC 29134', 'NIST Privacy Framework', 'CNIL DPIA methodology', 'ICO DPIA guidance', 'Internal privacy assessment framework').

attributes.name: assessment_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title of the privacy assessment (e.g., 'Customer Loyalty Program DPIA', 'E-Commerce Platform PIA').

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the privacy assessment: approved (no significant risks, proceed), approved_with_conditions (proceed with mandatory mitigations), rejected (unacceptable risk, do not proceed), requires_consultation (high residual risk requiring supervisory authority consultation per GDPR Article 36).

attributes.name: assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the privacy assessment was initiated.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the privacy assessment: draft (initial preparation), in_review (under business review), dpo_review (awaiting DPO validation), completed (finalized and approved), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of privacy assessment conducted. PIA = Privacy Impact Assessment, DPIA = Data Protection Impact Assessment (GDPR Article 35), LIA = Legitimate Interest Assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or team who conducted the privacy assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_role
attributes.description: Role or title of the assessor (e.g., 'Privacy Analyst', 'Compliance Manager', 'Data Protection Officer', 'Information Security Manager').

attributes.name: automated_decision_making
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed process involves automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects on data subjects. True if automated decision-making is present, False otherwise. Required disclosure under GDPR Article 22.

attributes.name: business_process
attributes.description: The retail business process or function being assessed (e.g., 'Customer Loyalty and Engagement Programs', 'E-Commerce and Digital Commerce Operations', 'Order Fulfillment and Last-Mile Delivery', 'Workforce Management').

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for the assessed process or system (e.g., 'E-Commerce', 'Store Operations', 'Supply Chain', 'Human Resources', 'Marketing').

attributes.name: children_data_processing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed process involves processing personal data of children (individuals under 16 years of age, or lower age as defined by member state law). True if children's data is processed, False otherwise. Requires parental consent under GDPR Article 8.

attributes.name: consultation_date
attributes.description: Date when the supervisory authority was consulted regarding high-risk processing. Applicable only if supervisory_authority_consulted is True.

attributes.name: consultation_outcome
attributes.description: Summary of the supervisory authority's response or guidance following consultation (e.g., 'Approved with additional safeguards', 'Requires further mitigation', 'Processing prohibited').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the privacy assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_period
attributes.description: Defined retention period for personal data processed in the assessed system or process (e.g., '7 years', '90 days post-transaction', 'Duration of employment plus 3 years'). Required for GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation principle.

attributes.name: data_subject_rights_supported
attributes.description: Data subject rights mechanisms implemented in the assessed system or process (e.g., 'Right to access', 'Right to rectification', 'Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)', 'Right to data portability', 'Right to object', 'Right to restrict processing'). Comma-separated list per GDPR Chapter III.

attributes.name: data_subjects
attributes.description: Categories of individuals whose personal data is processed (e.g., 'Customers', 'Employees', 'Minors', 'Suppliers', 'Job applicants'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: data_transfer_countries
attributes.description: Countries or regions to which personal data is transferred (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'IND', 'EU'). Required for GDPR Chapter V compliance on international data transfers. Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.

attributes.name: dpo_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the Data Protection Officer reviewed and validated the privacy assessment. Required for GDPR Article 35(2) compliance.

attributes.name: dpo_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Data Protection Officer who reviewed the assessment.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic regions or jurisdictions where the assessed processing activities occur (e.g., 'European Union', 'United States', 'California', 'Global'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis for processing personal data under GDPR Article 6: consent, contract (performance of contract), legal_obligation (compliance with legal obligation), vital_interests (protection of vital interests), public_task (public interest or official authority), legitimate_interests (legitimate interests pursued by controller or third party).

attributes.name: mitigations_applied
attributes.description: Privacy risk mitigation measures implemented or planned (e.g., 'Encryption of data at rest and in transit', 'Role-based access controls', 'Data minimization procedures', 'Automated data retention policies', 'Privacy-by-design architecture', 'Third-party data processing agreements'). Comma-separated or narrative format.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the privacy assessment record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this privacy assessment. Privacy assessments should be reviewed regularly or when significant changes occur.

attributes.name: personal_data_categories
attributes.description: Categories of personal data involved in the assessed process or system (e.g., 'Contact information (email, phone)', 'Purchase history', 'Payment card data', 'Geolocation data', 'Biometric data', 'Employee performance records'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: privacy_risks_identified
attributes.description: Summary of privacy risks identified during the assessment (e.g., 'Unauthorized access to customer PII', 'Excessive data retention', 'Lack of consent mechanism', 'Third-party data sharing without adequate safeguards', 'Inadequate data subject rights procedures'). Comma-separated or narrative format.

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for processing personal data (e.g., 'Customer relationship management', 'Order fulfillment', 'Marketing and promotions', 'Workforce scheduling', 'Fraud prevention').

attributes.name: regulatory_frameworks
attributes.description: Privacy and data protection regulations applicable to the assessed processing (e.g., 'GDPR', 'CCPA', 'CPRA', 'LGPD', 'PIPEDA', 'HIPAA', 'PCI DSS'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Privacy risk level remaining after mitigation measures have been applied. Used to determine if additional controls are required or if the risk is acceptable.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall privacy risk level determined by the assessment: low (minimal risk to data subjects), medium (moderate risk requiring mitigation), high (significant risk requiring immediate action), critical (severe risk requiring executive escalation).

attributes.name: special_category_data
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed process involves special categories of personal data (racial/ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data, health data, sex life, sexual orientation). True if special category data is processed, False otherwise. Requires heightened protection under GDPR Article 9.

attributes.name: supervisory_authority_consulted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supervisory authority (data protection authority) was consulted prior to processing, as required when a DPIA indicates high residual risk. True if consultation occurred, False otherwise. Required under GDPR Article 36 for high-risk processing.

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system or platform being assessed (e.g., 'the e-commerce platform', 'SAP S/4HANA Retail', 'Workday HCM', 'the customer master data system').

attributes.name: third_party_processors
attributes.description: Names of third-party data processors or vendors involved in processing personal data (e.g., 'AWS', 'Google Cloud', 'Salesforce', 'Payment gateway provider'). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: transfer_safeguards
attributes.description: Legal mechanisms used to safeguard international data transfers (e.g., 'Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC)', 'Binding Corporate Rules (BCR)', 'Adequacy Decision', 'Privacy Shield (legacy)', 'Explicit consent').

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: Business event or initiative that triggered the privacy assessment (e.g., 'New CRM system implementation', 'Third-party data sharing agreement', 'Marketing campaign launch', 'Process change in order fulfillment').

products.name: facility_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the deployment and compliance tracking of training programs at distribution center facilities. It captures which training programs are required or optional at each DC, facility-specific training schedules, completion tracking, and compliance status. Each record links one training program to one DC facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this facility-specific training deployment.. Existence Justification: In retail distribution operations, training programs (forklift certification, hazmat handling, food safety, OSHA compliance) are deployed to multiple DC facilities based on facility type and operational requirements. Each DC facility requires multiple training programs depending on the products handled, equipment used, and regulatory mandates. The business actively manages facility-specific training requirements, tracking which programs are mandatory vs. optional at each location, facility-specific completion schedules, compliance rates, and customized content for site-specific procedures.

products.name: facility_compliance_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between compliance programs and distribution center facilities. It captures facility-specific compliance certification status, audit schedules, scope variations, and program participation details. Each record links one compliance program to one DC facility with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific facility-program certification relationship.. Existence Justification: In retail distribution operations, compliance programs (FDA food safety, OSHA workplace safety, ISO quality, organic certification, PCI-DSS) apply to multiple distribution centers, and each DC must maintain certification under multiple programs simultaneously. The relationship is actively managed by compliance teams who track facility-specific certification status, audit schedules, scope variations (e.g., food safety only applies to food DCs or specific temperature zones), and incident history. attributes.name: enforcement_authority
attributes.description: Level of enforcement power the agency holds (full enforcement with penalties, advisory only, certification authority, audit-only).

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory agency was officially established or incorporated.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Typical number of days between required inspections or audits mandated by this agency for retail operations.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or functional jurisdiction of the regulatory agency (e.g., United States, European Union, California, Payment Card Industry).

attributes.name: maximum_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary penalty amount that the agency can impose for a single violation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special instructions, or context regarding the regulatory agency and its compliance requirements.

attributes.name: penalty_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency has authority to impose fines, penalties, or sanctions for non-compliance (True/False).

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for penalty amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the regulatory agency's headquarters address.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person or department at the regulatory agency for compliance coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary contact person at the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: regulatory_domain
attributes.description: Primary area of regulatory focus and enforcement (e.g., food safety, workplace safety, payment security, data privacy).

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency at which compliance reports must be submitted to this regulatory agency.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the regulatory agency is headquartered.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory agency record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the regulatory agency for accessing regulations, guidance, and compliance resources.

products.name: consent
products.description: Single source of truth for all customer consent records including marketing opt-in/out, data processing, and privacy preferences. Supports GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory frameworks. All consent decisions across channels are recorded here rather than scattered across profile, account, or contact tables.
products.reference: Authoritative consent store per GDPR Art.7 and CCPA 1798.100. All marketing opt-in/out decisions are recorded here; redundant flags on profile/account/contact are deprecated.

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each consent record.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the customer profile that granted or withdrew consent.

attributes.name: collection_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which consent was collected: web, mobile_app, in_store, call_center, paper_form.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current state of this consent record: granted, withdrawn, expired, pending_verification.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the consent decision was recorded.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent granted, e.g. marketing_email, marketing_sms, data_processing, third_party_sharing, profiling, analytics.

attributes.name: data_subject_rights_notice
attributes.description: Whether the data subject was informed of their rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability) at the time of consent.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmed
attributes.description: Whether a double opt-in confirmation (e.g. email link click) was completed.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the double opt-in confirmation was completed.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent automatically expires if not renewed, per regulatory or policy requirements.

attributes.name: granularity
attributes.description: Level of granularity for this consent: broad, purpose_specific, channel_specific, vendor_specific.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used when consent was given or withdrawn; used for audit trail and fraud detection.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record, e.g. EU, California, Brazil, UK.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the consent notice presented to the customer.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis for processing under GDPR: consent, legitimate_interest, contractual_necessity, legal_obligation, vital_interest, public_task.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Method used to capture consent: checkbox, banner_click, verbal, written_signature, double_opt_in.

attributes.name: minor_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject is a minor requiring special consent handling under COPPA or GDPR Article 8.

attributes.name: parental_consent_verified
attributes.description: Whether parental or guardian consent has been verified for minor data subjects.

attributes.name: privacy_policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy policy in effect when consent was captured.

attributes.name: proof_document_url
attributes.description: URL or reference to the stored proof document (screenshot, signed form, recording) evidencing consent.

attributes.name: purpose_category
attributes.description: High-level purpose category for data processing under GDPR Article 6 (e.g. marketing, analytics, service_delivery, legal_obligation, legitimate_interest).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this consent record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that originated this consent record.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when consent renewal is due, typically before expiration_date to allow re-consent collection.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or purpose limitation of the consent, describing what data processing activities are covered.

attributes.name: third_party_recipient
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the third party to whom data may be shared under this consent.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or device user-agent string captured at the time of consent for audit purposes.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this consent record, incremented on each update for optimistic concurrency control.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the customer when withdrawing consent, if any.

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when consent was withdrawn by the customer.

domains.name: supplychain
domains.description: Manages end-to-end supply chain planning and execution from demand forecasting through distribution center operations, including facility management, warehouse workflows, inbound/outbound logistics, replenishment planning, purchase order lifecycle, cross-docking, and supply chain performance monitoring.

products.name: replenishment_plan
products.description: Replenishment plans for SKUs across all supply chain nodes (stores, DCs, MFCs), generated by Blue Yonder or equivalent planning engine. Captures planned order quantities, replenishment triggers, reorder points, safety stock levels and policy parameters (calculation method, service level target, demand variability factor), weeks-of-supply targets, plan status, and MOQ enforcement rules (minimum order quantity, order multiples, minimum order value). SSOT for automated replenishment decisions including buffer stock governance and supplier ordering constraints.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each replenishment plan record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the replenishment_plan data product.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast plan from Blue Yonder Demand Planning that drove the generation of this replenishment plan. Enables traceability from replenishment decision back to the underlying demand signal.

attributes.name: inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain node (store, Distribution Center (DC), or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC)) for which this replenishment plan is generated. Identifies the destination receiving location in the replenishment network.

attributes.name: planner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Replenishment planners own plans for planning accountability and forecast accuracy tracking. Supply chain tracks planner performance on service levels, inventory turns, and forecast bias for performan

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this replenishment plan is generated. The SKU is the primary product-level identifier used in replenishment planning across stores, DCs, and MFCs.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling this replenishment plan. Links to the supplier master for MOQ enforcement, lead time, and EDI ordering constraints.

attributes.name: approved_order_qty
attributes.description: The final order quantity approved by the buyer or auto-approved by the system after MOQ, order multiple, and buyer override adjustments. This is the quantity that will be transmitted to the supplier via EDI or purchase order.

attributes.name: buyer_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a buyer has manually overridden the system-generated planned order quantity or parameters. True = buyer override applied; False = system-generated values accepted as-is. Supports audit trail for manual interventions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was first persisted in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the planned order value and unit cost are expressed (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency retail operations.

attributes.name: current_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU physically on hand at the supply node at the time the replenishment plan was generated. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS or SAP S/4HANA WM. Used as the starting inventory position for plan calculations.

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: A statistical measure of demand variability (coefficient of variation or standard deviation of demand) used by the planning engine to size safety stock. Higher values indicate more volatile demand and result in larger safety stock buffers.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: The target order fill rate percentage (Fill Rate) for this replenishment plan, representing the percentage of demand that should be fulfilled from available inventory. Used as a supply chain performance KPI (KPI) target for this SKU-node combination.

attributes.name: forecasted_demand_qty
attributes.description: The total forecasted demand quantity for the SKU at the supply node over the plan horizon, as generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. The primary input to the planned order quantity calculation.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected receipt at the supply node, as defined in the supplier contract or purchasing info record. Used to calculate reorder points and plan order release dates.

attributes.name: min_order_value
attributes.description: The minimum monetary value of a purchase order required by the supplier, expressed in the operating currency. Replenishment plans that do not meet the minimum order value threshold are consolidated or flagged for buyer action.

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The minimum number of units that must be ordered from the supplier per purchase order line, as enforced by supplier contract terms. Replenishment plans with planned_order_qty below MOQ are rounded up or flagged for buyer review.

attributes.name: moq_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned order quantity meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) constraint. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold and requires buyer review or order consolidation before release.

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of supply chain node receiving the replenishment. Values: store (retail store), dc (Distribution Center), mfc (Micro-Fulfillment Center), dark_store (fulfillment-only location). Drives replenishment logic and lead time parameters.

attributes.name: on_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU already on open purchase orders or in-transit to the supply node at the time of plan generation. Included in the net inventory position calculation to avoid over-ordering.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The unit increment in which the SKU must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Planned order quantities are rounded up to the nearest order multiple before purchase order generation.

attributes.name: order_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the replenishment plan is scheduled to be released as a purchase order to the supplier. Calculated by subtracting lead time from the planned receipt date. Drives the purchasing execution calendar.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why a buyer manually overrode the system-generated replenishment plan. Populated only when buyer_override_flag is True. Supports root cause analysis of planning accuracy and buyer behavior patterns.

attributes.name: plan_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment plan was generated by the planning engine (Blue Yonder or equivalent). Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for plan freshness assessment and demand signal alignment.

attributes.name: plan_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the end of the demand forecast window. Together with plan_horizon_start_date, bounds the coverage period for this plan.

attributes.name: plan_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning horizon covered by this replenishment plan. Defines the beginning of the demand forecast window used to generate the planned order quantity.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the replenishment plan, generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning or SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used for cross-system traceability and supplier communication.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment plan within the planning and execution workflow. Drives automated ordering triggers and buyer review queues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|proposed|approved|released|in_progress|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the origin and nature of the replenishment plan. Automated plans are system-generated by Blue Yonder; manual plans are buyer-created; override plans supersede automated recommendations; emergency plans address urgent stockout risk.

attributes.name: planned_order_qty
attributes.description: The quantity of units recommended by the planning engine to be ordered for this SKU at the specified supply node. Subject to MOQ and order multiple enforcement before release to purchasing.

attributes.name: planned_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the planned replenishment order, calculated as planned_order_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Used for Open-to-Buy (OTB) budget management and financial planning.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_date
attributes.description: The expected date on which the replenishment order is planned to be received at the supply node, calculated as the order release date plus supplier lead time. Used for inventory projection and DC scheduling.

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment plan was generated or adjusted to support a planned promotional event. True = promotion-driven uplift included in forecasted demand; False = baseline replenishment. Links to promotional demand lift in Blue Yonder.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level (in units) at the supply node at which a replenishment order is triggered. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during supplier lead time. Core parameter for reorder-point-based replenishment policies.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The replenishment policy calculation method applied to generate this plan. Min/Max triggers orders when inventory falls below minimum; Reorder Point (ROP) uses statistical triggers; Days of Supply targets coverage duration; Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) delegates to supplier; Cross-Docking bypasses storage; Direct Store Delivery (DSD) is supplier-direct. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: min_max|reorder_point|days_of_supply|vendor_managed|cross_dock|dsd — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Fixed uses a static buffer; Statistical uses demand variability and lead time variance; Days of Supply targets a coverage duration; Service Level Based derives buffer from the target service level percentage.

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: The buffer stock quantity maintained at the supply node to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Represents the minimum inventory floor below which replenishment is urgently triggered. Also referred to as buffer stock.

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
attributes.description: The target in-stock service level percentage used to calculate safety stock and replenishment parameters. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Represents the probability of not experiencing a stockout during the replenishment lead time.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that generated or last updated this replenishment plan. Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking. Values: blue_yonder (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), sap_s4hana (SAP S/4HANA MM), orms (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), manual (buyer-created).

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unit Cost (Cost of Goods Sold - COGS)
attributes.description: The per-unit cost of the SKU from the supplier at the time of plan generation, used to calculate the total planned order value and support COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.

tag_set.value: Unit Cost (Cost of Goods Sold - COGS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this replenishment plan record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Tracks buyer overrides, status transitions, and plan revisions.

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply_target
attributes.description: The target number of weeks of inventory coverage (Weeks of Supply / WOS) that the replenishment plan aims to achieve at the supply node after order receipt. Used as a planning horizon parameter for days-of-supply replenishment methods.

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: SKU-level demand forecast records generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Captures forecasted units, revenue, forecast horizon, statistical model used, override flags, forecast accuracy (MAPE/WMAPE), and demand signals including seasonality, promotions lift, and trend adjustments. Drives replenishment and OTB planning.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU-level demand forecast record generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Serves as the primary key for this table.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center (DC), or fulfillment node for which the demand forecast applies. Supports store-level and DC-level replenishment planning.

attributes.name: planner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Demand planners own forecasts for planning accountability and accuracy tracking. Supply chain tracks planner MAPE, bias, and forecast quality by planner for performance management, S&OP reviews, and p

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which the demand forecast is generated. The SKU is the atomic unit of inventory and demand planning in retail.

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_units
attributes.description: The pure statistical baseline demand forecast in units before any adjustments for promotions, seasonality, or manual overrides. Provides the unadjusted demand signal for comparison against the final consensus forecast.

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (expressed as a percentage, e.g., 95.00) associated with the forecast interval. Indicates the probability that actual demand will fall within the forecast range. Used to set safety stock levels and replenishment buffers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this demand forecast record was first written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and incremental load processing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the forecasted revenue amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency retail operations across international markets.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that provided the demand signal inputs used to generate this forecast (e.g., SAP_CAR for POS transaction data, Salesforce_Commerce_Cloud for e-commerce demand, ORMS for inventory positions). Supports data lineage and source system auditability.

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of the SKU's demand pattern used to select the appropriate forecasting model. 'regular' indicates stable, predictable demand; 'intermittent' indicates sporadic demand (Croston model); 'lumpy' indicates irregular high-volume spikes; 'new_item' indicates insufficient history; 'end_of_life' indicates declining/discontinuing SKU.

attributes.name: forecast_bias
attributes.description: The systematic directional error in the forecast, calculated as the mean of (forecasted units minus actual units) over a rolling period. Positive values indicate over-forecasting (excess inventory risk); negative values indicate under-forecasting (stockout risk). Critical for replenishment safety stock calibration.

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this forecast record was generated by the Blue Yonder Demand Planning engine. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the forecast lifecycle and supports version comparison across planning cycles.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: The total number of weeks into the future covered by this forecast run, measured from the forecast generation date. Determines the planning horizon for replenishment, Open-to-Buy (OTB), and supply chain optimization.

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_units
attributes.description: The lower bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the low-demand scenario used for minimum order quantity (MOQ) planning and markdown risk assessment.

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Together with forecast_period_start_date, defines the time bucket granularity (daily, weekly, monthly).

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the forecast horizon period covered by this record. Defines the beginning of the time bucket (day, week, or month) for which demand is forecasted.

attributes.name: forecast_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific Blue Yonder Demand Planning batch run that generated this forecast record. Enables traceability back to the originating planning cycle and supports audit of forecast lineage.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the demand forecast record. 'draft' indicates a preliminary run; 'published' indicates the forecast is active for replenishment; 'approved' indicates planner sign-off; 'overridden' indicates a manual adjustment was applied; 'superseded' indicates a newer run has replaced this record; 'archived' indicates the record is retained for historical analysis only.

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand forecast by its planning purpose. 'baseline' is the statistical base demand without uplift; 'promotional' incorporates promotion lift; 'seasonal' reflects seasonal index adjustments; 'event_driven' accounts for specific demand events; 'consensus' is the final agreed forecast used for replenishment and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_units
attributes.description: The upper bound of the forecast confidence interval in units at the specified confidence level. Represents the high-demand scenario used for safety stock and maximum inventory planning to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: An incrementing integer version number for the forecast record for a given SKU-location-period combination. Enables tracking of forecast revisions across planning cycles and supports comparison of forecast evolution over time.

attributes.name: forecasted_revenue
attributes.description: The projected revenue in the operating currency derived from the forecasted units multiplied by the expected selling price for the forecast period. Used in financial planning, Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgeting, and Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) analysis.

attributes.name: forecasted_units
attributes.description: The statistical model's predicted demand quantity in sellable units for the SKU at the specified location during the forecast period. This is the primary quantitative output of the demand planning engine and drives replenishment order quantities.

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record is the most current version for the given SKU-location-period combination. True means this record is the active forecast used for replenishment and OTB planning; False means it has been superseded by a newer forecast run.

attributes.name: is_new_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is a new item with insufficient sales history for statistical forecasting. When True, the forecast relies on analogous item modeling or planner input rather than historical demand patterns. Relevant for new product launches and assortment introductions.

attributes.name: is_override_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a demand planner has manually overridden the statistical forecast for this record. True means the final forecasted_units reflect a planner adjustment; False means the forecast is purely statistical. Critical for measuring forecast bias introduced by manual intervention.

attributes.name: is_promotional_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the forecast period overlaps with an active promotional event. When True, the promotional_lift_units field is expected to be populated and the forecast incorporates promotion-driven demand uplift.

attributes.name: mape
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) measuring the accuracy of the statistical forecast against actual sales for the equivalent prior period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.12 = 12% error). Lower values indicate higher forecast accuracy. Used as the primary KPI for demand planning performance.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the statistical forecasting model used to generate this forecast record. Supports model governance, reproducibility, and performance tracking across model upgrades in Blue Yonder Demand Planning.

attributes.name: otb_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast record has been incorporated into the Open-to-Buy (OTB) financial plan. When True, the forecasted revenue and units are reflected in the merchandise financial plan and buying budget for the relevant period.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: A standardized code indicating the business reason for the planner's manual override of the statistical forecast (e.g., new product launch, competitor action, supply constraint, market intelligence). Populated only when is_override_applied is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEW_PRODUCT|COMPETITOR_ACTION|SUPPLY_CONSTRAINT|MARKET_INTEL|PROMO_CHANGE|STORE_EVENT|WEATHER — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: override_units
attributes.description: The manually adjusted demand quantity in units entered by a demand planner to replace or supplement the statistical forecast. Populated only when is_override_applied is True. Enables analysis of planner override magnitude and its impact on forecast accuracy.

attributes.name: planning_channel
attributes.description: The retail fulfillment channel for which this demand forecast is generated. 'store' covers brick-and-mortar POS demand; 'ecommerce' covers digital commerce demand from Salesforce Commerce Cloud; 'omnichannel' covers unified demand signals; 'dc_replenishment' covers distribution center stock replenishment; 'bopis' covers Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS) demand.

attributes.name: promotional_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental demand units attributed to active promotions during the forecast period. Derived from promotion event modeling in Blue Yonder and used to isolate the promotional demand signal from baseline demand for Pricing and Promotions Management analysis.

attributes.name: replenishment_recommendation_units
attributes.description: The system-recommended replenishment order quantity in units derived from the demand forecast, current inventory position, safety stock targets, and lead time. Feeds directly into Oracle Retail Merchandising System (ORMS) purchase order generation and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_index
attributes.description: A multiplicative seasonal index applied to the baseline forecast to account for recurring seasonal demand patterns (e.g., holiday peaks, back-to-school). A value of 1.0 indicates no seasonal adjustment; values above 1.0 indicate above-average seasonal demand.

attributes.name: statistical_model_code
attributes.description: The identifier or code of the statistical forecasting algorithm used by Blue Yonder Demand Planning to generate this forecast (e.g., ARIMA, Holt-Winters exponential smoothing, Croston for intermittent demand, machine learning ensemble). Enables model performance benchmarking and algorithm governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ARIMA|HOLT_WINTERS|CROSTON|ETS|MOVING_AVG|ML_ENSEMBLE|CAUSAL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: time_bucket_granularity
attributes.description: The temporal granularity of the forecast period covered by this record. 'daily' is used for short-horizon replenishment; 'weekly' is the standard planning cadence; 'monthly' is used for financial and Open-to-Buy (OTB) planning.

attributes.name: trend_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplicative factor representing the long-term demand trend applied to the forecast. Values above 1.0 indicate upward trend; values below 1.0 indicate declining demand trend. Used to capture secular demand shifts beyond seasonal patterns.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this demand forecast record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, including override applications, accuracy recalculations, or status changes.

attributes.name: weeks_of_supply
attributes.description: Weeks of Supply (WOS) — the projected number of weeks the current on-hand inventory will cover demand based on the forecasted units. A key inventory health metric used in replenishment planning to identify stockout risk and excess inventory positions.

attributes.name: wmape
attributes.description: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error (WMAPE) measuring forecast accuracy weighted by sales volume, reducing the distortion caused by low-volume SKUs. Expressed as a decimal. Preferred accuracy metric for high-volume retail assortments where MAPE can be misleading.

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Purchase order header records representing procurement commitments to suppliers, managed in SAP MM or Oracle RMS. Captures PO number, supplier reference, buyer, order and expected delivery dates, total value, currency, payment terms, incoterms, PO type (standard, blanket, DSD), approval status, and EDI transmission status. SSOT for the PO lifecycle from creation through closure.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for purchase_order

attributes.name: blanket_po_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent blanket or framework purchase order from which this release or call-off order was created. Null for standalone standard POs. Enables tracking of spend against blanket agreement limits.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal buyer or purchasing agent responsible for creating and managing this purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKGRP (purchasing group) owner.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center or store location designated as the delivery destination for this purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WERKS (plant/site).

attributes.name: receiving_coordinator_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: DC receiving coordinators manage PO receipts for operational ownership and accountability. Operations tracks receipt accuracy, cycle time, and discrepancy resolution by coordinator for performance man

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) fulfilling this purchase order. Links to the supplier master data product managed in Informatica MDM. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.LIFNR (vendor account number).

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the destination facility. Populated upon goods receipt posting in SAP (MIGO transaction). Used to calculate supplier on-time delivery performance and lead time actuals.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Authorization workflow status indicating whether the purchase order has been approved by the required approvers per the company's procurement authorization matrix. Distinct from po_status as it tracks the internal approval gate specifically.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order received final authorization approval. Captures the precise moment the procurement commitment became binding. Used for approval cycle time analytics and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date by which the purchase order must be cancelled if goods have not shipped. Also known as the cancel date or cancel-by date in retail procurement. Null if the PO has not been cancelled or does not have a cancellation deadline.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or business unit issuing the purchase order. Used for financial reporting, P&L allocation, and intercompany reconciliation. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BUKRS.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier after PO acknowledgment. May differ from expected_delivery_date if the supplier cannot meet the original requested date. Used to update replenishment plans and manage weeks of supply (WOS).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order record was first created in the source system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.AEDAT (creation date) combined with time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WAERS (currency key).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount or allowance amount applied to the purchase order by the supplier, including volume discounts, promotional allowances, and trade deals. Reduces the net payable amount. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.

attributes.name: edi_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of the EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transmission of this purchase order to the supplier. Not Sent = EDI not applicable or not yet initiated; Pending = queued for transmission; Transmitted = EDI 850 PO sent to supplier; Acknowledged = supplier returned EDI 855 acknowledgment; Failed = transmission error; Rejected = supplier rejected the PO via EDI.

attributes.name: edi_transmitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order was transmitted to the supplier via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) as an EDI 850 transaction set. Null if EDI transmission has not occurred. Used for supplier communication SLA tracking.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the purchase order amounts from the supplier's transaction currency to the company's functional currency at the time of PO creation. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.WKURS.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The agreed-upon date by which the supplier is expected to deliver the ordered goods to the designated distribution center or store. Used for supply chain planning, replenishment scheduling, and SLA monitoring. Corresponds to SAP EKET.EINDT (scheduled delivery date).

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of ordered units that have been received and fulfilled by the supplier, calculated as (total_received_units / total_ordered_units) * 100. Fill Rate is a key supplier performance KPI measuring order completion. Stored as a pre-computed operational field updated upon each goods receipt.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation (e.g., FOB = Free On Board, DDP = Delivered Duty Paid, CIF = Cost Insurance Freight). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.INCO1. Critical for import/export compliance and logistics cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying the exact location where risk and cost transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., 'Port of Los Angeles' for FOB). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.INCO2.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is designated for cross-docking at the distribution center, meaning goods will be transferred directly from inbound to outbound without putaway storage. Cross-docking reduces DC handling costs and accelerates store replenishment.

attributes.name: is_drop_ship
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is a drop ship arrangement where the supplier ships goods directly to the end customer, bypassing the retailer's distribution center. Drop ship POs are common in e-commerce and extended aisle assortments.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the purchase order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The agreed or expected number of days from purchase order placement to goods receipt at the destination facility. Used in replenishment planning, weeks of supply (WOS) calculations, and Blue Yonder demand planning models. Corresponds to supplier lead time in the procurement master data.

attributes.name: merchandise_category_code
attributes.description: The merchandise category or department code associated with the primary goods on this purchase order, aligned with the retailer's category management hierarchy. Used for spend analytics by category, OTB (Open to Buy) tracking, and GMROI reporting.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity the supplier requires for this purchase order, as defined in the supplier agreement or item master. MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) constraints drive order sizing decisions in replenishment planning and OTB management.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the supplier after applying all discounts, allowances, and adjustments to the gross total order amount. This is the financial commitment recorded in accounts payable. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for buyer notes, special instructions, or remarks associated with the purchase order. May include delivery instructions, quality requirements, or supplier-specific handling notes. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.IHREZ (your reference) or header text.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was officially created and issued. This is the principal real-world event date for the procurement commitment. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.BEDAT (document date).

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the agreed payment terms between the retailer and supplier (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Corresponds to SAP EKKO.ZTERM (terms of payment key). Drives accounts payable scheduling and early payment discount capture.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable purchase order number assigned by the procurement system (SAP MM or Oracle RMS). Used in EDI transmissions, supplier communications, and receiving workflows. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EBELN field.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase order from creation through closure. Draft = created but not submitted; Pending Approval = awaiting authorization; Approved = authorized for transmission; Sent = transmitted to supplier via EDI or portal; Partially Received = some goods received; Received = all goods received; Closed = fully processed and closed; Cancelled = voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement method. Standard = regular replenishment PO; Blanket = open-quantity framework agreement; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) = supplier delivers directly to store; Drop Ship = vendor ships direct to customer; Consignment = inventory owned by supplier until sold; RTV (Return to Vendor) = merchandise returned to supplier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|blanket|direct_store_delivery|drop_ship|consignment|return_to_vendor — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer group or commodity team responsible for this purchase order within the purchasing organization. Used for spend analytics by category and buyer performance reporting. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKGRP.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization code representing the organizational unit responsible for procuring goods and services. Defines the legal entity and negotiation authority for the purchase order. Corresponds to SAP EKKO.EKORG.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this purchase order record originated. SAP_MM = SAP S/4HANA Materials Management; ORMS = Oracle Retail Merchandising System; MANUAL = manually entered; EDI = created via EDI inbound processing. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supplier_po_reference
attributes.description: The supplier's own reference number or acknowledgment number for this purchase order, returned via EDI 855 or supplier portal. Used for cross-referencing in supplier invoices, ASNs (Advance Ship Notices), and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: total_order_amount
attributes.description: The gross total monetary value of the purchase order before any adjustments, representing the sum of all line item values. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code. Used for open-to-buy (OTB) tracking, financial commitments, and accounts payable accruals.

attributes.name: total_ordered_units
attributes.description: The total quantity of units ordered across all line items on this purchase order. Used for fill rate calculation, receiving reconciliation, and inventory planning. Expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: total_received_units
attributes.description: The total quantity of units physically received and goods-receipted against this purchase order to date. Used to calculate fill rate (order completion percentage) and identify short shipments or over-deliveries.

products.name: po_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each purchase order. Captures SKU/GTIN, ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit cost, extended cost, confirmed quantity, shipped quantity, received quantity, line status, MOQ compliance flag, and lead-time commitment. Enables granular PO tracking at the SKU level.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each purchase order line item in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the po_line data product.

attributes.name: buyer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise buyer or procurement officer responsible for this PO line. Supports buyer performance reporting, OTB management, and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific destination location (DC, store, or fulfillment center) where this PO line is to be delivered. Supports multi-destination PO management and DC-to-store allocation.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise department or category to which this PO line's SKU belongs. Supports departmental OTB tracking, assortment planning, and financial reporting by merchandise hierarchy.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record for the item being ordered on this PO line. Links to the product master for full item attributes. [RESOURCE_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for PO lifecycle tracking. [HEADER_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) fulfilling this PO line. Enables supplier performance analysis at the line level, including fill rate and lead time compliance.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods for this PO line were physically received at the destination. Used to calculate on-time delivery performance and actual lead time versus committed lead time.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Supplier-granted trade allowance or promotional funding amount applied to this PO line (e.g., off-invoice allowance, scan allowance). Reduces net cost and impacts COGS and GMROI calculations.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Supplier-provided Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) number associated with the shipment of this PO line. Enables pre-receipt processing at the DC and cross-referencing with EDI 856 transactions.

attributes.name: cancel_date
attributes.description: The latest date by which this PO line must be received; if not received by this date, the line is automatically cancelled. Critical for seasonal and fashion merchandise to prevent late deliveries.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier for this PO line. May differ from the requested delivery date; variance drives lead time compliance KPIs and supplier scorecards.

attributes.name: confirmed_qty
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed by the supplier as available and committed for shipment on this PO line. May differ from ordered quantity due to supplier capacity constraints or MOQ adjustments.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the product on this PO line was manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations, import compliance, and consumer labeling regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PO line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for PO creation and supports data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and extended cost on this PO line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency supplier contracts and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Type of destination for this PO line shipment. Indicates whether goods are routed to a Distribution Center (DC), direct to store (DSD), cross-docking facility, drop ship to customer, or Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC).

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this PO line calculated as ordered_qty multiplied by unit_cost. Represents the gross financial commitment for this line item before any allowances or discounts.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for the product on this PO line. Supports EDI transactions, supplier collaboration, and cross-retailer product identification. May be a GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk/cost responsibility between buyer and supplier for this PO line (e.g., FOB, DDP, CIF). Critical for landed cost calculation and logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Supplier invoice number associated with this PO line for three-way match processing (PO, receipt, invoice). Links to accounts payable for payment processing and FASB ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this PO line record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture, audit compliance, and Silver Layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Committed supplier lead time in calendar days from PO placement to expected delivery for this line item. Used for replenishment planning, OTB management, and supplier SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent purchase order, used to uniquely identify and order line items within a PO. Corresponds to SAP MM item number (EBELP). [LINE_SEQUENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this PO line item, tracking progression from open through fulfillment or cancellation. Drives replenishment alerts and supplier follow-up actions. [LIFECYCLE_STATUS — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: The supplier's contractual Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for this SKU on this PO line. Used to validate ordered_qty compliance and negotiate order consolidation.

attributes.name: moq_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ordered quantity on this PO line meets or exceeds the supplier's Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirement. Non-compliant lines may incur supplier penalties or require buyer approval.

attributes.name: net_cost
attributes.description: Net cost per unit after applying all supplier allowances, discounts, and deductions to the unit cost. Represents the true landed cost basis for COGS and margin calculations.

attributes.name: order_uom_qty
attributes.description: Number of base selling units (eaches) contained within one purchase unit of measure. Enables conversion between purchase UOM and retail selling UOM for inventory and sales reporting (e.g., 12 eaches per case).

attributes.name: ordered_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU ordered on this PO line, expressed in the purchase unit of measure. Represents the buyer's original demand signal to the supplier. [LINE_QUANTITY — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: otb_consumed
attributes.description: Dollar value of Open to Buy (OTB) budget consumed by this PO line at the time of order placement. Used for merchandise financial planning and budget compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: received_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU physically received and confirmed at the distribution center or store against this PO line. Drives inventory on-hand updates and three-way match for invoice processing.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for any quantity rejected or returned to vendor (RTV) during receiving for this PO line (e.g., damaged goods, wrong item, quality failure). Supports chargeback processing and supplier compliance management.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the retailer requests delivery of this PO line at the destination (DC or store). Used for lead time compliance monitoring and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: retail_price
attributes.description: Planned retail selling price (AUR - Average Unit Retail) for this SKU at the time of PO creation. Used for initial margin calculation and GMROI planning at the line level.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier shipped goods for this PO line, as reported via ASN or EDI 856. Used to calculate in-transit duration and validate supplier shipping compliance.

attributes.name: shipped_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU that the supplier has physically shipped against this PO line, as reported via ASN (Advance Shipment Notice) or EDI 856. Used to calculate in-transit inventory.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal retailer-assigned Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant (size, color, style) ordered on this line. Used for inventory management and POS reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Agreed purchase cost per unit of the SKU on this PO line, in the transaction currency. Represents the negotiated supplier price and is the basis for COGS calculation and GMROI analysis. [LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT — TRANSACTION_LINE canonical category]

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the ordered, confirmed, shipped, and received quantities are expressed (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack, LB=Pound). Aligns with GS1 and SAP MM unit of measure codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|LB|KG|OZ|L|M|FT|DZ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own item number or part number for the product on this PO line. Used in EDI transactions and supplier communications to cross-reference retailer SKU with supplier catalog number.

products.name: plan
products.description: Aggregated supply plan at the SKU-DC-week level, reconciling demand forecasts with available supply, open POs, in-transit inventory, and supplier capacity constraints. Captures planned receipt quantities, projected on-hand, weeks-of-supply, stockout risk score, excess inventory flags, allocation priorities for constrained supply, and plan version/approval status. Master supply-demand balancing record used by planners in weekly S&OP reviews to identify coverage gaps, trigger replenishment actions, and prioritize allocation across stores and DCs.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plan

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Distribution Center (DC) for which this supply plan is generated. Identifies the fulfillment node responsible for receiving, storing, and distributing the planned SKU.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active promotion associated with this SKU-DC-week supply plan. Promotional events drive demand uplift adjustments to the consensus demand quantity and may require incremental supply planning.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open Purchase Order (PO) associated with this supply plan record. Links the plan to the procurement execution layer for tracking open PO quantities and expected receipt dates.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being planned. The SKU is the lowest-level product identifier used for inventory tracking and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier responsible for fulfilling the planned receipt quantities for this SKU-DC combination. Used to evaluate supplier capacity constraints during supply-demand balancing.

attributes.name: allocation_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank (1 = highest priority) assigned to this DC for allocation of constrained supply for the SKU. Used by planners to prioritize distribution of limited inventory across DCs and stores during supply-constrained periods.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status of the supply plan record within the S&OP governance process. Pending plans await planner or manager sign-off; approved plans are authorized for execution; rejected plans require revision; escalated plans require senior leadership review.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply plan record was approved in the S&OP workflow. Provides a precise audit trail for plan authorization and supports compliance with internal governance controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the supply chain planner or manager who approved this supply plan record in the S&OP workflow. Provides audit trail for plan authorization decisions.

attributes.name: beginning_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Projected on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC at the start of the planning week, before any receipts or demand consumption. Used as the opening inventory position for supply-demand balancing calculations.

attributes.name: consensus_demand_qty
attributes.description: Agreed demand quantity after S&OP consensus adjustments, incorporating planner overrides, promotional uplifts, and commercial inputs. This is the demand signal used for supply-demand balancing in the approved plan.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supply plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for the plan lifecycle and supports data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: crossdock_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU planned for cross-docking at the DC, bypassing put-away storage and flowing directly from inbound receipt to outbound shipment. Supports DC throughput optimization and reduces handling costs for high-velocity items.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Statistical demand forecast quantity for the SKU at the DC for the planning week, expressed in the SKU's unit of measure. Sourced from Blue Yonder Demand Planning and represents the baseline demand signal before supply constraints are applied.

attributes.name: excess_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the projected on-hand quantity exceeds the maximum inventory target for the SKU-DC combination in the planning week. When True, signals a potential dead stock or overstock situation requiring markdown or redistribution action.

attributes.name: in_transit_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU currently in transit from supplier or another DC, expected to arrive at the destination DC within the planning week. Represents confirmed supply pipeline inventory not yet received.

attributes.name: max_inventory_qty
attributes.description: Maximum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC, representing the upper bound of the inventory target range. Projected on-hand quantities exceeding this threshold trigger the excess inventory flag.

attributes.name: min_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) required by the supplier for this SKU, representing the smallest quantity that can be ordered in a single purchase order. Constrains replenishment order quantities in the supply plan.

attributes.name: open_po_qty
attributes.description: Quantity on open, unfulfilled Purchase Orders (POs) for this SKU-DC combination expected to be received within the planning week. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM and ORMS to represent committed supply.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business-facing externally-known identifier for the supply plan record, used in S&OP communications, planner workflows, and cross-system references. Typically formatted as a combination of DC code, SKU, and planning week.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply plan record within the S&OP approval workflow. Draft plans are under construction; submitted plans await approval; approved plans are baselined for execution; locked plans are frozen for the current cycle.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply plan by planning methodology. Consensus plans reflect agreed S&OP output; unconstrained plans reflect pure demand signal; constrained plans incorporate supplier and DC capacity limits; allocation plans reflect prioritized distribution of limited supply.

attributes.name: planned_receipt_qty
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU planned to be received at the DC during the planning week from all supply sources (open POs, in-transit, cross-dock). Core output of the supply planning process used to assess coverage against demand.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the supply chain planner to document assumptions, exceptions, override rationale, or action items associated with this supply plan record. Supports S&OP review discussions and audit trail.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: Number of weeks forward from the plan week start date that this supply plan covers. Defines the rolling planning window used for demand-supply balancing and replenishment trigger decisions.

attributes.name: projected_on_hand_qty
attributes.description: Projected ending on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC at the end of the planning week, calculated as beginning on-hand plus planned receipts minus consensus demand. Key metric for identifying coverage gaps and excess inventory.

attributes.name: promotional_uplift_qty
attributes.description: Incremental demand quantity attributed to a promotional event for this SKU-DC-week, added on top of the baseline statistical forecast to derive the consensus demand quantity. Sourced from the promotions planning system.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_qty
