attributes.description: Identifier of the originating facility for inter-facility transfers. Null for supplier-direct shipments.

attributes.name: primary_inbound_dc_facility_id

attributes.description: Warehouse wave or batch that included this line for picking. Links to wave planning for labor optimization and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: allocated_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units allocated from available inventory to fulfill this line. May differ from ordered quantity due to stock availability constraints.

attributes.name: carton_number
attributes.description: Shipping carton or container identifier containing this line item. Used for package-level tracking and multi-carton shipment management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this outbound order line record was first created in the warehouse management system. Audit trail for order entry and system integration.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Enables multi-currency operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-before date for perishable goods. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic and shelf-life management.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this line (unit cost multiplied by shipped quantity). Represents inventory value transferred from DC to destination.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global trade item number (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the product. Enables cross-system product identification and EDI transaction processing.

attributes.name: handling_instructions
attributes.description: Special handling requirements or notes for warehouse and carrier personnel. Includes fragile, orientation, stacking, and security instructions.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and carrier certification per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line requires refrigerated or climate-controlled transportation and storage to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to this line record. Tracks status changes, quantity adjustments, and data corrections throughout fulfillment lifecycle.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the outbound order. Establishes ordering and uniqueness of line items within a single order document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this order line. Tracks progression through warehouse workflow from allocation through shipment or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|cancelled|short_shipped|backordered — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number for traceability. Critical for product recalls, quality control, and regulatory compliance in food and pharmaceutical retail.

attributes.name: ordered_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units originally requested for this line item. Represents the demand signal from the destination location or customer.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU requested if a substitution was made. Enables demand signal accuracy and substitution pattern analysis for assortment planning.

attributes.name: packed_qty
attributes.description: Quantity of units packed into shipping containers for this line. Confirms units staged for outbound shipment and ready for carrier pickup.

attributes.name: picked_qty
attributes.description: Actual quantity of units physically picked from warehouse storage locations. Reflects warehouse execution accuracy and inventory availability.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized items such as electronics, appliances, or high-value goods. Enables item-level tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: shipped_qty
attributes.description: Final quantity of units shipped to the destination. Used for fill rate calculation, short-ship identification, and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: short_ship_qty
attributes.description: Quantity variance between ordered and shipped units. Represents unfulfilled demand due to stockouts, damage, or allocation constraints.

attributes.name: short_ship_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this line was short-shipped. Used for root cause analysis, supplier performance tracking, and inventory planning improvement.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code identifying the specific product variant being shipped. Used for inventory tracking and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a substitute product was shipped in place of the originally ordered SKU due to stockout or allocation constraints.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specific temperature control requirement for this line item. Drives carrier selection, routing, and cold chain compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit for this line item at time of shipment. Used for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields on this line. Standardizes quantity interpretation across systems and trading partners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|GAL|LTR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of this line item. Used for trailer utilization, storage capacity planning, and dimensional weight pricing.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of this line item in kilograms. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier capacity planning, and load optimization.

products.name: wave
products.description: A wave is a batch grouping of outbound order lines released together for coordinated picking within a DC. Captures wave number, wave type (single-order, multi-order, cluster, zone, demand-based), release timestamp, planned pick start/end, total lines, total units, assigned pick zones, wave status (planned, released, in-progress, short-closed, complete), fill rate, and short-ship disposition rule. Wave management is a core Manhattan WMS workflow that drives labor scheduling, equipment allocation, and pick zone sequencing for optimal DC throughput.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wave batch. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Warehouse supervisor or shift manager responsible for overseeing execution of this wave.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Shipping carrier assigned to transport the outbound shipments generated from this wave.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Distribution center where this wave is being executed.

attributes.name: merchandise_category_id
attributes.description: Primary product category for items in this wave, used for category-based wave planning and zone assignment.

attributes.name: actual_pick_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the last pick task in this wave was completed.

attributes.name: actual_pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the first pick task in this wave was started by warehouse associates.

attributes.name: assigned_pick_zones
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of warehouse pick zone identifiers assigned to this wave for zone-based picking strategies.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: Shipping service level for this wave (e.g., ground, two-day, next-day, same-day) determining delivery speed and cost.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Destination channel for orders in this wave: store_replenishment (DC to store), ecommerce (DC to customer), BOPIS (buy online pick up in store), ship_from_store, wholesale (B2B), marketplace (third-party platform).

attributes.name: consolidation_location
attributes.description: Warehouse staging area or dock door where picked items from this wave are consolidated for packing and shipping.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was first created in the WMS system.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Primary material handling equipment or picking technology allocated for this wave execution.

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered units successfully picked, calculated as (picked_units / total_units) * 100, measuring wave execution effectiveness.

attributes.name: generation_method
attributes.description: Method used to create this wave: scheduled (time-based automatic), manual (planner-initiated), demand_triggered (order volume threshold), threshold_based (inventory or capacity rule).

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wave contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and compliance documentation per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wave contains orders driven by promotional campaigns or special marketing events requiring expedited handling.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this wave requires temperature-controlled handling and storage (refrigerated or frozen goods).

attributes.name: labor_hours_actual
attributes.description: Actual total labor hours consumed by warehouse associates to complete this wave, measured from task start to completion.

attributes.name: labor_hours_planned
attributes.description: Estimated total labor hours required to complete picking, packing, and staging for this wave, used for workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was most recently modified, tracking status changes and execution progress.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions for warehouse associates executing this wave (e.g., gift wrap required, fragile items, rush processing).

attributes.name: picked_units
attributes.description: Actual quantity of units successfully picked and confirmed for this wave.

attributes.name: planned_pick_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for picking operations to complete for this wave.

attributes.name: planned_pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for picking operations to begin for this wave.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for wave execution sequencing, with lower numbers indicating higher priority for labor allocation and equipment assignment.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wave was released to the warehouse floor for picking execution.

attributes.name: short_ship_disposition
attributes.description: Business rule applied to handle short-picked units: cancel (remove from order), backorder (fulfill later), substitute (offer alternative SKU), split_shipment (ship partial now).

attributes.name: short_units
attributes.description: Quantity of units that could not be picked due to inventory shortage or location discrepancies.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature control zone for this wave: ambient (room temperature), refrigerated (33-40°F), frozen (0°F or below).

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the wave template configuration that defines the rules and parameters used to generate this wave.

attributes.name: total_cartons
attributes.description: Total number of cartons or shipping containers generated from this wave for outbound shipment.

attributes.name: total_order_lines
attributes.description: Total count of order line items included in this wave batch for picking.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of individual units (eaches) to be picked across all lines in this wave.

attributes.name: units_per_hour
attributes.description: Productivity metric calculated as picked_units divided by labor_hours_actual, measuring warehouse picking efficiency.

attributes.name: wave_number
attributes.description: Business-facing wave identifier used for operational tracking and communication across warehouse teams.

attributes.name: wave_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wave: planned (created but not released), released (available for picking), in-progress (actively being picked), short-closed (closed with shortages), complete (all lines picked), cancelled (wave aborted).

attributes.name: wave_type
attributes.description: Classification of wave picking strategy: single-order (discrete pick per order), multi-order (batch pick across orders), cluster (cart-based multi-order), zone (pick within assigned zones), wave-less (continuous release), demand-based (dynamic priority-driven release).

products.name: outbound_shipment
products.description: Represents a physical outbound shipment dispatched from a DC or MFC to a destination (store, customer, 3PL node). Captures shipment number, carrier and SCAC code, service level (ground, express, same-day, LTL, FTL), trailer/vehicle ID, seal number, manifest ID, total cartons, total pallets, total weight/cube, ship date/time, estimated and actual delivery dates, shipment status (manifested, loading, in-transit, delivered, exception), and tracking numbers. Includes carton-level packing detail: pack station ID, operator, carton/tote ID, items packed (SKU, quantity, lot), carton weight/dimensions, void fill, shipping label reference, packing slip, QC check result (pass/fail/repack), and pack completion timestamp. SSOT for outbound shipment execution, carton-level tracking, and carrier manifesting within the distribution domain.

attributes.name: outbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for outbound_shipment

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the shipment from origin to destination.

attributes.name: destination_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination entity (store, customer address, 3PL node, or DC) receiving the shipment.

attributes.name: outbound_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, or dark store from which the shipment originates.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse picking wave that generated the orders included in this shipment.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the shipment was delivered and received at the destination.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the shipment was delivered and signed for at the destination.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Legal document number issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Four-letter code uniquely identifying the transportation carrier, assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shipment record was first created in the warehouse management system.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination entity type to which the shipment is being sent.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the loading dock door from which the shipment was dispatched at the origin facility.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: The carrier-provided or system-calculated expected delivery date at the destination.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of exception or issue encountered during shipment processing or transit (e.g., damaged, delayed, refused).

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any exception or issue encountered during shipment processing, loading, transit, or delivery.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Total transportation cost charged by the carrier for moving the shipment from origin to destination.

attributes.name: freight_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and documentation.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment requires temperature-controlled transportation (refrigerated or frozen).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shipment record was most recently modified or updated.

attributes.name: manifest_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carrier manifest document that groups multiple shipments for a single carrier pickup or route.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional shipment instructions, special handling requirements, or operational notes.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment was delivered on or before the estimated delivery date, used for carrier performance measurement.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Progressive number assigned by Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) carriers to track freight shipments.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the tamper-evident seal applied to the trailer or container to ensure shipment integrity during transit.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: The transportation service tier selected for this shipment, defining speed and handling characteristics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ground|express|same_day|next_day|two_day|ltl|ftl|parcel — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shipment departed the origin facility.

attributes.name: ship_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the shipment departed the origin facility and was handed over to the carrier.

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique shipment number used for tracking and reference across systems and with carriers.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outbound shipment indicating its position in the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manifested|loading|staged|in_transit|delivered|exception|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment based on its business purpose and destination type.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specifies the temperature control requirement for the shipment during transportation.

attributes.name: total_cartons
attributes.description: Total number of cartons or packages included in the shipment.

attributes.name: total_cube_m3
attributes.description: Total volumetric cube of the shipment in cubic meters, used for capacity planning and freight costing.

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets included in the shipment.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of individual SKU units included across all cartons in the shipment.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging materials.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Primary carrier-assigned tracking number used to monitor shipment progress and delivery status.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the trailer or vehicle used to transport the shipment.

products.name: crossdock_transaction
products.description: Captures cross-docking events where inbound freight is transferred directly from receiving docks to outbound staging without entering reserve storage. Records inbound shipment reference, outbound order reference, SKU, quantity cross-docked, source dock door, destination dock door, transfer timestamp, cross-dock type (pre-allocated, opportunistic flow-through, merge-in-transit, retail-ready), handling unit ID, and priority flag. Supports DC throughput optimization, reduces storage dwell time, and enables vendor-direct-to-store flow programs common in grocery and apparel retail.

attributes.name: crossdock_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cross-dock transaction event. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the carrier responsible for transporting the cross-docked goods to the destination.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center where the cross-dock operation occurred.

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the handling unit (pallet, container, or carton) used to move the goods through the cross-dock process.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment from which goods were received for cross-docking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store or fulfillment location to which the cross-docked goods are being sent.

attributes.name: outbound_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound order or shipment to which the cross-docked goods were allocated.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotion associated with the cross-docked merchandise, if applicable.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product being cross-docked.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier who provided the inbound goods being cross-docked.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number associated with the inbound shipment, providing pre-arrival inventory details.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of lading number for the outbound shipment, serving as a legal document and receipt for the goods.

attributes.name: carton_count
attributes.description: Number of cartons or cases included in this cross-dock transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cross-dock transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_type
attributes.description: Type of cross-dock operation: pre-allocated (pre-assigned to outbound orders), opportunistic (matched at dock), flow-through (continuous transfer), merge-in-transit (consolidation), retail-ready (floor-ready merchandise), or vendor-direct (DSD bypass).

attributes.name: destination_dock_door
attributes.description: Dock door number or identifier where the goods were staged for outbound shipment.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes that the goods spent in the cross-dock facility from inbound receipt to outbound staging, used to measure throughput efficiency.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any exception or issue encountered during the cross-dock process (e.g., short shipment, damage, mismatch).

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any exception or issue that occurred during the cross-dock transaction.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product, providing international product identification.

attributes.name: handling_instructions
attributes.description: Special handling instructions or notes for the cross-dock operation, such as fragile, stack limit, or orientation requirements.

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inbound shipment was received at the source dock door.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cross-docked goods are classified as hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance.

attributes.name: is_promotional_merchandise
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cross-docked goods are part of a promotional campaign or seasonal event.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cross-docked goods require temperature-controlled handling (e.g., refrigerated or frozen products).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the cross-dock transaction for operational reference.

attributes.name: outbound_staging_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods were staged at the destination dock door for outbound shipment.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this cross-dock transaction.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number linked to the inbound shipment being cross-docked.

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cross-dock transaction was flagged as high-priority for expedited processing.

attributes.name: quantity_cross_docked
attributes.description: Total quantity of units successfully transferred from inbound to outbound without entering reserve storage.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the product being cross-docked.

attributes.name: source_dock_door
attributes.description: Dock door number or identifier where the inbound shipment was received.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: Serial Shipping Container Code for the logistics unit being cross-docked, providing unique identification for tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specific temperature range or condition required for the cross-docked goods (e.g., 2-8°C, frozen, ambient).

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Trailer or vehicle number assigned to the outbound shipment carrying the cross-docked goods.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique transaction number for the cross-dock event, used for operational tracking and reference.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cross-dock transaction in its lifecycle: planned, in-progress, completed, cancelled, or exception.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the goods were physically transferred from the inbound dock to the outbound staging area.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the cross-docked quantity: EA (each), CS (case), PL (pallet), LB (pound), KG (kilogram).

products.name: inventory_transfer
products.description: Records inter-facility inventory transfer orders and movements between DCs, MFCs, stores, and 3PL nodes. Captures transfer order number, origin facility, destination facility, SKU, transfer quantity, unit of measure, lot/batch, transfer reason (rebalancing, store replenishment, returns consolidation), requested ship date, actual ship date, receipt confirmation date, and transfer status. Distinct from inbound supplier shipments — this entity owns internal stock movement.

attributes.name: inventory_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory transfer transaction. Primary key for the inventory transfer entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the carrier or logistics provider handling the transfer shipment. Links to the carrier master record for transportation tracking.

attributes.name: cross_dock_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to a cross-dock plan if applicable. References the cross-dock planning record for coordinated inbound-to-outbound movements.

attributes.name: destination_facility_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility to which inventory is being transferred. Target location for the stock movement.

attributes.name: origin_inventory_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_node. Business justification: Store-to-store and DC-to-store transfers require origin_inventory_node_id to track stock movement from specific nodes. Existing origin_facility_id targets dc_facility only; retail needs inventory_node

attributes.name: primary_inventory_dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility from which inventory is being transferred. Source location for the stock movement.

attributes.name: replenishment_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to a replenishment plan if the transfer is driven by automated replenishment logic. References the supply planning record that triggered the transfer.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this transfer to the physical shipment record. Connects the transfer order to the logistics execution layer.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product being transferred. Links to the master product record for the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being moved.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was actually received and confirmed at the destination facility. Marks completion of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was actually shipped from the origin facility. Used for performance tracking and transit time calculation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was approved. Marks the authorization point in the transfer lifecycle for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the transfer order. Used for audit trail and accountability in inventory movement authorization.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Ship Notice number sent to the destination facility. EDI 856 transaction identifier providing advance notification of incoming inventory.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code identifying the transportation carrier. Four-letter code assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) for carrier identification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was first created in the system. Audit field tracking the initial creation of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer value. Indicates the currency in which inventory costs are denominated.

attributes.name: destination_facility_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the destination facility. Indicates whether the target is a Distribution Center (DC), Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), store, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider, or vendor location.

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory is expected to arrive at the destination facility. Used for receiving planning and inventory availability forecasting.

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost incurred for moving the inventory between facilities. Used for total cost of ownership analysis and logistics expense tracking.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product being transferred. International standard product identifier that may be UPC (Universal Product Code), EAN (European Article Number), or other GTIN format.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transfer is part of a cross-docking operation where inventory moves directly from inbound to outbound without storage. True if cross-dock, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transferred inventory contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance. True if hazmat, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order record was last modified. Audit field tracking the most recent change to any attribute of the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number for the inventory being transferred. Used for traceability, quality control, and recall management, particularly for perishable or regulated goods.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the transfer. Captures special instructions, handling requirements, or contextual information for the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: origin_facility_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the origin facility. Indicates whether the source is a Distribution Center (DC), Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), store, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider, or vendor location.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the transfer order. Determines handling urgency and shipping method selection for time-sensitive inventory movements.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and confirmed at the destination facility. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage, loss, or discrepancies during transit.

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory is requested to be shipped from the origin facility. Represents the planned or desired shipment date for supply chain planning.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number for serialized inventory items being transferred. Provides unit-level traceability for high-value or regulated products.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped from the origin facility. May differ from transfer quantity due to stock availability or last-minute adjustments.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant being transferred. Unique item identifier used for inventory tracking and management.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the inventory requires temperature-controlled transportation and storage. True if temperature-sensitive, false otherwise.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Specific temperature control requirement for the transferred inventory. Defines the storage and transit temperature range needed to maintain product quality and safety.

attributes.name: total_transfer_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the inventory transfer calculated as unit cost multiplied by transfer quantity. Used for financial reporting and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the transfer shipment. Used for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transfer order number used for tracking and reference across systems and facilities. Externally visible identifier for the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units being transferred from origin to destination facility. Represents the planned or actual number of items moved in the transfer transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the inventory transfer. Provides standardized classification of why the stock movement is occurring for analytics and operational planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rebalancing|replenishment|returns|excess_stock|damaged_goods|recall|seasonal_shift — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory transfer order. Tracks progression from draft through approval, shipment, and receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer purpose. Indicates the business reason driving the inventory movement between facilities.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the inventory being transferred. Used for inventory valuation and financial accounting of inter-facility stock movements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transfer quantity. Defines how the transferred inventory is counted and tracked (individual units, cases, pallets, etc.).

products.name: dock_appointment
products.description: Manages scheduled dock door appointments and yard trailer tracking for inbound and outbound operations at DC facilities. Appointment attributes include scheduled date/time, dock door assignment, appointment type (inbound, outbound, cross-dock), carrier, trailer number, supplier/PO reference, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, at-door, loading/unloading, completed, no-show), actual arrival time, and dock dwell time. Yard management attributes include trailer yard location (door, spot, staging lane), check-in/check-out timestamps, seal number, load status (empty, loaded, partial), temperature readings for reefer trailers, trailer type (dry van, reefer, flatbed), and associated inbound/outbound shipment references. SSOT for dock scheduling efficiency, yard visibility, and trailer dwell time monitoring at DC facilities.

attributes.name: dock_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dock appointment record. Primary key for the dock appointment entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for the shipment associated with this dock appointment.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse facility where the dock appointment is scheduled.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inbound or outbound shipment record associated with this dock appointment. Links appointment to shipment transaction.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor associated with inbound shipments for this dock appointment. Applicable primarily for inbound and cross-dock appointments.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier or trailer arrived at the facility gate or yard. Used to measure on-time performance and calculate dwell time.

attributes.name: actual_carton_count
attributes.description: Actual number of cartons or cases handled during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance against expected quantities.

attributes.name: actual_pallet_count
attributes.description: Actual number of pallets loaded or unloaded during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance against expected quantities.

attributes.name: actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual total weight in kilograms of the shipment handled during the dock appointment operation. Used to measure variance and validate freight charges.

attributes.name: appointment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes allocated for the dock appointment from scheduled start to scheduled end. Used for dock capacity planning and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique appointment reference number used for scheduling and tracking dock appointments across systems and communications with carriers and suppliers.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dock appointment tracking progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|confirmed|checked_in|at_door|in_progress|completed|cancelled|no_show — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dock appointment indicating the nature of the operation: inbound receiving, outbound shipping, cross-dock transfer, live unload, or drop trailer.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Advanced Ship Notice document sent by the supplier or carrier to notify the facility of the incoming shipment details prior to arrival.

attributes.name: at_door_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the trailer was positioned at the assigned dock door and ready for loading or unloading operations to begin.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Legal document number issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment. Serves as a contract of carriage and receipt.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the dock appointment was cancelled. Used for operational analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Four-letter unique identifier assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify transportation carriers in North America.

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier checked in at the facility and was assigned to the yard or dock door queue.

attributes.name: check_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier checked out of the facility and departed the yard.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the dock appointment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Physical dock door identifier assigned to this appointment for loading or unloading operations. Represents the specific bay or door location at the facility.

attributes.name: dock_door_zone
attributes.description: Logical zone or area grouping for the dock door (e.g., inbound zone, outbound zone, cross-dock zone, refrigerated zone) used for operational planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: driver_license_number
attributes.description: Commercial driver license number of the driver. Captured for security verification and compliance with transportation regulations.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the driver delivering or picking up the trailer for this dock appointment. Used for security and access control purposes.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes that the trailer spent at the facility from arrival to departure. Key performance indicator for dock efficiency and yard management.

attributes.name: expected_carton_count
attributes.description: Anticipated number of cartons or cases to be handled during this dock appointment based on advance shipping notice or order information.

attributes.name: expected_pallet_count
attributes.description: Anticipated number of pallets to be loaded or unloaded during this dock appointment based on advance shipping notice or order information.

attributes.name: expected_weight_kg
attributes.description: Anticipated total weight in kilograms of the shipment to be handled during this dock appointment. Used for capacity planning and equipment allocation.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and safety protocols.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the dock appointment record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: late_arrival_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or reason code for why the carrier arrived late outside the scheduled appointment window. Used for root cause analysis and carrier performance management.

attributes.name: load_status
attributes.description: Current loading state of the trailer indicating whether it is empty, fully loaded, or partially loaded.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional instructions, special handling requirements, or operational notes related to the dock appointment.

attributes.name: on_time_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the carrier arrived within the scheduled appointment window. Used for carrier performance measurement and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: operation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loading or unloading operation was completed and the trailer was ready for departure or yard staging.

attributes.name: operation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the actual loading or unloading operation commenced at the dock door.

attributes.name: original_scheduled_timestamp
attributes.description: The initial scheduled start timestamp before any rescheduling occurred. Preserved for audit trail and performance analysis.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Unique shipment tracking number assigned by the carrier for less-than-truckload (LTL) shipments. Used for freight tracking and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the purchase order associated with the inbound shipment for this dock appointment. Links appointment to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: reschedule_count
attributes.description: Number of times this dock appointment has been rescheduled. Used to track scheduling volatility and carrier reliability.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dock appointment is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dock appointment window ends. Defines the expected completion time for the loading or unloading operation.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dock appointment window begins. Used for dock scheduling optimization and carrier arrival planning.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the security seal applied to the trailer door to ensure cargo integrity and prevent tampering during transit.

attributes.name: temperature_reading_celsius
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading in Celsius recorded for refrigerated or frozen trailers at check-in or during operations to ensure cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control classification required for the shipment indicating ambient, refrigerated, or frozen storage and handling conditions.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier or license plate number of the trailer or container involved in the dock appointment. Used for yard management and tracking.

attributes.name: trailer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trailer equipment type indicating the physical configuration and capabilities (dry van, refrigerated, flatbed, tanker, intermodal container).

attributes.name: yard_location
attributes.description: Physical location identifier within the facility yard where the trailer is staged when not at a dock door (e.g., spot number, staging lane, holding area).

products.name: handling_unit
products.description: Represents a physical handling unit (pallet, carton, tote, roll cage, each) tracked through the DC as a discrete unit load via License Plate Number (LPN). Captures handling unit type, LPN barcode, SSCC-18 identifier, parent/child hierarchy (pallet→carton→each), current storage location, contents manifest (SKU, quantity, lot, expiry), weight, dimensions, creation timestamp, last movement timestamp, and disposition status (active, in-transit, shipped, consumed, damaged, on-hold). LPN-level tracking is the foundational Manhattan WMS concept enabling unit-level traceability, inventory accuracy, lot recall capability, and quality hold enforcement. SSOT for physical unit identity within the distribution domain.

attributes.name: destination_type

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date for perishable or date-sensitive SKUs, used for FEFO inventory rotation and quality control.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 global product identifier (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the SKU contained in the handling unit, enabling cross-enterprise product identification.

attributes.name: handling_unit_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the handling unit within the distribution center lifecycle, controlling operational workflows and quality holds.

attributes.name: handling_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical handling unit form factor used for warehouse operations and material handling.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for space planning and carrier cube calculations.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and transportation compliance.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit requires temperature-controlled storage and transportation to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for space planning and carrier cube calculations.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier lot or batch identifier for the SKU, enabling lot-level traceability and recall capability.

attributes.name: lpn
attributes.description: Unique barcode identifier assigned to the handling unit for tracking through the distribution center. The LPN is the foundational Manhattan WMS tracking identifier enabling unit-level traceability.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the SKU was manufactured or produced, supporting shelf-life calculations and quality traceability.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the inbound receipt that created this handling unit, enabling PO-to-inventory traceability.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the handling unit is under quality hold, preventing allocation or shipment until quality inspection is completed.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for quality hold, such as damage inspection, recall investigation, or expiry verification.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the SKU contained within the handling unit, measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Warehouse receipt transaction identifier generated when the handling unit was received and put away into inventory.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the handling unit was loaded onto a carrier and departed the distribution center for outbound delivery.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Primary product identifier for the merchandise contained in the handling unit, linking to the product master.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: 18-digit GS1 standard identifier for the logistics unit, enabling global supply chain traceability and EDI integration.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Current warehouse location identifier where the handling unit is stored, such as aisle-bay-level or zone-bin coordinates.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature zone classification for storage and transportation of the handling unit contents.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Trailer or container identifier where the handling unit is loaded for outbound shipment or was received from inbound delivery.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field, defining how the SKU quantity is counted or weighed.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the handling unit including contents and packaging, measured in kilograms, used for freight calculation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: width_cm

products.name: quality_hold
products.description: Records quality hold and quarantine events applied to handling units, storage locations, or inbound shipments within a DC or MFC. Captures hold type (damage, contamination, temperature excursion, recall, regulatory, expiry), affected entity reference (handling unit ID, location, shipment), hold reason, hold date, release date, disposition decision (return to vendor, destroy, rework, release), approver, and regulatory reference. Supports food safety compliance (FSMA), cold chain temperature excursion tracking, and hazmat quarantine requirements. Essential for retail grocery and perishable goods operations.

attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supervisor or quality manager who approved the disposition decision for the quality hold.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Quality holds are triggered by audit findings (temperature deviations, contamination, labeling violations). Hold disposition requires audit finding reference for regulatory traceability and corrective

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action. Business justification: Quality holds are released after corrective action completion and verification. Hold disposition decisions (release, destroy, return to vendor) require corrective action reference for audit trail and

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the distribution center or micro-fulfillment center where the quality hold event occurred.

attributes.name: escalated_from_quality_hold_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on quality_hold (escalated_from_quality_hold_id)

attributes.name: handling_unit_id

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id

attributes.name: affected_entity_reference

attributes.name: affected_entity_type

attributes.name: affected_quantity

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Ship Notice number for the inbound shipment containing the inventory under quality hold. Used for traceability and supplier accountability.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount

attributes.name: chargeback_currency_code

attributes.name: chargeback_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality hold event is eligible for supplier chargeback or cost recovery based on supplier accountability and contract terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality hold record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposition decision was executed and inventory was released, returned, destroyed, or otherwise processed.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the held inventory: release (approved for use), return_to_vendor (RTV for credit or replacement), destroy (dispose per hazmat or food safety protocols), rework (repackage or relabel), donate (to food bank or charity), transfer (move to alternate facility).

attributes.name: disposition_notes

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date. Relevant for perishable goods and pharmaceutical items. Quality holds may be triggered when inventory approaches expiry.

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: hold_date
attributes.description: Date when the quality hold was initiated and inventory was quarantined.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the quality hold event, used for tracking and reference in communications with suppliers and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the reason for the quality hold, including observations, inspector notes, and contextual information.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality hold: active (hold in effect, inventory quarantined), released (hold lifted, inventory available), pending_disposition (awaiting decision on disposition), escalated (requires senior management or regulatory review), closed (disposition completed and documented).

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the quality hold was initiated, including time zone information. Used for SLA tracking and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: hold_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damage|contamination|temperature_excursion|recall|regulatory|expiry|quality_defect — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality hold record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the quality hold was released, if applicable. Used for hold duration calculation and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: sku

attributes.name: storage_location_code

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for the product under quality hold: ambient (room temperature), chilled (refrigerated 0-5°C), frozen (below 0°C).

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`analytics_alert`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Operational alert performance — tracks alert volume, severity distribution, resolution times, and false positive rates. Used by operations and analytics teams to manage exception handling and system health."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`analytics`.`alert`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "alert_type"
      expr: alert_type
      comment: "Category of alert (threshold_breach, anomaly, data_quality, compliance) for triage and routing."
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity classification (critical, high, medium, low) for prioritization in operations dashboards."
    - name: "alert_status"
      expr: alert_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status (open, acknowledged, resolved, suppressed) for workload management."
    - name: "business_entity_type"
      expr: business_entity_type
      comment: "Type of business entity the alert relates to, enabling domain-specific alert analysis."
    - name: "escalation_level"
      expr: escalation_level
      comment: "Escalation tier reached (L1, L2, L3, executive) for SLA compliance tracking."
    - name: "notification_channel"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`ecommerce_abandoned_cart_recovery`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Abandoned cart recovery campaign metrics covering recovery rates, incentive effectiveness, and recovered revenue. Drives CRM and retention investment decisions."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`ecommerce`.`abandoned_cart_recovery`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "recovery_status"
      expr: recovery_status
      comment: "Outcome of the recovery attempt (recovered, expired, opted-out, pending) for campaign effectiveness analysis."
    - name: "recovery_channel"
      expr: recovery_channel
      comment: "Channel used for recovery outreach (email, SMS, push) for channel effectiveness comparison."
    - name: "incentive_type"
      expr: incentive_type
      comment: "Type of incentive offered (discount, free-shipping, loyalty-points) for incentive ROI analysis."
    - name: "device_type"
      expr: device_type
      comment: "Device type of the abandoned cart for device-specific recovery strategy."
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Transaction currency for multi-currency revenue normalization."
    - name: "is_first_recovery_attempt"
      expr: is_first_recovery_attempt
      comment: "Whether this is the first recovery attempt for sequence effectiveness analysis."
    - name: "is_incentive_redeemed"
      expr: is_incentive_redeemed
      comment: "Whether the recovery incentive was redeemed for incentive cost tracking."
    - name: "utm_campaign"
      expr: utm_campaign
      comment: "UTM campaign tag for marketing attribution of recovery campaigns."
    - name: "recovery_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', message_sent_timestamp)
      comment: "Day the recovery message was sent for daily campaign performance analysis."
    - name: "recovery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', message_sent_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the recovery message was sent for monthly campaign performance analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_recovery_attempts"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of abandoned cart recovery attempts. Baseline volume metric for recovery program scale."
    - name: "total_abandoned_gmv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(abandoned_cart_gmv AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross merchandise value of abandoned carts targeted for recovery. Quantifies the revenue opportunity being pursued."
    - name: "total_recovered_gmv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recovered_gmv AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross merchandise value successfully recovered. Primary recovery program revenue impact metric."
    - name: "recovery_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN recovery_status = 'recovered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of recovery attempts that resulted in a completed order. Primary recovery campaign effectiveness KPI."
    - name: "gmv_recovery_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(recovered_gmv AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(abandoned_cart_gmv AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of abandoned GMV that was successfully recovered. Measures the financial effectiveness of the recovery program."
    - name: "avg_incentive_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(incentive_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average incentive value offered in recovery campaigns. Tracks promotional cost per recovery attempt."
    - name: "total_recovered_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recovered_order_net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net order amount from recovered carts after discounts. Represents actual net revenue contribution of the recovery program."
    - name: "total_recovery_discount_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(recovered_order_discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount cost incurred to recover abandoned carts. Used to calculate net ROI of the recovery program."
    - name: "incentive_redemption_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_incentive_redeemed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of recovery attempts where the incentive was redeemed. High redemption with low recovery rate indicates incentive cost without conversion benefit."
$$
metric_views.description: Abandoned cart recovery campaign metrics covering recovery rates, incentive effectiveness, and recovered revenue. Drives CRM and retention investment decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`ecommerce_cart`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Cart-level metrics covering abandonment, discount usage, and cart value. Central to understanding checkout funnel leakage and promotional effectiveness."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`ecommerce`.`cart`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cart_status"
      expr: cart_status
      comment: "Current state of the cart (active, abandoned, converted, expired) for funnel stage analysis."
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Sales channel (web, mobile app, in-store kiosk) for cross-channel cart behavior comparison."
    - name: "device_type"
      expr: device_type
      comment: "Device used to create the cart for device-specific abandonment analysis."
    - name: "fulfillment_type"
      expr: fulfillment_type
      comment: "Fulfillment method selected (ship-to-home, BOPIS, etc.) for operational demand planning."
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Transaction currency for multi-currency revenue normalization."
    - name: "is_guest_cart"
      expr: is_guest_cart
      comment: "Whether the cart belongs to a guest (unauthenticated) user. Guest vs authenticated cart behavior differs significantly in conversion rates."
    - name: "cart_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Day the cart was created for daily trend analysis."
    - name: "cart_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the cart was created for monthly trend analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_carts"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of carts created. Baseline demand signal for the checkout funnel."
    - name: "abandoned_carts"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_abandoned = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of carts that were abandoned without conversion. Directly quantifies revenue at risk from checkout funnel leakage."
    - name: "cart_abandonment_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_abandoned = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of carts abandoned. A primary ecommerce health KPI; increases trigger UX, pricing, and checkout flow investigations."
    - name: "total_cart_subtotal"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subtotal_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all cart subtotals. Represents gross merchandise value at the cart stage, including abandoned carts."
    - name: "avg_cart_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(subtotal_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cart subtotal value. Tracks basket size trends and informs upsell and cross-sell strategy."
    - name: "total_cart_discount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount value applied across all carts. Measures promotional cost at the cart stage."
    - name: "avg_cart_discount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount per cart. Elevated averages may indicate over-reliance on promotions to drive cart creation."
    - name: "total_estimated_shipping"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_shipping_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated shipping charges across all carts. Informs free-shipping threshold calibration and logistics cost forecasting."
    - name: "total_cart_tax"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated tax across all carts. Used for tax liability forecasting and compliance reporting."
$$
metric_views.description: Cart-level metrics covering abandonment, discount usage, and cart value. Central to understanding checkout funnel leakage and promotional effectiveness.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`finance_ap_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Accounts payable invoice metrics tracking vendor payment obligations, discount capture efficiency, tax exposure, and payment cycle performance for treasury and procurement leadership."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`finance`.`ap_invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice (e.g. open, paid, disputed, blocked) for aging and workflow analysis."
    - name: "invoice_type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Classification of the invoice (e.g. standard, credit memo, recurring) to segment payables by type."
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Transaction currency for multi-currency payables exposure analysis."
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method used (e.g. ACH, wire, check) to analyze payment channel mix."
    - name: "payment_terms_code"
      expr: payment_terms_code
      comment: "Vendor payment terms code (e.g. Net30, 2/10Net30) for discount capture and cash flow planning."
    - name: "three_way_match_status"
      expr: three_way_match_status
      comment: "PO/GR/invoice three-way match result to identify exceptions requiring manual intervention."
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year of the invoice for period-over-period payables trend analysis."
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period of the invoice for monthly payables reporting."
    - name: "is_edi_received"
      expr: is_edi_received
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the invoice was received electronically, supporting automation rate tracking."
    - name: "invoice_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Invoice date truncated to month for trend analysis of payables volume."
    - name: "due_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', due_date)
      comment: "Payment due date truncated to month for cash outflow forecasting."
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_payables"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross amount of AP invoices — primary measure of vendor payment obligations outstanding."
    - name: "total_net_payables"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net payable amount after discounts, representing actual cash outflow obligation."
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on AP invoices for tax liability reporting and compliance."
    - name: "total_discount_captured"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total early-payment discounts captured — measures treasury efficiency in leveraging vendor terms."
    - name: "total_chargeback_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(chargeback_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total chargeback amounts raised against vendors — signals vendor compliance and dispute volume."
    - name: "avg_invoice_gross_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average gross invoice amount per AP invoice — baseline for vendor spend concentration analysis."
    - name: "invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of AP invoices processed — measures payables processing volume and workload."
    - name: "disputed_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN invoice_status = 'disputed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of invoices in disputed status — high values indicate vendor or receiving quality issues."
    - name: "three_way_match_exception_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN three_way_match_status != 'matched' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of invoices failing three-way match — drives manual intervention cost and payment delays."
    - name: "edi_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_edi_received = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of invoices received via EDI — measures AP automation adoption rate."
$$
metric_views.description: Accounts payable invoice metrics tracking vendor payment obligations, discount capture efficiency, tax exposure, and payment cycle performance for treasury and procurement leadership.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_retail_v1`.`_metrics`.`finance_ar_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Accounts receivable invoice metrics covering revenue billed, collections performance, write-off exposure, and dispute management for finance and credit leadership."
  source: "`vibe_retail_v1`.`finance`.`ar_invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current AR invoice status (e.g. open, paid, written-off, disputed) for aging and collections segmentation."
    - name: "invoice_type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Type of AR invoice (e.g. standard, credit memo) to segment receivables by billing category."
    - name: "billing_category"
      expr: billing_category
      comment: "Business billing category (e.g. product sale, service, subscription) for revenue mix analysis."
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Invoice currency for multi-currency receivables exposure reporting."
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method on the AR invoice for collections channel analysis."
    - name: "payment_terms_code"
      expr: payment_terms_code
      comment: "Customer payment terms for DSO and collections efficiency benchmarking."
    - name: "dispute_status"
      expr: dispute_status
      comment: "Current dispute resolution status to track collections friction and resolution cycle time."
    - name: "revenue_recognition_status"
      expr: revenue_recognition_status
      comment: "ASC 606 revenue recognition status (e.g. recognized, deferred, pending) for compliance reporting."
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year for period-over-period AR trend analysis."
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period for monthly AR aging and collections reporting."
    - name: "invoice_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)
      comment: "Invoice date truncated to month for billing volume trend analysis."
    - name: "dunning_level"
      expr: dunning_level
      comment: "Collections dunning level reached — indicates severity of overdue status and escalation stage."
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_receivables"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross AR billed — primary measure of revenue invoiced to customers."
    - name: "total_net_receivables"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net receivable amount after cash discounts — actual expected cash inflow."
    - name: "total_open_receivables"
      expr: SUM(CAST(open_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding open AR balance — key liquidity and collections performance indicator."
    - name: "total_applied_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(applied_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cash applied against AR invoices — measures collections effectiveness."
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total AR written off as uncollectible — measures credit risk materialization and bad debt expense."
    - name: "total_cash_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cash_discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cash discounts granted to customers — measures cost of early payment incentives."
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax billed on AR invoices for tax liability and compliance reporting."
    - name: "avg_open_receivable_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(open_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average open AR balance per invoice — baseline for collections prioritization and DSO modeling."
    - name: "invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total AR invoices issued — measures billing volume and customer transaction activity."
    - name: "disputed_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_status IS NOT NULL AND dispute_status != 'resolved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of AR invoices in active dispute — high values signal customer satisfaction or billing accuracy issues."
    - name: "written_off_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN write_off_amount > 0 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of invoices with write-off activity — tracks bad debt incidence rate."
$$
metric_views.description: Accounts receivable invoice metrics covering revenue billed, collections performance, write-off exposure, and dispute management for finance and credit leadership.

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
